490.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg
490.details:
By strict orders from the Sentinels, I am commissioning a bounty on the Gnarlpine. They are no longer friends of the forest. Their corruption has left them mindless threats to our people and the creatures of the glade.

As decreed, you shall be rewarded for removing the furbolg menaces from Teldrassil. Bring to me their fangs as proof of your deeds.

You will find furbolg concentrated in Ban'ethil Hollow, west of Dolanaar and south of the road, and in Starbreeze Village to the east.
490.offerRewardText: You have served well, adventurer. You shall be rewarded for your contribution.
490.requestItemsText: Teldrassil cannot thrive with corruption tainting the land. Drive the Gnarlpine from this forest, once and for all.

620.title: The Monogrammed Sash
620.details: This fine sash has the letters "HS" embroidered along its hem.

785.title: A Strategic Alliance
785.details: Thrall is a most wise and noble leader. His tenacity on the battlefield is matched only by his diplomatic tact. The Darkspear Trolls have proven to be invaluable allies to orckind. Out of loyalty and honor we have sworn a pact of protection with them. The Warchief has sent orders to make sure our Darkspear friends in Sen'jin Village are not under any direct threat. One of their most trusted scouts, Lar Prowltusk is keeping a close watch on their western flank. Seek out Lar and assist as needed.

908.title: Amongst the Ruins
908.details: The Twilight's Hammer has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps.  Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us.  If left unchecked, this region will be theirs for good. adventurer, go into Blackfathom and find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere close in the water.  In it is a fathom core - a device that when properly read it will relate a history of all elemental activity.  If I have it, I and the Earthen Ring can maybe do something to stop them!

909.title: Baron Aquanis
909.details: The defeated water elemental has left behind a strange water globe.  You surmise that the object somehow fed the beast energy.  Inside the globe, a putrid-looking form of water sloshes about.  The globe itself seems impervious to any sort of physical force. If anyone can make any sense of this item, it would be Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring.  He is located at the Horde's Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.

1288.title: Vimes's Report
1288.details: You've done some good work, adventurer, best I've seen from an amateur. Lady Proudmoore asked that I keep her apprised of this delicate situation, and I haven't spoken to her for some time now. I was going to deliver my report to her later, but it seems more fitting that you should be the one to speak with her about it. You can probably answer her questions better than I could.

3366.title: The Glowing Shard
3366.details: The shard is a brilliant green, and although solid, what looks like smoke swirls just below the surface. You can't help staring into the depths of the crystal; at the same time, you know there is something very disturbing about it. Maybe you should see if anyone in Ratchet can tell you more about this strange shard.

3381.title: A Meeting with the Master
3381.details: Ah, a young friend come to speak to Sanath. What a wonderful day! I am so honored to have you grace me with your presence. Thank you! Please... do not be so arrogant to assume my sarcasm was a compliment. Let us get one thing straight: I don't like you. But this little conversation doesn't have anything to do with us--it has to do with my master. Bring me a couple hippogryph feathers for my arrows and I'll give you leave to see him. He's asked that I send adventurers to him if they proved worthy enough.

3911.title: The Last Element
3911.details: There is work to be had for those venturing into the depths, adventurer. The Dark Irons have mastered creation of extremely powerful golems. Initial reports from our spies indicate that the dwarves use a unique power source to give their creations incomparable killing power. Just imagine what we could do with our abominations if we could get our hands on this essence of the elements! Turn that city upside down if you must, but do not return until you have found the essence! Payment will be worth the risk.

5640.title: Desperate Prayer
5640.details: Praise be to Elune, and to your Light, adventurer. About this time, many of our order learn abilities reflecting their faith in Elune. If knowledge serves me, I believe the same holds true for your order also. When your business in Darnassus is complete, I would seek out one of your High Priests for further training.
5640.offerRewardText: I'm glad you've arrived, adventurer. There are many things we will have to discuss, but more importantly is your training in the ways of the Light. There are lessons all servants of the Light must learn. If you are ready, we'll begin discussing some of those now.

5678.title: Arcane Feedback
5678.details: It is time for you to return to Stormwind, young one. Your superiors there have called you back for more training. And although it disturbs me some, your race and mine are allies and I would not betray that. I do not mean to be so coy with you--my distrust of arcane magics, be they divine inspired or not, is still strong within me. You will know of what I speak after you return to your Cathedral of Light. Speak to High Priestess Laurena when you arrive.
5678.offerRewardText: Ah, you have wonderful timing, adventurer. I was beginning to wonder if all of my messengers had been successful. I'm glad to see they were, otherwise I would wager you'd still be out in the world learning more about all the threats that exist against our people. Are you ready? Ready for more training I mean. You're growing in power more quickly, and I feel you are ready to learn more about our faith.

6131.title: Timbermaw Ally
6131.details: The Timbermaw are the only furbolg tribe to escape the corruption. However, many other races kill furbolg blindly now, without bothering to see if they are friend or foe. For this reason, the Timbermaw furbolg trust very few. Are you interested in proving yourself? Drive back the corrupted Deadwood tribe of Felwood and we may one day consider you an ally. You'll find the first Deadwood tribe - warriors, pathfinders and gardeners - to my west.

7487.title: Attunement to the Core
7487.details: Rifts stir, tear, and collapse all around us, friend. Not two paces from where I stand is a tear leading through the depths of Blackrock Mountain, into the maw of the Firelord. Surprised? Pity... The mortal races cannot comprehend that which they cannot see, touch, or feel. I assure you, the portal is there and access is possible. I've piqued your interest? Attunement is simple. Venture into Blackrock Depths and retrieve a core fragment. Return it to me and I shall attune your essence with the portal.

7668.title: The Darkreaver Menace
7668.details: Death Knight Darkreaver lords over the Great Ossuary in the Scholomance.  He threatens to twist the spirit realm to do his own bidding, and he must be stopped!  This is where the scryer you helped make comes into play. Use the divination scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement to call forth Darkreaver's spirit minions.  Defeat the spirits and the death knight himself will appear.  adventurer, bring me his head!  Only his demise will reverse the damage dome to the spirit realm!
7668.offerRewardText: This is a victory to savor, adventurer! The demise of Darkreaver should restore the fragile fetters that anchor the spirit realm. You have far exceeded what was asked of you, even when you had no notion of reward or compensation. You are truly a champion of worth, my friend. I know that acting to preserve the spirit realm should be thanks enough, but please - accept this simple gift with my thanks.
7668.requestItemsText: Time is critical, adventurer - have you succeeded in stopping Death Knight Darkreaver's threat?

7669.title: Again Into the Great Ossuary
7669.offerRewardText: Are you headed back into the Scholomance, adventurer?  You've already paid such a great price for the use of the Divination Scryer - perhaps you'd like to take another one with you.  With it, you'd be able to face the perils of the Great Ossuary once more. By all means, have it.  You've certainly earned it.

7670.title: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
7670.details: The time has come, adventurer, for you to learn about what it will take for you to acquire something you have no doubt waited on for some time... your charger. Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.  It is he who will guide you not only though the legerdemain of a Paladin's most trusted mount, but the tasks before you to acquire one of your own. I wish you the best in this trial.  For the Light, noble <brother/sister>!
7670.offerRewardText: I am glad to see you adventurer. I know that you have awaited word as to how to acquire your charger, and now that time has come. You will be surely tested in many different ways, but most importantly in your willingness to rise above numerous obstacles thrust before you. These are not done as a learning exercise - your stature is beyond simple educational tests. You must save your future companion from the clutches of the evil you have spent your life fighting. Take heed, your time has come!

7908.title: Arena Master
7908.details: There must be more to being a master of the arena than this!   Perhaps the Pirate who runs the event at Gurubashi will know!

7961.title: Waskily Wabbits!
7961.details: These rabbits are breeding uncontrollably.  Something must be done! Help us adventurer, you're our only hope.

7962.title: Wabbit Pelts
7962.details: I want LeCrafty rabbit pelts.  Get me some from LeCrafty Rabbits. This is important!

8259.title: A More Fitting Reward
8259.offerRewardText: Ah, adventurer... your effort against Darkreaver was extraordinary - an effort, may I add, that deserved a much better reward than you received.  Please, accept this helm as an additional gift to you for your accomplishments in Scholomance. Again, thank you.

8530.title: The Alliance Needs Singed Corestones!
8530.details: champion, I need your help. In the Molten Core there are these stones, singed Corestones to be precise, that we need to harvest for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. I'm told that our blacksmiths and engineers can put them to good use, so that's where you come in. I need you to go into the Molten Core and gather up as many of these corestones as you can. Of course, you'll want to talk thirty-nine of your closest friends along with you.

8617.title: The Horde Needs Singed Corestones!
8617.details: The time has come for you to contribute to the Ahn'Qiraj war effort, champion. Gone are the halcyon days of whiling away your time in leisure. Now it is time to serve me and the Horde, and I assure you that I am not as forgiving as the Warchief. You will gather your forces, a guild if you have one, and invade the Molten Core. Inside you will find that the denizens of the place have singed corestones. Bring these back to me in large quantities.

9556.title: To The Victor...
9556.details: You've no doubt been fighting long and hard among the towers, friend. We would like to give something back to you in return for your defense of these lands, but first, you must prove to us you understand the weight of the tragedies that took place here. Walk the streets of Stratholme and find a vial of the holy water. Once you have it, travel to the mage quarter of Stormwind or the Undercity... There, if you are victorious within these lands, you will find my colleague.

65593.title: Hearts of the Lovers
65593.details: An incubus will be drawn to the hearts of lovers, and the most aching love will create the most irresistible lure. My scrying has revealed two that should serve exceptionally. In Silverpine Forest, Avelina Lilly provides her tailoring services to the fallen wizards at Ambermill. In the Barrens, Isaac Pearson hopes to make his mark in the seaside town of Ratchet. They toil on opposite ends of the world, yet their hearts yearn only for each other. Bring those hearts to Carendin.
65593.offerRewardText: As expected. Excellently done, adventurer. Idiots.
65593.requestItemsText: Ah, adventurer, you return. Were you able to procure the lovers' hearts?

65597.title: The Binding
65597.details: The time has come at last. Bring the hearts to the summoning circle below. Place them at its center and call forth the incubus. The demon will not be pleased when it realizes that you have tempted it into a trap. Do not fall prey to its beguilement, adventurer. You must subdue it fully. Only then can I teach you the spell to bind it to your will.
65597.offerRewardText: Impressive. Very impressive. The sayaad specialize in preying upon mortals. Many a champion has thought themselves strong enough to command one, only to find themselves being commanded instead. This trial did not break you, adventurer, and your efforts have earned your reward. I will teach you the spell to summon the incubus.
65597.requestItemsText: The incubus possesses martial prowess, but its illusory charms are its most potent weapon. Falter for even a moment, and the demon will seize upon the opportunity to enthrall you. Do not let it, adventurer.

65601.title: Love Hurts
65601.details:
A sayaad male is known as an incubus. A creature of profound evil and singular mind.

The demon must be lured into our world with an item of enticement - an object that represents great love and devotion.

If you trust a blind man to lead you, adventurer, then listen. East from the Cleft of Shadow, along the main drag of Orgrimmar, lives Magar. He longs for the return of his mate, Krilge.

Seek him out. He'll ask you to search for something precious. That is the key which you must bring to Gan'rul.
65601.offerRewardText: Who told you about Krilge? Have you come with any news? You better not be toying with me...

65602.title: What Is Love?
65602.details:
You will need a powerful reagent to tempt an incubus -- an object that represents great devotion and love.

With my scrying, I have located a small figurine that should be suitable for your ritual.

Thousands of years ago, the figurine belonged to a young couple. The original owners are no more, but their keepsake has survived to the present day.

Follow the road north into Ashenvale, then west and past Maestra's Post. You will see a house nestled amongst the trees. There you will find what you seek.
65602.offerRewardText: <Gakin turns the wooden figurine over in his hand.> I sense the emotional energy residing within this artifact, undiminished by the passing of time. The incubus will be drawn to it like a fly to honey. Takar never disappoints.

65603.title: The Binding
65603.details:
The time has come. Take the figurine and descend into the crypts below. A summoning circle has been prepared, and you must place the figurine at its center.

Then the gateway will open, and the incubus will cross into our world.

A sayaad is not to be underestimated. The demon will not hesitate to attack when it realizes your ruse. You must draw upon all you have been taught to defeat it.

If you succeed, return to me and I shall bind the creature to your will. Fail, and your soul is forfeit.
65603.offerRewardText: Not bad, adventurer. Your have bested the fiend, and your will remains unbroken. Many a champion has believed themselves strong enough to bind a sayaad, only to become the demon's next meal instead. I am pleased to see you are not so foolish. Watch closely, and I will teach you the invocation to call upon your newly bound incubus.
65603.requestItemsText: The incubus will try to lower your guard through beguilement and deception. The demon is adept at swaying the hearts of mortals. Remember that anything it may offer you is false. To the demon, you are merely prey.

65604.title: The Binding
65604.details:
Yes... I see. I feel the residual emotions bound within these threads. Love is woven into its stitches. The incubus will not be able to resist.

Take this to the summoning circle in Neeru's tent, adventurer. Summon forth a malevolent incubus, then show it your mastery. Do not expect it to be subdued quietly. Ready your magic and prepare yourself for a fight. Underestimating a demon has been many a warlock's final mistake.

When you have defeated it, return the cloth to me. I will let Magar know what you found.
65604.offerRewardText: Hah! Victorious, as expected! The incubus is subdued, and it will be my pleasure to teach you to summon the demon. You strength is growing, and I have no doubt that this is a mere stepping stone to even greater powers. I will return the scarf to Magar. I have known that orc for many years, and never did I think he would care for someone the way he cared for Krilge. It is a reminder of what separates us from the demons. We wield their darkness, but they will never wield us.
65604.requestItemsText: The sayaad are dominators of minds and torturers of souls. Their visage brings the heart joy, leaving you defenseless when they rend your flesh with whip and claw. Do not entertain the incubus' charms, adventurer. Slay it quickly and let it be done.

65610.title: Wish You Were Here
65610.details:
I met Krilge while making Mooncloth in Ashenvale. He was stationed there to protect civilians from danger, until he disappeared...

They've stopped looking for him and consider him a deserter, but I don't believe it.

We would often meet at Fallen Sky Lake before it became overrun by those aggressive bog beasts.

I'm not typically one to ask favors, but if you could go to Ashenvale and look for any sign of him, I'd appreciate it.
65610.offerRewardText: What is it you have there, adventurer? A scarf made of... Mooncloth? You best not be seeking to romance me.

76156.title: Stalk With The Earthmother
76156.details: I sense in you a hidden talent for the subtle arts, champion. Use this mask to infiltrate the nearby Venture Company mine and steal their supplies. It may not seem like a convincing disguise, but a skilled rogue can slip past any guard with naught but a winning smile and a cunning distraction. I believe this capability lies within you as well.
76156.offerRewardText: Hmm... perhaps disguises are not your strength.
76156.requestItemsText: We'll need to work on your stealth skills, champion. I heard you approaching as soon as you set foot on the mesa.

76160.title: Stalk With The Earthmother
76160.details: Maybe your skills lie with poisons, not disguises. The Harpies to the north nest in a tree which produces a resin of potent toxicity. Gather the fallen cones around the nests, then crush them into a salve. When applied to a blade this salve will sear your opponent's wounds into their flesh and turn their blood to salt.
76160.offerRewardText: champion, this is not the venomous salve I asked for. What you have brought me is pine nut butter. Are you sure you followed my instructions? This will be of far more use spread on some spice bread than on a dagger. Although you would be quite formidable against a foe with a nut allergy.
76160.requestItemsText: Be careful with the salve once you are finished, champion. Even skin contact could be quite painful.

76240.title: Stalk With The Earthmother
76240.details:
I have one last idea that may lead us to success. I still feel there is hidden talent in you, but let us try and coax it out with a less direct approach.

Go and procure a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then bring it back here. Use these daggers to clean and fillet it. Do not think too hard - do what comes naturally.
76240.offerRewardText: That was quite a display, champion. Not the rogueish precision I hoped for, but you possess an impressive ambidexterity. I see now that you will not be the one to train my people in the subtle arts, but there is one thing I can teach you. Good luck on your travels, champion. The Horde will need heroes like you.
76240.requestItemsText: Do you have something for me?

78088.title: A Strange Artifact
78088.details:
<The mysterious orb you hold fills you with cold dread. You can almost hear a voice echo faintly in your mind. Low and guttural, you understand well that the language being spoken is demonic in nature.

Even as a paladin, this magic is beyond you. Find a more senior paladin here in Kalimdor who might be able to help you discern the nature of this sinister object.>
78088.offerRewardText: You were right to bring this to me, adventurer.
78088.requestItemsText: Did you find something in the tower?

78124.title: Nar'thalas Almanac
78124.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. Our knowledge expands through your efforts. If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78124.requestItemsText: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

78127.title: The Dalaran Digest
78127.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. Our knowledge expands through your efforts. If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78127.requestItemsText: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

78132.title: Dragonslayer's Helm
78132.offerRewardText: Splendid job, adventurer! With this, I am one step further on my path to glory.
78132.requestItemsText: The helm of the Dragonslayer once belonged to a great commander who fell in battle. It is said his tormented soul still haunts the site of his passing.

78133.title: Dragonslayer's Shield
78133.offerRewardText: Splendid job, adventurer! With this, I am one step further on my path to glory.
78133.requestItemsText: The shield of the Dragonslayer is rumored to be held by an Orcish warlord. He stole it while raiding a human settlement.

78134.title: Dragonslayer's Lance
78134.offerRewardText: Splendid job, adventurer! With this, I am one step further on my path to glory.
78134.requestItemsText: The lance of the Dragonslayer has changed hands many times. Every now and then, rumor spreads of it appearing in black market arms deals. Perhaps the lance's current unsavory proprietor would be willing to part with it; for a price.

78142.title: Bewitchments and Glamours
78142.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. Our knowledge expands through your efforts. If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78142.requestItemsText: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

78143.title: Secrets of the Dreamers
78143.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. Our knowledge expands through your efforts. If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78143.requestItemsText: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

78145.title: Arcanic Systems Manual
78145.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. Our knowledge expands through your efforts. If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78145.requestItemsText: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

78146.title: Goaz Scrolls
78146.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. Our knowledge expands through your efforts. If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78146.requestItemsText: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

78147.title: Crimes Against Anatomy
78147.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. Our knowledge expands through your efforts. If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78147.requestItemsText: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

78148.title: Runes of the Sorcerer-Kings
78148.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. Our knowledge expands through your efforts. If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78148.requestItemsText: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

78149.title: Fury of the Land
78149.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. Our knowledge expands through your efforts. If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
78149.requestItemsText: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

78150.title: Friend of the Library
78150.offerRewardText: Thanks to your donations, the library is thriving. Please, take this.

78261.title: The Horn of Xelthos
78261.details:
<A note sits in the chest>

Hello, adventurer.

I desire a treasure known as The Horn of Xelthos, which is somewhere within Shadowfang Keep.

Venturing inside the keep usually calls for backup. However, for this job, a low profile is of utmost importance.

You must go alone.

I have a contact, by the name of Veenix, in the Stonetalon Mountains. He should be able to help you get past the courtyard gate. The rest is up to you.

Return the horn here, and your payment will be sent soon after.

- C
78261.offerRewardText: <You place The Horn of Xelthos into the chest>

78270.title: Goblin Lockpicks
78270.details:
<A note sits in the chest>

Hello again, adventurer.

I desire a treasure known as The Horn of Xelthos, which is somewhere within Shadowfang Keep.

Venturing inside the keep usually calls for backup. However, for this job, a low profile is of utmost importance.

You must go alone.

I have a contact, by the name of Veenix, in the Stonetalon Mountains. He should be able to help you get past the courtyard gate. The rest is up to you.

Return the horn here, and your payment will be sent soon after.

- C
78270.offerRewardText: Nice job, adventurer. I figure that was a cakewalk for someone in your line of work. As promised, here's the goods.
78270.requestItemsText: You said you're breaking into Shadowfang...alone? You've got some guts! I can hook you up with explosives to get past the gate, but I'll need a work order to make it look legit on the books. An employee around here's likely carrying one. Probably someone who does a lot of tinkering or building.

78307.title: The Horn of Xelthos
78307.offerRewardText: <A note sits in the chest> For adventurer. I'll be seeing you. - C

79007.title: ... and that note you found
79007.details:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79007.offerRewardText: As you stumble upon the remnants of yet another charred corpse, your gaze falls upon a message secured to a wooden plank.

79008.title: ... and that note you found
79008.details:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79008.offerRewardText: As you stumble upon the remnants of yet another charred corpse, your gaze falls upon a message secured to a wooden plank.

79090.title: Repelling Invaders
79090.details: Some of the Warsong Outriders lie defeated, but the battle still rages...
79090.offerRewardText: These Horde invaders still sully our lands and harvest from our sacred wilderness. Continue to drive them out! This sacred battle hymn may inspire you to fight them with greater determination. Thank you, adventurer.
79090.requestItemsText: adventurer, what news do you have from the front?

79091.title: Archmage Antonidas: The Unabridged Autobiography
79091.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. You say this is from the Ironforge library?...I'm sure they won't miss it. If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79091.requestItemsText: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

79092.title: Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal
79092.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. Our knowledge expands through your efforts. If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79092.requestItemsText: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

79093.title: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works
79093.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. Our knowledge expands through your efforts. If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79093.requestItemsText: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

79094.title: The Lessons of Ta'zo
79094.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. Our knowledge expands through your efforts. If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79094.requestItemsText: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

79095.title: The Apothecary's Metaphysical Primer
79095.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. Our knowledge expands through your efforts. If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79095.requestItemsText: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

79097.title: Baxtan: On Destructive Magics
79097.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. Our knowledge expands through your efforts. If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79097.requestItemsText: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

79098.title: Clear the Forest!
79098.details: This one is slain, but these infuriating alliance continue to fight... what is this charm?
79098.offerRewardText: These Alliance dogs still prevent us from harvesting the resources needed for Orgrimmar. Continue to drive them out! This Warsong battle drum will inspire you to fight them with greater determination. Lok'tar Ogar, adventurer!
79098.requestItemsText: adventurer, what news do you have from the front?

79192.title: Stepping Stones
79192.details: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."
79192.offerRewardText: Backcountry adventurers and mercenaries alike undoubtedly make camp here. The corner of a note flapping in the breeze catches your eye and you reach for it.

79362.title: Grant's Shield
79362.details:
A shield left behind by the specter of Grant Valor, father of the Valor family and hero of Raven Hill.

With Grant's spirit still battling the undead, perhaps his unfinished business was to slay the scourge that injured him in the Raven Hill Cemetery. It is likely the one his mace is still imbedded in.
79362.offerRewardText: Let's get ready to rumble, ya?
79362.requestItemsText: You' legs be lookin' a wobbly der. De ground be shakin?

79363.title: Silvia's Sword
79363.details:
A sword left by the spirit of Raven Hill's guard, Silvia Valor, who lived her life protecting civilians and their homes.

With Silvia's spirit still visiting farmsteads, perhaps her unfinished business was to route the defias who have taken up residence in Addle's Stead south of Raven Hill.
79363.offerRewardText: Shake dat sludge off, we almost done.

79535.title: Basilisks: Should Petrification be Feared?

79535.requestItemsText: Have you brought something to add to our collection?

79536.title: Greater Friend of the Library

79637.title: A Ticking Present

79731.title: The Troll Scroll
79731.details:
<The ancient glyphs resolve into words before your eyes.>

When Zul'Kunda's fountain runs with the waters of the holy spring, the gods grant their blessing.
79731.offerRewardText: A magic fountain hidden in the jungle? What a story, adventurer! That gives me an idea for another chapter in my book! Let's see, where did I put that manuscript...

79974.title: Wet Job
79974.details:
"Always like to keep a reserve stash nearby in the off chance I've got to flee in a hurry.

The face of this mountainside is so beautiful you might say it was carved from the waterfalls of time. That's the eagles nest, that's what you're looking for."

79975.title: Eagle's Fist
79975.details:
<You find a carefully folded letter inside of the toolbox.>

"From here, with the right tools, you call the shots. Great place to launch a parachute glider.

My loyalty to the Eagle and Fist requires distance in order to serve them best. This barricade has had better days, like the Old Kingdoms it once defended, but I'll never abandon it."
79975.offerRewardText: A campfire is newly fed with wood, but signs of a quick departure are evident.

79976.title: This Must Be The Place
79976.details:
"So, I've decided to take my work back underground. To stop it falling into the wrong hands."

<The paper is torn just large enough to fit the message. You aren't sure if these are the last words you'll read from the author, or if they're a clue to the next hideout. An inadequately secured sleeping bag is unrolling itself onto your feet...>
79976.offerRewardText: Heavy canvas is rolled over assorted equipment. You help yourself to the pack.

79980.title: Scramble
79980.details: "Not so bad, eh? Since you're reading this, it means my stash is still there. Take a hundred paces due north and don't break your ankles going down the steep cliffside. There should be enough to keep you going."
79980.offerRewardText: You pull a messenger bag out of the ground. Stuffed in with the supplies is a dirty parchment.

80001.title: Rekindle
80001.offerRewardText: You put your scout skills to work.
80001.requestItemsText: An extinguished fire pit. The wood is even dry enough to catch a flame. Simple Wood (1)

86574.title: Stonetalon Supply Run
86574.details:
<The unfortunate body here bears the marks of many strikes from the Pridewing wyverns. The pack nearby is rumpled and discarded, with its contents missing, and only a small note clutched in the courier's hand to indicate what was lost: a shipment meant for Innkeeper Faralia at Stonetalon Peak.>

<The wyverns have probably carried off the supply bundles to line their nests.>
86574.offerRewardText: You found the missing shipment? Oh, I had no idea that the courier didn't make it. That is... a tragic state of affairs... I'll put these supplies to good use to make sure that her loss is not in vain.
86574.requestItemsText: I hope that shipment comes soon...

86576.title: Bloodfury Trinkets
86576.details:
In addition to spreading their filth across the Charred Vale, the Bloodfury harpies gather anything shiny that they can find. I'm told that they collect a variety of golden-yellow sunstones for decoration. I have no use for such trinkets, but Mor'rogal has mentioned using them before.

While you're fighting the harpies of the Vale, keep your eye out for Glittering Sunstones. Bring any that you find to Mor'rogal, up on the hills above us.

86585.title: Banner of the Fallen
86585.details:
The fallen mountaineer bears a standard of Ironforge. Perhaps she was scouting, or making a doomed charge. Either way, the standard has been cast down and trampled. The mountaineer was hit on the head so hard that her helm was knocked off and she was killed outright by a trogg, likely with a spiked club.

The trogg that killed her is probably still nearby, and likely remembers the banner. Raising the banner of Ironforge once more may call it out.
86585.offerRewardText: You found Ylva's body? Ah, the poor woman. She said she was going to show the troggs that Ironforge would never fall to their kind. She went looking for a few mountaineers who never returned from a patrol through trogg country. She was always too independent-minded to be cautious. Now we know what happened. I'll take the banner back and make sure it's cleaned up and displayed. You should take her weapon. May it serve you well against the troggs.
86585.requestItemsText: That banner looks like it's been in a war!

86613.title: Excavation Tools
86613.details: The excavation's tools, left behind when the dwarves fled from the troggs, seem mostly untouched. Returning them to the excavators will surely aid their work.
86613.offerRewardText: Our tools! When the troggs overran the camp, we had to leave most of our tools behind. This'll be a big help once we get this invasion under control and can start working again!
86613.requestItemsText: We just, uh, need to adjust our dig site and we can get this whole thing back on track!

86614.title: Silver of the Waves
86614.details: <Among the fishing knickknacks in the debris are some rusty hooks, broken spools of wire, and a slightly corroded but ornate silver hair clip with the monogram "K.D.">
86614.offerRewardText: My hair clip! I thought this was lost for good! This'll shine right up with just a little work. Thank you for bringing it to me! I'll make it worth your while.
86614.requestItemsText: I have a lot of chores today, so can you keep it quick?

86667.title: Snowbound
86667.details:
My old mentor, Norric, sent a minor elemental with an odd request. He needs a jar of snow for some of his shamanic workings! I don't know what he's going to do with that, but I learned a long time ago not to question his ways with respect to magic.

I'm busy learning about the local elementals, so I can't leave to help him. Go to the tunnel entrance at South Gate Pass where there's snow year-round. Scoop some up in this ceramic jar and bring it to him before it melts. The jar should keep it cold.
86667.offerRewardText: This jar is for me? Snow! Grenhild did it! She sent the snow that I asked for! A pity, though, I was hoping she would come and visit in person. Well, regardless, thank you for your effort. This is a real help for my work.

86758.title: Twisting the Knife
86758.details:
Did I ever tell you how I almost lost me hand to a crocolisk? Managed to jam me knife into its jaw, and scrambled out real quick. I thought I had the knife around here somewhere, but I can't seem to find it.

Anyway, that croc is probably still out there hunting along the edge of the lake. That nasty brute probably needs to go, for the safety of the other hunters, if nothing else.

I've taken to calling it Daggerfang. If you see it, give it a friendly hello from me! And by "hello" I mean "stab."
86758.offerRewardText: Hah! You did it! I never thought that ol' croc would get its comeuppance, but that does the trick! Oh ah... y'know, I had to get me another knife, but maybe that one will bring you some good luck. Why don't you hang onto it?

86776.title: Ingredients for the Forge
86776.details:
Thelsamar's a great place to live, but we don't have all of the amenities of Ironforge. I'm always running out of bronze! I need more bronze if I'm going to keep making tools and kettles and pots!

I can tell you have a little experience at the forge. Think you could smelt me some bronze bars? I can pay you well for it!
86776.offerRewardText: Ah, this is a relief! I should be able to keep the forge going now. Hopefully one of these days we'll get a trader bringing coal into town regularly!

86784.title: Sticks and Bones
86784.details:
My associate Eleanor Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."

If you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.
86784.offerRewardText: Extra firewood? That is always welcome. It will keep these old bones warm through the cold nights of the Glades. I have a sling for collecting wood myself, so you might as well hang onto that basket.

87288.title: Soft Saber Pelts
87288.details:
Hello, traveler! I hope you are enjoying your visit to our village. I like Dolanaar because it is small and rustic and everyone is friendly.

I'm a local trader, and I bring in all sorts of tools and trinkets that might be useful to you in your travels. Indeed, if you are interested in a trade, I find myself in need of some nightsaber pelts. While these majestic creatures are beautiful, the local ones are rather aggressive, so don't feel too bad about defending yourself.
87288.offerRewardText: Oh, these are wonderful. It is a shame to resort to violence with such majestic animals, but it is important to keep the roads safe, and these pelts will make beautiful blankets and shawls. Here, let me give you something to remember them. It is both soft and sturdy.
87288.requestItemsText: It is good to see you again! Are you here to trade?

87760.title: Holy Diver
87760.details:
I have received word back from Darnassus, adventurer!

From the animal samples, we learned that the naga dominated these sea creatures to use as unwilling mounts and beasts of burden. The ones that were too obstinate, or too old or badly injured, they drove out for sport. Monstrous!

It is our sacred duty to put a stop to this!

The naga have forces in the Ruins of Mathystra, and they must be seizing threshers from off the shore. Find their beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her tools of domination!
87760.offerRewardText: This has been a long journey, Orangequake, but it was worth it. At long last, you have wrested away the rod that the naga use to compel the sea creatures into their service. I will make sure it is destroyed, and the threshers and sea turtles can finally live in peace. Thank you again. Your persistence has finally been rewarded, and I, personally, am grateful to you.
87760.requestItemsText: We will finally have resolution to this mystery, and the animals will have peace at last!

90902.title: Rediscovering the Light
90902.details:
I am proud to welcome another newly risen paladin to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others.

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.
90902.offerRewardText: Pain is nothing new to those who have endured death, and as such the Forsaken are particularly hardy to it. Pain has a purifying property as well that you should embrace as a badge of honor and evidence that you are, in fact, still a servant of the light despite your new circumstances. Be well and walk in the light once more, champion.
90902.requestItemsText: Mastery of the light will return, in time.

91208.title: Coming to Terms
91208.details:
Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.

These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened paladin who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.
91208.offerRewardText: Tragically, more than a few of our brothers and sisters succumb to a similar madness after being risen. As precious as every Forsaken soul is, sometimes the best we can do is grant those that cannot acclimate a clean end. I will say a prayer to the light for her. Thank you for doing what must be done, adventurer.

91209.title: Continue Your Training
91209.details:
Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training.

One last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a paladin traveling through Forsaken lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.
91209.offerRewardText: Welcome aboard, champion. It's always encouraging to see more of our number roaming these lands. There are many here in Brill in need of assistance from adventurers such as yourself. Seek employment and grow stronger in the light. Return to me whenever you need training. When you've proven yourself to myself and the people of Brill, I will provide guidance for the next leg of your journey. Go with the light, champion.

91282.title: A Second Home
91282.details:
It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new paladin order right here in Tirisfal.

If you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery at Northface Rock. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.
91282.offerRewardText: Another fresh recruit? Welcome to Tyr's Watch, brother.

91285.title: Murlocs at the Gates
91285.details:
Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.

A tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.
91285.offerRewardText: We appreciate the assistance. I'm sure this won't stop the attacks entirely, but it'll hopefully slow them down a bit. It's hard enough rebuilding this place without a murloc trying to stab you in the back with a spear.

91294.title: Touring the Grounds
91294.details:
Now that the immediate threat of the murloc attacks is under control, I'd encourage you to show yourself around our stronghold. It isn't much yet, but it's home.

When you are done exploring, seek out Danitha Morr, our leader. She can help you get settled in.

I'm very glad to have met you, adventurer. May the light be your guide.
91294.offerRewardText: Breton sent you up here, eh? Excellent. My name is Danitha Morr, and I am the closest thing this keep has to a commander. If you come seeking fellowship amongst those that still remain loyal to the light, you've come to the right place. There's a lot of work to do here before we can fully establish ourselves, and we'd be most appreciative if you would be willing to lend aid.
91294.requestItemsText: Welcome to Bandarion Keep, champion. It's always good to see a new face.

91316.title: Making Repairs
91316.details:
This far from the Undercity, logistics are challenging and we have a dire shortage of building materials needed to help restore this fortress. I'd like your help with that.

The ruined village of Shadowvale can be found in the Whispering Forest, just southwest of here. One of the buildings has an old root cellar used to store all sorts of things. There are likely to be usable materials down there. Scavenge what you can and return to us.
91316.offerRewardText: I'm glad to see that your trip to Shadowvale bore fruit. I'll send Breton and a few of the other new recruits over later to clear the rest of the cellar out and retrieve anything left down in the dark.
91316.requestItemsText: They say location is everything. While this fortress may look imposing perched upon these bluffs, its turning out to be quite the challenge to stay supplied this far from proper civilization. An unfortunate oversight on our part.

91317.title: The Tarnished
91317.details:
Not all risen paladins have acclimated well to our new existence, as you may have seen yourself already. Some have carried forward their prejudices from life, and continue to visit violence upon their fellow Forsaken.

As it stands we are mistrusted by our people who remember well the persecution inflicted by the living in the name of the light, and these attacks do not help. A number of these tarnished have taken up residence at Shadowvale to the southwest. End them and bring me their leader's head.
91317.offerRewardText: Excellent work, adventurer. Every time one of these Tarnished strike out and kill one of the Forsaken, it becomes that much easier for our detractors to stoke mistrust towards us paladins. Eliminating them will help further our cause and solidify our place here in Tirisfal. I suspect it may take a long time for us to be fully embraced by the Forsaken and the horde. It could take years... or maybe even decades, but the best we can do is keep trying to prove ourselves.
91317.requestItemsText: The Tarnished threaten what little goodwill we have with the other Forsaken. As much as it pains me to cross blades with our former brothers and sisters, they must be stopped if our fledgling order is to survive.

91723.title: Delicate Instruments
91723.details: Blast it! Every time I try to calibrate these sensitive arcane instruments, they get thrown off again by a surge of energy. The surges seem to be coming from the north, where those primitive Kobolds have been practicing their crude magic. Could you clear some of them out, so I can continue my work?
91723.offerRewardText: Well done, my friend. Let me try my calibrations again...

91724.title: Delicate Instruments
91724.details: Almost there, and... By the Nether! Something is still disrupting my instruments. This is most frustrating, adventurer. I have heard rumors that the local bandits have been practicing spells near Stone Cairn Lake. Maybe if you stop them, these disruptions will finally cease and I can get some work done?
91724.offerRewardText: It seems like everything is working properly. Thank you, adventurer.

91725.title: Stolen Enchanting Supplies
91725.details:
I was sent by Master Theocritus to pick up some enchanting supplies from the trading post, but on the way back I was ambushed by a pack of gnolls!

I dropped the package and escaped, but if I return without it, I'll be cleaning up after the polymorph experiments for weeks as punishment! Do you think you could find the supplies for me?
91725.offerRewardText: Oh, that's a relief! It looks like it's all here. Thank you!

91732.title: Good Steel
91732.details: Good steel is in short supply after the war, and our tools have suffered for it. The Jasperlode miners used finely-crafted picks, and I imagine some of them are still there in the depths of the mine. Could you retrieve some for me, and I'll see if I can repurpose the steel?
91732.offerRewardText: Oh, very nice. Do you see that shine? Truly, they don't make them like they used to.
91732.requestItemsText: Have you been to the mine yet?

91733.title: Downstream
91733.details: I was bringing back a supply shipment from the trading post, but my wagon tipped over and the supplies fell in the river! Before I could catch them, they had already washed downstream. Between the murlocs and wolves down there, I don't stand a chance of retrieving the supplies on my own. You seem like the hardy sort - do you think you could find them for me?
91733.offerRewardText: You look a bit damp, adventurer. Sorry about that. But thank you for retrieving the supplies.

91736.title: Applejack Still
91736.offerRewardText: The machine dispenses a clear liquid into a bottle...
91736.requestItemsText: A strong scent of apples burns your nose as you inspect the device.

91738.title: An Apple Treat
91738.offerRewardText: Do my eyes deceive me? I haven't seen a drop of Thunder Applejack in months! This should put a smile on the troops' faces. You have my thanks, champion!
91738.requestItemsText: The sergeant's eyes light up as he notices your bottle of Thunder Applejack...

91740.title: Croaky's Head
91740.details: This murloc has no doubt been terrorizing the local roads for some time. You suspect the nearby watch guards will want to know of its demise.
91740.offerRewardText: We lost two members of the watch last week to the murlocs, champion. Hopefully with their leader slain, we can start pushing them out of Elwynn.

91741.title: Nibbled-On Book
91741.details:
<One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it.

Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>
91741.offerRewardText: Hey! How did you end up with that? It's supposed to be on the shelf! Oh dear, the kobolds have been stealing my books again. They must want to eat them! Thanks for bringing back the book, but what will I do about the rest of my missing collection?
91741.requestItemsText: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.

91743.title: Rascally Rodents
91743.details: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.
91743.offerRewardText: Thank you so much! Here! Take one of these how-to books. I don't need them. But there's still so many books missing. The kobolds don't seem to be eating them. So, why do they want them?
91743.requestItemsText: Have you rescued my books yet, adventurer?!

91745.title: Mining Consultant
91745.details: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.
91745.offerRewardText: Kobolds with books? Yah, I've seen kobolds running back and forth with books, yelling at each other. They must be stealing them from the library inside the abbey.

91746.title: Elmpaw's Head
91746.details: The trophy serves as an impressive reminder of your victory over Elmpaw. A local hunter or skinner might be interested to hear the story.
91746.offerRewardText: So, you took down Elmpaw? Very impressive, adventurer! Let me give you something in return for your trophy - I know a few collectors who will pay quite well to have this on their mantle once I've prepared it.

91751.title: Rough Wolf Pelts
91751.details: Are you looking for an opportunity to practice skinning? My husband usually helps with hunting wolves, but he's busy up by the abbey. I could use a hand collecting more pelts to finish the orders I'm working on.
91751.offerRewardText: Excellent work collecting these pelts, champion. You have a real talent for hunting.
91751.requestItemsText: Any luck with those wolf pelts?

91752.title: The Big Picture
91752.details:
Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.

Go get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.
91752.offerRewardText: Thank you for returning these stolen books, adventurer. I'll get them back to Brother Paxton at once. You're becoming quite the hero around here. Great job!
91752.requestItemsText: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?

91753.title: An Enchanting Lesson
91753.details:
Academic rigor is of course essential to the enchanter's craft, but a practical foundation can pay dividends. Consider, as an example, the lowly Kobold. Lacking formal education, they nevertheless demonstrate a sort of innate aptitude for simple cantrips and enchantments.

Obtain some of their wax effigies and deconstruct the enchantments bound within them. You may find it elucidating.
91753.offerRewardText: Theory and practice are two sides of a coin, adventurer. Remember this.

91758.title: Follow That Kobold!
91758.details:
You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.

Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.
91758.offerRewardText: I can help ye' track down this varmint. Let me whip somethin' up for ye'.

91772.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds
91772.details:
Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.

Follow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

I have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.
91772.offerRewardText: What's this, adventurer? Tracking kobolds? Well, of course they're headed toward the Fargodeep mine! That place is infested with kobolds. Good work, I guess. I'm going to need someone to take care of that problem.
91772.requestItemsText: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?

91775.title: Book Return
91775.details:
While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.

Take this book bag to protect the books when you find them!
91775.offerRewardText: I applaud your diligence, adventurer. Brother Paxton sent a list of books, and you've found most of the missing ones. The rest must have been taken to the Jasperlode Mine. You can keep that book bag!
91775.requestItemsText: Have you found all the books yet?

91777.title: Rare Books
91777.details:
There's just two books left missing on Brother Paxton 's list: " Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards " and " Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words ".

The kobolds must have taken them to the Jasperlode Mine. Please track down those two books and bring them back to Brother Paxton.

But I'm afraid it will be quite dangerous. If the "apprentice" kobold was summoning an elemental, who knows what the master can do. I'd bring some friends if I were you.
91777.offerRewardText: Oh, adventurer! Thank you so much for saving my library. You've done me an amazing service. Please take one of these fine weapons. They were intended for the militia, but you can make better use of them.
91777.requestItemsText: Have you found all my missing books yet?

91858.title: Diplomatic Incident
91858.details:
A most unfortunate turn of events in Silverpine has presented a unique opportunity for us to prove our worth in the eyes of the horde.

A pair of dignitaries from the Earthen Ring went missing in Silverpine Forest en route to Tarren Mill. We don't know much else but rumors say that this is becoming quite the diplomatic incident. If we can recover these missing persons, it could help gain us the legitimacy we so dearly need.

We have a man at The Sepulcher, Trevan Rol. Travel there and speak with him.
91858.offerRewardText: Danitha sent you? Well in that case I already know why you are here. You just walked into a damned fine mess, champion.

91859.title: A Curious Pair
91859.details:
Cutting straight to it, these "dignitaries" are no ordinary diplomats. One was a Tauren. Ordinary enough for the Earthen Ring, but the other--and you'll scarcely believe this--was an elf. A *high* elf. They were cloaked, but I've seen quel'dorei before and I'd bet my good pinky finger that's what I saw.

Why was an elf accompanying a Tauren through horde territory? Well, your guess is as good as mine. That's as much as I know, so I'd suggest speaking with Deathguard Baldren near the entrance to town.
91859.offerRewardText: I might not care for you paladins, but I will say that your timing is impeccable. It's better to be lucky than good, I suppose?

91860.title: A Grim Fate
91860.details:
Out on patrol last night I spotted a group of gnolls dumping a very large body onto a pyre on the shores of Fenris Isle. I didn't see an elf or any smaller corpses, but I'd say this doesn't bode well for them.

If you are brave or stupid you are welcome to charge into Fenris Isle to learn more, but if you ask me, its a lot of work to find some snooty elf that's probably long dead.

I know you paladins love swearing oaths and taking on lost causes, but this one isn't worth it. Trust me.
91860.offerRewardText: <The corpse before you was certainly Tauren and you can tell that it was gnawed on heavily before it was tossed onto the pyre. You see no signs of the elf woman that was described to you though. Perhaps she is still alive somewhere deeper in the fortress nearby? This will be dangerous, but there's only one way to find out for sure.>

91861.title: Into Fenris Keep
91861.details: <The fact that you only found only one body is a hopeful sign. Perhaps the High Elf that Trevan and Hadrec described is still alive somewhere deeper inside the nearby fortress?>
91861.offerRewardText: You are one of the Forsaken, yes? Can you help free me? Time is short for me, I am afraid. Please hurry!

91862.title: Lumina Windsinger
91862.details:
Quel'dorei? No, I am no "quel'dorei". I am Lumina Windsinger and I am shen'dorei. One of the Windshaper Skyborne.

I came to these lands as a guest of the Earthen Ring. My companion Banon and I were passing through Silverpine to reach the Arathi Highlands so that we could study the elemental convergences there. Clearly, we didn't make it.

We have no time for this now though. Kill the gnolls nearby. Retrieve the key to this cage and free me. I will tell you the rest once we are safely away.
91862.offerRewardText: Thank you, champion. Unfortunately we aren't out of danger yet.
91862.requestItemsText: Gnolls are the second worst creatures I've encountered yet on Azeroth.

91899.title: A Sealed Crate
91899.offerRewardText: Thank you for your hard work, adventurer. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates laying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest. Here is your payment.
91899.requestItemsText: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.

91900.title: A Sealed Crate
91900.offerRewardText: Thank you for your hard work, adventurer. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates laying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest. Here is your payment.
91900.requestItemsText: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.

91901.title: A Sealed Crate
91901.offerRewardText: Thank you for your hard work, adventurer. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates laying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest. Here is your payment.
91901.requestItemsText: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.

91904.title: A Sealed Crate
91904.offerRewardText: Thank you for your hard work, adventurer. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates laying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest. Here is your payment.
91904.requestItemsText: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.

91905.title: A Sealed Crate
91905.offerRewardText: Thank you for your hard work, adventurer. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates laying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest. Here is your payment.
91905.requestItemsText: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.

91920.title: Wild Eyes
91920.details:
I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel 's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.

Along the shore of Lake Lordamere are a swarm of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.

If my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.
91920.offerRewardText: The potion didn't work? Of course it didn't work. You brought me insufficient hearts. The recipe clearly calls for six. You brought three. However, I confess I hadn't considered applications for murloc parts until now... <Renferrel takes the eyes.> I can afford to sacrifice a few of my own hearts to get your Deathstalker's strength back.

91921.title: Return to Quinn (Again)
91921.details:
Here is the new potion to aid in Quinn's recovery, made with love extracted from six whole hearts.

Now, please excuse me before your presence necessitates more paperwork.
91921.offerRewardText: <Quinn takes the potion and drinks it.> Yes, I can feel it working. I will soon be able to travel. You have done me a great favor, adventurer.
91921.requestItemsText: You return! I was beginning to come to terms with devolving into a ghoul.

92109.title: My First Alchemy Set
92109.details:
Erm... 'Ello, <mister/miss>. I'm not supposed to talk to strangers, but... Hey, what are those shiny bottles sticking out of your backpack for? Are you an alchemist? That's so cool!

When I grow up, I want to be an alchemist too. Daddy won't let me play with any of his herbs; too dangerous, he says.

Well, I want to start learning now. Could you maybe get some supplies for me, pretty please?
92109.offerRewardText: Oh my gosh! Look at these! Did you pick the herbs yourself? Wow, thanks mister, I am going to see what I can make with these right now! Do you want to watch?
92109.requestItemsText: 'Ello again! Did you bring back alchemy stuff?

92110.title: My First Real Potion
92110.details:
Wow, my very first potion! Did you know that mixing those two herbs together would change the potion to a bright red color when you first started?

That was fun, but mixing a few flowers doesn't seem like the kind of alchemy Daddy does. He uses other ingredients too.

I don't know what else to use, so let's try the first thing that comes to mind! Let's see... maybe murloc eyes? That sounds so gross, but I bet something will happen.
92110.offerRewardText: You brought me murloc eyes! I am so excited for my first REAL potion I can't breathe! I snuck out and grabbed a few more herbs while you were away and found some empty vials downstairs. Um... you can do the mixing this time. <The child watches enthusiastically you mix the ingredients, but her nose crumples as you add the eyes. The concoction takes on a sickly orange in mere seconds.> Wow! See, I was right. I wouldn't drink that, but here's my recipe if you wanted to make more. Come back sometime!
92110.requestItemsText: Don't worry about me, I'm a big girl. I can take care of myself. Just don't tell anyone I am hiding here, it's our little secret.

92124.title: Book Inventory
92124.details:
We need to take stock of how many books are missing!

Go talk to my useless assistant, Daniel. He can do a quick inventory and let us know how serious the problem is.

He's obsessed with the various trade professions in Elwynn Forest. The boy keeps focusing on those instead of his important work helping me.

Don't let him prattle on about tradeskills, and find out what's happened to my books!
92124.offerRewardText: Yah, I overheard. I warned Brother Paxton three times about the kobolds tunneling under the abbey. It looks like the kobolds have taken a lot of books. There are whole bookshelves emptied out. You should probably see what Brother Paxton wants you to do about it. While you're here, can I talk to you about tradeskills? I'd be happy to answer any questions you have, or point you toward the local trainers.

92401.title: A Frightened Request
92401.details:
It's my husband Edward...

He has not returned from his weekly journey to the graveyard in the Lordaeron ruins. Our son was lost when Arthas razed the city, and my dear Edward is still filled with guilt and sorrow that we never found his body. I've tried to warn him against searching those overrun ruins, but he refuses to give up. I try not worry, but it's been days.

There are things there I cannot contend with but if you are willing, I need to know the fate of my husband.
92401.offerRewardText: What I asked of you was not fair, nor would it have been unjust for you to simply walk away. Thank you stranger. I am unable to repay you in kind but I hope one of these is acceptable. I hope our paths cross again without such sorrow.

92415.title: Remember That I Love You
92415.details: <A torn and stained bundle of parchment has barely survived the undead trodden grounds of the graveyard. It mentions a missing child of the Heartweaver family. Perhaps the orphan matron in Stormwind City will know more.>
92415.offerRewardText: Heartweaver? Heartweaver... Oh! Little Jeremy Heartweaver. He was brought in years ago after the attack on Lordaeron. Lost both of his parents in the attack, poor thing. He was actually adopted not too long ago by a sweet woman out in Duskwood.
92415.requestItemsText: What is it, adventurer? What are you looking for?

92421.title: Light's Justice
92421.details:
As a paladin of the Forsaken, it is my duty to exact the will of our Dark Lady while tending to our people's needs. We are fortunate with an opportunity to accomplish both.

Above the Undercity, the scourge still roam unchecked in great numbers. Our forces dwindle trying to reclaim our land, and decaying flesh cannot be reknit. Not without replacements.

Would that our glorious captain Garek Bandarion still be with us, I know what he would wish. To finish what he started and heal our kin. For Lordaeron!
92421.offerRewardText: Let those who fall from the Banshee Queen's grace meet our justice! With these parts, our brothers and sisters have hope to see another day. You do Captain Bandarion proud.
92421.requestItemsText: What remains of the invading scourge? Have you managed to find suitable replacement parts?

92422.title: The Wrath of Rath'mael
92422.details:
Reports have come in from the Lordamere Overlook deep within the Ruins of Lordaeron. An unholy fog has taken over the streets and graveyard, affording the scourge up there some measure of stealth.

Our scouts indicate they're being conjured by a new power within their ranks, a necromancer known as Rath'mael. We do not have the luxury of waiting this one out, adventurer.

If you have allies, summon them and their aid to the Forsaken. Drive this creature out of our lands.
92422.offerRewardText: While I have no doubt something of his kind will be replaced, we can only hope their ranks thin in the meantime. Thank you adventurer.

92454.title: Welcome!
92454.details: Welcome to the World of Warcraft! As special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Dalia Windbreeze in Thendal Grove.  You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory. Thanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!

92460.title: Coming of Age
92460.details:
Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We've been awaiting your arrival and anticipating your much needed help here in Thendal Village. I imagine you are brimming with both nerves and excitement for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.

<Ailee smiles kindly.>

Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.
92460.offerRewardText: Gale's greetings, adventurer. I am honored to bestow your coming of age relic today as you are recognized for the potential you bring to the shen'dorei. Our people have faced great hardship and persecution in our complex history. Today you are given this relic which is one of many held by those before you. Someday when your ashes are scattered to the winds it will pass to another to continue our tradition. As you take this relic with you know that the winds of home will be with you wherever you travel.

92461.title: Harmony in Balance
92461.details:
We live in times of great uncertainty for our people. We face unprecedented challenges that may require bold solutions, but we also must contend with the ordinary and mundane here in Thendal Grove. Take, for example, the recent unsustainable rise in the vuldren population.

The vuldren are a vital part of our ecosystem. However, imbalances must be corrected to maintain the delicate harmony that all creatures in Thendal Grove share.

Head east and cull some of the vuldren there.
92461.offerRewardText: Thank you for your service to Zephras, young champion. The vuldren are typically quite docile, but the animals that call Zephras home can sense when the magic on the winds is out of balance, which can lead to dangerous and unpredictable behavior if left unchecked.

92462.title: Infestation Investigation
92462.details:
One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove.

Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.
92462.offerRewardText: Judging by the amount of bug entrails covering you, this must be quite the infestation.
92462.requestItemsText: Such pests cannot be allowed to find root in our peaceful grove. An infestation can quickly grow dangerous if left unchecked.

92463.title: The Cirrusfly Queen
92463.details:
If the forest is as thick with these insects as it sounds, simply killing the workers won't be enough.

Go deeper into the forest and find the queen. She'll be close to the hive and surrounded by bigger and more aggressive soldiers, so be careful.

Put her down and return here when it's done. That'll be one less problem to think about around here.
92463.offerRewardText: Excellent work, adventurer. You'd make a fine ranger if this whole "adventurer" thing doesn't work out for you.
92463.requestItemsText: Cirrusflies aren't to be underestimated. They might not seem dangerous, but you have to watch out for the bigger ones. The bigger they are, the meaner!

92464.title: Elemental Unrest
92464.details:
Ever since our elemental benefactors left us, it seems that we are simply moving from one unrest to another. The problem we face now is that the manifestations of the winds near the standing stones to the northeast are agitated.

Not truly self-aware like the sentient wind spirits that once lived here, these simple sprites respond in kind to forces, emotions, and intentions of the creatures around them.

My apprentice Yala Windwatcher went to observe them. Seek her out and discover what she's learned.
92464.offerRewardText: Rorian sent you? Good. I could use your aid.

92465.title: Agitators
92465.details:
The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.

Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove.

Will you lend me your aid, champion?
92465.offerRewardText: It pains me to shed shen'dorei blood here in the grove, but we do what we must.

92466.title: Call of Earth
92466.details:
While we owe much of our prosperity to the elements of wind, the path we walk requires that we obey the call of all four of the primary elements and undertake a trial for each. Before you begin your first trial in earnest however, you must prove the strength of your resolve.

Travel to the standing stones to the east. A force of Al'Aketh converts has been spotted there and they must be driven off. Confront the cultists there and bring me one of their signets as proof of your deeds.
92466.offerRewardText: You have returned and brought what I have requested and thus your grit and determination are unquestionable. You are ready for the next step, adventurer.
92466.requestItemsText: The Al'Aketh cult represents the most direct and urgent danger to our homeland. Their increasingly extremist actions have destabilized our society and damaged our already-weakened connection to the spirits of the four winds. The elements demand action to prove our resilience and resolve, which are traits that are endemic to the domain of the element of earth.

92467.title: Call of Earth
92467.details: A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the strong willed to see the elements as no one else can. Your spirit will be connected to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few shaman know the recipe. The sapta is always drunk in a sacred place, and never anywhere else--remember that. Seek out the Rise of Spirits up the pass northeast of here. Drink your sapta there, and... well, you will see what you need see.
92467.offerRewardText: Ah... adventurer... child of the four winds... You seek understanding. You seek answers. Why have the winds left you? How may you get them back? These are answers I cannot provide, for I do not know the motives or movements of the winds. I can, however, teach you much of the earth. Its strength, its resolve. Even here, high in this endless sea of clouds, you are still a creature of the earth. If you hope to find the strength to speak to the spirits of the four winds once more, this is the path you must walk.

92468.title: Call of Earth
92468.details: Take this Rough Quartz from me and bring it to the one you call Windshaper Boro as proof of our meeting. He will craft a totem for you, and this shard will be the heart of it. As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast many others. Be patient, adventurer. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what the elements ask of you. In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.
92468.offerRewardText: Good! The totem I will craft for you is more than a symbol of your status among champion--it has abilities beyond that. One use of the totem is as a focus for spells. Those spells are tied to the earth, and as you earn greater and greater wisdom, more of the earth's abilities will be made accessible to you. The trainers will know when you are ready for greater knowledge. But for now, take this earth totem...
92468.requestItemsText: As you will come to learn, the path we walk is not as simple as it may seem. While we seek to find the voice needed to speak with the spirits of the winds, the winds are but one of the elemental forces of this world. Only through understanding, and--we hope--mastery of all four elements will we regain our voice to again sing the songs of the wind.

92469.title: Return to Rorian
92469.details:
You've done enough here, champion. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.

Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.
92469.offerRewardText: This is most troubling, but unfortunately unsurprising. We've been aware of the cult's movements for some time, but we've been content to watch from afar. Their agitation of the wind spirits near the standing stones is a clear escalation on their part. You've performed a difficult but necessary service for Thendal Grove, adventurer. Thank you.

92470.title: Foul Matriarch
92470.details:
Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.
