Many skyborne love to adorn their hair with vibrant plumes and the down feathers of a hippogryph are exceptionally vibrant and more importantly, silky soft.

If you are heading that way, try and gather as many of the fallen feathers as you can from in and around their nesting grounds. Do be careful, as wild hippogryph are not tolerant of guests.
93951.offerRewardText: It might seem a bit of a vain triviality, gathering feathers for our hair. However, even in times like these, one needs to embrace the small joys as much as possible. If one thing I create brings someone joy, then I will consider that to be a good day. Thank you for bringing me these and helping me bring some joy to Zephras.
93951.requestItemsText: What beautiful things did you bring me?

93958.title: The Inner Sanctum
93958.details:
Valennia's forces just breached the inner sanctum. The fighting was thick in there at first, but it's grown... unsettlingly quiet. Go in there and do your best to link up with Valennia and her forces... if any of them are left.

I'll stay here and watch your back.

93963.title: Exploring the Alliance
93963.details:
Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus all have unique peoples and cultures. As a guest of the Alliance here on Azeroth, you should take some time to visit each of our capital cities in turn.

Speak with Randal Emerson in the southern antechamber for directions to get you started.
93963.offerRewardText: Ah, you are back. I hope your adventures have given you a sense of the scale and wonder of our world. I know it must seem overwhelming to you, but if you are to help your people, you must be prepared for whatever may come your way while you are on Azeroth. While you wait for your order to establish itself in Dalaran, I suggest you turn your attention to the lands around Stormwind. Westfall in particular can always use more strong adventurers to lend them aid, if you are willing.

94003.title: The Skybreaker Bulwark
94003.details:
I am all that remains of the line of Skybreakers here on Zephras Isle. The rest were murdered by the Al'Aketh.

The only thing that outweighs my sorrow is my shame. My family's ancestral shield--the Skybreaker Bulwark --is now in the hands of a cultist named Zaal Stormshield. Family lore holds no harm may befall a worthy wielder of this shield.

Zaal is not worthy, of that I am sure. Find this man at the Shrine of Akir and reclaim my shield from him. Do this and I will teach you the Skybreaker Defense.
94003.offerRewardText: You have done what I could not and restored my family honor. For this, I will bestow a gift that few on Zephras are worthy to receive. I will teach out the secrets of the Skybreaker Defense. Also, you will need a shield to put what I have to teach you into practice. Please, take this one. I have little use for it now that the Skybreaker Bulwark has been returned to me. Banu'Adoraah, friend.

94004.title: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Ogre's Strength
94004.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Elixir of Ogre's Strength, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94004.offerRewardText: You brought da elixir!! T'anks, friend. You come all this way to help Sos'mol. No ogre ever done that before. Sos'mol will remember this. Pay you back someday. Me promise.

94006.title: The Great Ursera Spirit
94006.details:
Greetings, adventurer. You have progressed in your druidic studies far enough that I think it is time for you to meet one of the great spirits that reside here on Zephras. Urs'endris is a wise and noble spirit, who has taught druids how to take on the ursera shape for generations. Unfortunately his domain has begun to wither and fall into the sky like many other areas of Zephras.

To find him, travel northeast near the waterfall in the shadow of the Shrine of Akir. He should be able to instruct you further.
94006.offerRewardText: So, you wish to embrace the way of the claw, child? Very well. Let us speak.

94007.title: Taming the Beast
94007.details:
Now that you've gained a level of comfort in the wilds of the highlands, I believe it is time for you to seek your very own animal companion.

Go to the port of Valanaar to the southeast, and speak with Quel'ana Quickgale there. He will instruct you in the art of beast taming.
94007.offerRewardText: I am most glad that you came. Come, let us begin.

94013.title: Taming the Beast
94013.details:
You've returned triumphant from taming two beasts, it's time now for your last trial. The winds of Zephras whisper of greater challenges ahead.

Take this Taming Rod and journey to the Gustberry Lowlands. There, tame a Vuldren Alpha and prove your mastery.

Complete this lesson and you'll be ready to learn the deeper ways of the hunter.
94013.offerRewardText: Excellent, adventurer! You are quite a fast learner. Now that you know the basics, I can teach you how to forge a lasting bond with an animal companion. Go with this knowledge and thrive. Be the champion that Zephras Isle needs you to be.
94013.requestItemsText: You will learn, adventurer, and one day you will be a great champion.

94050.title: Training the Beast
94050.details:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than my sister, Quel'dora. She will give you the ability to train your new pet.

Go with the winds, young champion.
94050.offerRewardText: A fledgling champion, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle. Remember, adventurer, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.

94212.title: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Wisdom
94212.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Elixir of Wisdom, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94212.offerRewardText: I will admit, I expected the treacherous winds of the highlands to tear that letter to shreds. I had not imagined that someone would see my humble request, let alone deliver it straight to me. Your efforts are kind and admirable, friend. I will use this to aid my meditation. Feel free to stay and share a tale or two of your travels. I enjoy the company.
94212.requestItemsText: Come, warm yourself by the fire.

94213.title: Craftsman's Writ: Lesser Mana Potion
94213.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Lesser Mana Potion, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94213.offerRewardText: Ah, is this the potion I requested? <The elven woman respectfully takes the vial from you.> Your arrival is timely, and generosity deeply appreciated. I accept this, and offer you a small token of my gratitude. Thank you, may we meet again.
94213.requestItemsText: Good day, friend. I appreciate the company but my attention is elsewhere. If we do not have business, please be on your way.

94214.title: Craftsman's Writ: Shadow Protection Potion
94214.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Shadow Protection Potion, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>

94215.title: Craftsman's Writ: Free Action Potion
94215.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Free Action Potion, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94215.offerRewardText: <You waste little time offering the wiggling mass the Free Action Potion that was requested. It seems either unaware of your presence, or unable to claim the item. A handful of coins are scattered just beside the cocoon. You may decide to leave the potion there, and take the coins for yourself. Nature will surely sort itself out, in that case.>
94215.requestItemsText: <You approach a thrashing creature clearly trapped in spider silk, exactly where the writ marked on the map.>

94216.title: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Lesser Agility
94216.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Elixir of Lesser Agility, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94216.offerRewardText: <Ziz continues to talk in a hushed tone.> I'm not about to give you the whole spiel about how I got into this position, but here's some advice for you. Sometimes, all you gotta do to impress your new boss is take credit for someone else's work. So you're going to hand over the elixir, and I am gonna talk about how much blood, sweat, and tears I poured into making it. It's a new gig, okay? I need to make a good first impression!
94216.requestItemsText: Are you here about... <Ziz looks around his tiny hut suspiciously, and lowers his voice.> The elixir?

94217.title: Craftsman's Writ: Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir
94217.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94217.offerRewardText: Exactly what Short John Mithril ordered! Here's ye' coin. I'd keep it clutched to your chest as ye' scuttle out of here, the arena combatants thirst for riches as much as they thirst for blood!
94217.requestItemsText: Yarr, you be bringin' me my elixir?

94218.title: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Defense
94218.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Elixir of Defense, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>

94219.title: Craftsman's Writ: Draught of Water Breathing
94219.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Draught of Water Breathing, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>

94220.title: Craftsman's Writ: Pearl-Handled Dagger
94220.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Pearl-Handled Dagger, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94220.offerRewardText: Oh, you are delivering my dagger? Hah, I suppose my threat rang quite hollow then, hm? I must stay on high alert given my duties here, and especially with oth-- ahem, the foul Syndicate roaming about elsewhere here. Would you be so kind as to part with the blade, now? I must get back to my task.
94220.requestItemsText: It is unwise to sneak up on me, friend. Speak quickly, and speak quietly.

94221.title: Craftsman's Writ: Golden Rod
94221.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Golden Rod, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94221.offerRewardText: Ah, the Golden Rod I requested. I never expected it to arrive. I was considering going back to Ironforge to purchase one off the auction house. You saved me a trip, something these old feet greatly thank you for. I do not yet know how I can use this to commune with the Binding Stones, let alone if I even can, but I suspect this brings me one step closer. In the worst case, well, I am happy to have a new cane.
94221.requestItemsText: <The dwarf seems to be in a deep state of meditation, though your approach interrupted his focus. Fortunately, a smile greets you.>

94222.title: Craftsman's Writ: Iridescent Hammer
94222.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Iridescent Hammer, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>

94223.title: Craftsman's Writ: Silver Skeleton Key
94223.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Silver Skeleton Key, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94223.offerRewardText: <With the undead hordes endlessly gathering nearby and no sign of others, you choose to make use of your Silver Skeleton Key to effortlessly open the chest. Despite the claims of impressive riches, the trunk is nearly empty. At the very least there is enough present to cover some of the cost of this ordeal.>
94223.requestItemsText: <After following the instructions on the writ, you find yourself deep in a crypt surrounded by undead. There is a note on a nearby trunk.> Whomever first reads this will be the first to learn of my death. I am a mere caretaker of the Raven Hill Cemetery, whose presence is largely forgotten by even his employers at Darkshire. I have no heir with which to bestow my vast wealth unto. I have since stashed them away, in this box, for who or whatever manages to open it.

94224.title: Craftsman's Writ: Heavy Bronze Mace
94224.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Heavy Bronze Mace, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94224.offerRewardText: Whoa. You came well prepared! Hope that mace is for me, unless you plan to do ALL of the fighting.
94224.requestItemsText: Shh. Keep your voice down. I'm not ready for a fight, yet.

94225.title: Craftsman's Writ: Rough Bronze Leggings
94225.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Rough Bronze Leggings, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94225.offerRewardText: These are the leggings I ordered, huh? "Three to five business days," they said. More like three to five business MONTHS! I submitted this when I was working for the Venture Co out there, and let me just say, that partnership is well over with, so we can consider this order expired. Why aren't you leaving yet? Ugh, fine! Here's your payment.

94226.title: Craftsman's Writ: Green Iron Gauntlets
94226.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Green Iron Gauntlets, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>

94227.title: Craftsman's Writ: Big Bronze Knife
94227.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Big Bronze Knife, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94227.offerRewardText: Cluck? CLUCK CLUCK! BWOK! <The chicken glares menacingly toward Magus Tirth from afar, newly acquired blade in beak.>
94227.requestItemsText: <The chicken... clears its throat?> Cluck, cluck.

94228.title: Craftsman's Writ: Green Iron Boots
94228.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Green Iron Boots, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94228.offerRewardText: At last! I've been stomping around the wetlands with soggy feet for days! Hopefully these aren't prone to rusting either. I trust you know what you're doing.
94228.requestItemsText: Please tell me you're the one with the boots...

94229.title: Craftsman's Writ: Ornate Spyglass
94229.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Ornate Spyglass, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94229.offerRewardText: Oh. Oh! You're the engineer? I suppose at the very least you are the delivery boy in any case. Please hand over the spyglass. I have little time and many things to inspect.
94229.requestItemsText: Whoa! I almost didn't see you there. I might have seen you coming sooner if a damned engineer would at last deliver my order.

94230.title: Craftsman's Writ: Explosive Sheep
94230.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Explosive Sheep, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>

94231.title: Craftsman's Writ: Moonsight Rifle
94231.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Moonsight Rifle, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94231.offerRewardText: Ohoho, I take it back. Look at this beautiful boomstick. I bet it'll knock a satyr's head clean off. Thanks pal, now step aside or you're going to get caught in the crossfire.
94231.requestItemsText: Hey, HEY, man, haven't you heard of a little thing called "subtlety"? Spell it out with me, S-U-B...LETY. You're going to blow my cover!

94232.title: Craftsman's Writ: Minor Recombobulator
94232.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Minor Recombobulator, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>

94233.title: Craftsman's Writ: Practice Lock
94233.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Practice Lock, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94233.offerRewardText: Ahh, my practice lock has arrived. The Syndicate here have been plotting to turn this place into a prison like it once was. I already know that at least one orc is currently being held here. Maybe more. I don't intend to be another, but I intend to be more prepared than the last time if they catch me off guard.
94233.requestItemsText: I watched this whole place get burned to the ground and that keep toppled over. It was glorious. Never expected a group of bandits try to use this place as a base of operations.

94234.title: Craftsman's Writ: Shadow Goggles
94234.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Shadow Goggles, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94234.offerRewardText: My new shadow goggles! <Without another word, the goblin tossed a handful of coins your way with one hand while the other swiped the item out of your grasp. The transaction was completed and his attention lost before you had a moment to process what happened.>

94235.title: Craftsman's Writ: Gnomish Universal Remote
94235.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Gnomish Universal Remote, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94235.offerRewardText: Seems we are in luck, the remote has arrived! Looks like you precalibrated it for us which, I'll admit, isn't ideal for this scenario. I should be able to reverse engineer it in no time. Then maybe, hopefully, I'll be able to take a much needed break. Feels like I've been stuck fumbling with this teleporter's controls for months on end!
94235.requestItemsText: Careful where you walk, Gizmo! This thing likes to activate when you least expect it, and we don't quite have a handle on where it can take you when we aren't actively manning the controls.

94236.title: Craftsman's Writ: Big Bronze Bomb
94236.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Big Bronze Bomb, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94236.offerRewardText: Hey, there's the bomb I ordered! Well, one of them anyway. I needed a variety pack! You know, enough so I can test each one for effectiveness AND have a few leftover for my own needs! Well, whatever. Here's a cut of your cut, I'll give you the rest when you bring ME my full order!

94237.title: Craftsman's Writ: Crafted Solid Shot
94237.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Crafted Solid Shot, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>

94238.title: Craftsman's Writ: Heavy Leather Ball

94239.offerRewardText: Oh! The pants? Ah, I realized shortly after writing this that I needed a full set of clothes - new overalls included. If it will get you out of my hair, I suppose I should honor the request. After all, you did make an arduous journey to find me. Take this, now please... <She gestured in a polite but firm shooing motion.>
94239.requestItemsText: Move along, please, and try not to draw attention to us.

94241.offerRewardText: Oh your timing is impeccable! Callahan! Your new shirt arrived. Hurry up and change so I can stop hearing about how itchy you are all the time. And for you, friend. Here is your payment. Before you wander off, you should take a look at my wares now that you can afford 'em!

94243.offerRewardText: I--Hmm. I don't remember why I ordered this. <Ziz shrugs and tosses the quiver into a nearby pile of junk.>

94244.title: Craftsman's Writ: Dark Leather Shoulders
94244.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Dark Leather Shoulders, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94244.offerRewardText: Thar be me shoulderpads, at last! Ever had one of these squakers perch on your shoulder? Bet ye' haven't! Their claws, they hurt! Now they got a place to rest all day, and you have a heavier coinpurse! <Narkk eyes said coinpurse.> For now!
94244.requestItemsText: Yarr, what business do ye' have with ol' Narkk?

94247.offerRewardText: <Alan speaks in a whisper.> Don't you think it is a little suspicious to be carrying elegant robes in broad daylight to a man garbed in dark leathers? Well, ahem, fortunately I am out here on behalf of the Kirin Tor, so there is no shady transaction about to take place. None at all. The robe, please.
94247.requestItemsText: <The man stands at attention, peering over the mountainside toward Dalaran. He regards your presence with a subtle wave of a hand, beckoning you closer.>

94248.title: Craftsman's Writ: Blue Overalls

94248.requestItemsText: Oh! Please keep your voice down, we don't need to draw any further attention to ourselves. Do you have something for me?

94249.title: Craftsman's Writ: Azure Silk Hood

94249.offerRewardText: It da hood me order-er-ed! Me forgot why wanted in first place, but me take anyway. Here, take shiny coin. It fell out of slime monster. Lots and lots of them!
94249.requestItemsText: AHHHH! Oh, it just a friend. Hi friend!

94250.title: Craftsman's Writ: Small Silk Pack
94250.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Small Silk Pack, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94250.offerRewardText: Ha ha! Thanks, pal. I owe you. <Kzixx reaches into a Small Silk Pack already in his possession, filled to the brim with coin, and pulls out a fist full. He counts out a tiny fraction of his total wealth, and hands it to you.> This should cover it. No take-backs!
94250.requestItemsText: Yo! Is that pack for me?

94369.title: The Fate of Zephras
94369.details:
Ansirem has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir now that the wards that have hidden Zephras are down. If the Windlord chooses to attack us, we stand no chance to defend ourselves while we are here in his domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.
94369.offerRewardText: <Talaanis Shadowsong listens intently as you tell him of what transpired above the Shrine of Akir, and of Elaadrin's plan to leave Zephras Isle.> I need to reflect on this further, but looking at the upside, we have rid ourselves of Lorthuna and deprived the cult of their leader. Our home has not been invaded yet, and on the timeline of elemental demigods, it could be years... decades even, before Al'Akir deigns to turn his attention to us. There is much to fear now, but much to celebrate as well.

94373.title: Call of Earth
94373.details:
Aye, the time's come, young shaman. Ye've grown stout and sturdy, like the stone beneath our boots. Takin' up the shaman's path shows ye've got the wisdom o' the mountain, even before ye've proven yerself.. Ye've the grit of stone to walk the earth's path.

But to earn its favor, ye must face it proper. South o' here, the Frostmane trolls live in a cave.

Bring me two of their necklaces they wear--crafted from the Iceclaw bears. Then we'll speak more of yer future.
94373.offerRewardText: Well done, lad. Ye've proven yerself ready. Earth's the bedrock of all things. Strength, stamina, patience. It'll shield ye, but only if ye show it proper respect. Even stone can shift if slighted. Learn its ways, and ye'll grow wiser than most. Never forget the secrets it shares. I'll craft ye a sapta now - accept it, and ye'll walk the true path.
94373.requestItemsText: Patience, lad, is the earth's finest virtue. It's seen mountains crumble and rivers carve valleys - slow and stubborn, like a true friend. The earth calls to ye now, for trouble brews on the horizon. Return successful, and ye'll be one step closer to bein' whole. Others may envy yer wisdom, but that's their burden to bear.

94374.title: Call of Earth
94374.details:
Aye, sapta's a brew forged with magic, bindin' our spirit to the elements. Only a few shaman know the recipe, and it's nae for the weak-willed. Drink it, and ye will see what others can't. Hold true--it's only to be drunk in a sacred place.

Head north to the Spirit Stone, tucked at the end of a hidden path up the mountain. Drink it there... see what the earth has to show ye.
94374.offerRewardText: Ah... adventurer... the earth welcomes you, even in this frozen land. Bound in body and spirit, you'll walk forward knowing the mountains are your strength, the plains your patience, and the world your essence. To pass this rite, stand humbly before the earth. The other elements are not so still - they clash and roar. Learn their dual nature, even here among the snow and stone.

94375.title: Call of Earth
94375.details:
Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Teo Hammerstorm as proof o' our meeting. He will craft a totem for ye, and this pebble will be the heart o' it. As small as it may seem, ye will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest o' things can outlast many others.

Be patient, adventurer. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks o' ye. In the end, ye shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect ye.
94375.offerRewardText: Well done! Know this - totems ain't just a mark of yer place among shamans. They're tools, a focus for spells tied to stone, soil, and other elements. As ye grow wiser, more o' the mountain's power will open to ye. The trainers will know when yer ready for more. But for now, take this totem, and let the ground speak through ye.
94375.requestItemsText: Ahh, ye've returned. If ye have the stone, it means the mountain's chosen ye true. I'll give ye the totem it promised. But if ye've come empty-handed, off with ye! The path ain't for those who forget their way.

94411.title: Meddlesome Mages
94411.details:
Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. Prove your resolve to us by going to the standing stones and dispersing them.

I am loathe to condone outright bloodshed, but do what you must to drive them off. Return to me when its done.
94411.offerRewardText: Direct conflict with our shen'dorei brothers and sisters only weakens us as a people, but decisive action must at times be taken to prevent greater tragedy. The mages of the High Order have zero regard for the consequences of their magical meddling. The forces that bind our island are fragile and vulnerable and all it could take is one thoughtless action to destroy our home.

94413.title: A Magical Affront
94413.details:
The recent emergence of the ley lines on the surface of Zephras has been profound for our order. We have more direct and tangible access to the energies that permeate this place and it has increased our understanding of said magic greatly.

The Windshapers, however, view these emergences as scars on the land that must be "healed". This is an affront to our order and is something we simply cannot abide.

Go to the ley line in the forest to the southwest and drive off the Windshapers you find there.
94413.offerRewardText: Sometimes I find it hard to distinguish between the blind zealotry of the Al'Aketh cult, and the stubborn refusal of the Windshapers to change. If they truly believed the winds would guide us, they should be sensing the direction the winds are blowing and flow with them rather than against them.

94414.title: The Anchors of Zephras
94414.details:
Greetings, young adventurer. I often times come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.

They suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed.

If you'd like, I can lend you my gift to look upon them yourself.
94414.offerRewardText: Thank you for taking a moment to share this with me. I will continue to watch over the grove, and ponder on the state of our homeland.
94414.requestItemsText: My gift is simple, and mundane. I cannot peer between worlds such as those with the skysight, nor can I draw upon the magic of the ley lines beneath Zephras like others can. But a gift it remains and I am grateful to have it. Appreciation of what you have is the key to happiness. Yearning for what you may have, or what you have lost, only leads to despair.

94427.title: A Lesson in Divinity
94427.details:
A key tenant of being a paladin is the pursuit of divinity. This is not the pursuit of godhood, but merely the pursuit of good itself, for good's sake. We've all arrived at this place due to tragedy of one form or another, and it would be easy to lose that grace that defined us as paladins in life.

Go to the Undercity and seek out Tanis Alderwood in the Trade Quarter. They are in need, and they could benefit greatly from some grace.
94427.offerRewardText: You... you are a champion? Please, do not hurt me. I-I know I'm not supposed to be panhandling. I have no quarrel with you or your order. Leave me be, I beg you!

94434.title: A Lesson in Divinity
94434.details:
Wait, you want to... help? Why would a paladin want to help a beggar like me?

Well, I suppose that you could be of some assistance.

Its my wife you see. She, well... she's falling apart. I mean that literally. The apothecaries can stitch her back together right as rain, but they are about the Dark Lady's business and none are available to help. If you could perhaps bring me some fresh cloth then I could at least make her a wrapping to hold her together while we wait for the apothecaries.
94434.offerRewardText: This is very kind of you, champion. Very kind indeed.
94434.requestItemsText: I hope that this is no imposition upon you, goodly champion.

94435.title: A Lesson in Divinity
94435.details: I don't know why you'd go out of your way to help me, but I appreciate it. If someone sent you my way, tell them I appreciate them too. You'll always have a friend in Tanis Alderwood, champion.
94435.offerRewardText: You have done well, adventurer. It was a small thing, but even small acts of service such as this may help strengthen our connection to the light. The Dark Lady and many in her service mistrust us. Some even conspire against us, but we will visit their skepticism and fear with courage and righteousness. We will show them that we are members of the Forsaken and we are willing to do our part, be it large or small, to help our people prosper once again. Take this symbol, you will need it for what comes next.

94436.title: A Lesson in Divinity
94436.details:
It's time to demonstrate your ability to channel one of the light's greatest gifts.

The item I just gave you is called the Symbol of Life. Take care, as it may cause you some discomfort to handle a talisman of the light such as this. The light may be anathema to the force that created us, but it is still our guide and ally. The pain reminds us of this.

Go see Deathguard Billmuth downstairs. He just arrived and he has petitioned us for aid. Show him and the Forsaken what a true paladin can do.
94436.offerRewardText: So you'll help me, then? Good, good. I'll admit I'm not proud of resorting to... well, resorting to asking paladins for aid. The priests waved me away and you might be my friend's only chance. Please, help me.

94438.title: A Lesson in Divinity
94438.details:
Falgan and I were sent on a mission to scout out scarlet activity in Venomweb Vale. We managed to sneak close enough to one of their camps to hear about new orders involving an attack on Brill. Before we could decide what to do next, I stepped on a twig and the noise alerted them to us.

Falgan yelled at me to run, so I ran. By the time I realized he wasn't with me, I was halfway to Brill. That brave idiot probably stayed behind to hold them off for me.

Please, find my friend and help him if you can.
94438.offerRewardText: I'm... back? And saved by a champion no less? I see you carry a Symbol of Life. I've not seen one of those since... well, since before the war when Lordaeron was a very different place. I can only assume you are here to help. Billmuth and I were sent here to scout out the scarlet activity here, and we found out that they are planning some kind of attack. If you would be willing to help more, there may yet be more than you can do to help the Forsaken.

94440.title: A Lesson in Divinity
94440.details:
These Scarlet Crusaders often carry satchels with their deployment orders. We know an attack is coming, but if we can recover their orders, we can warn the rest of the Deathguard and prepare an ambush.

You are clearly an impressive paladin. Kill these scarlet animals and retrieve a copy of their orders and bring them back to Deathguard Billmuth. He'll take it from there.
94440.offerRewardText: Thank you for saving my friend,adventurer. I will take these plans back to my commander and we will give those crusaders a welcoming they won't forget. I know that many among our people mistrust you paladins, but its clear to me that you are Forsaken through and through. I won't forget this, and I'll make sure others know of what you did here today.

94441.title: A Lesson in Divinity
94441.details:
Please give my thanks to Danitha Morr and tell her that the rest of the Deathguard will hear about the service that the paladins of Tyr's Watch performed for us.

You have a lot of promise as a paladin, and I am proud to have those like you among the ranks of the Forsaken. Dark Lady watch over you, adventurer.
94441.offerRewardText: The Symbol of Life is only able to be used by a champion who is ready to make use of one of the light's greatest blessings. I'm proud to count you among us, and I now bestow upon you the gift of redemption. With this you will be able to resurrect your fallen companions. Use this new boon wisely. You have done well for both the Forsaken as well as the paladins of Tyr's Watch. Any steps we can take to win the hearts and minds of our fellow Forsaken is well worth the effort. Go with the light, adventurer.

94449.title: Call of Fire
94449.details:
It's been long since ye were last tested, adventurer. Ye've shown patience, aye -- but now it's time ye learned of chaos... of destruction. Fire's call is loud, and if ye're ready to pay its price, it'll speak to ye.

Seek out Bruegs Kindleborn, far east in the mountains. He dwells in a cave above South Gate Outpost. He'll know if ye're truly ready.
94449.offerRewardText: Hmm... that elder sent ye, eh? Well, a champion's word is solid, so I'll not argue. That means ye're ready for the next sapta. The sapta of fire. I see it in yer eyes already -- the burnin', the hunger. Ye've tasted power, and now ye want more. But mind yerself, adventurer. Remember what the stone taught ye. Fire's easy to wield, but harder to master. Know when to hold back.

94465.title: Call of Fire
94465.details:
Aye, ye've the strength to bear the totem o' fire, lad--but strength alone won't make ye ready.

Beyond the Valley o' Kings, in the crags of Loch Modan, lies a hidden path to one o' our sacred peaks. There, Braldir Ashmantle guards the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame.

Take this torch to him--it shows yer intent. Return it burnin' by the shrine's brazier, and I'll see ye earn the totem proper.
94465.offerRewardText: Ah, me apologies, adventurer. Didn't spot the Torch in yer hand. An honor to meet ye proper. Many a wanderer climbs these heights chasin' tales of treasure or beasts, only to find naught but stone and silence. But we know better, don't we, adventurer? This shrine holds truths far deeper than the Alliance can fathom. To us, it's a sacred flame that waits to be awakened.
94465.requestItemsText: Greetin's, adventurer. Ye've made it to the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame, eh? Not many do. Only those well-versed in the champion's path can grasp the secrets this place holds. Shame ye came all this way just to be turned back--the climb's no stroll through Dun Morogh. But I'm the shrine's keeper, and I won't be lettin' just any foot trod about.

94466.title: Call of Fire
94466.details:
Bah, ye didn't trek all this way for tales, did ye, adventurer? Ye seek the Eternal Flame and the fire totem.

First, ye'll need a sapta to bind yer spirit to the flame.

I'll craft it--but I'll need two things: fire tar from Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north, and a reagent pouch from a Stonesplinter Seer lurkin' in the southern hills. Dangerous work, but worthy of the flame.
94466.offerRewardText: These'll do fine, adventurer. Fire ain't just fury and ruin--mark me words. It's life, it's forge, it's the breath o' creation. All things are bound in balance. One force tempers the other, gives it meaning. Without shadow, light's but a glare. Without flame, stone's but cold memory. Masterin' magic means knowin' when to blend, not just burn. That's true wisdom, lad.
94466.requestItemsText: Aye, I've near all I need for the fire sapta, adventurer--just missin' the fire tar and the seer's pouch. The tar's carried by Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north. The pouch ye'll need to wrest from a Stonesplinter seer in the southern hills. These ingredients are bound to flame, as all true saptas must be. Their elemental ties make our craft strong.

94467.title: Call of Fire
94467.details: The fire sapta 's ready, adventurer. Now ye face the flame. Use it at the shrine, then climb to the peak. There, ye'll see the spirit--he'll not strike 'til ye do, but he'll know ye see him. Strike fast, lad. The longer ye wait, the stronger he burns. When he falls, take his glowing embers and place 'em in the brazier. Light the torch and earn the fire's favor.
94467.offerRewardText: A white hot flame ignites within the bowl as you place the ember within. You can feel the magical effects of the sapta coursing through your body and the fire dances rhythmically before you. You place the top of the torch within the basin, and it immediately catches on fire. The smoke seems to drift towards the mountain of blackrock.
94467.requestItemsText: The brazier stands about a third your height, with charred inscriptions along its smooth metal rails. The metal shows no signs of wear from the weather, and the bowl seated at the top of it feels cool to the touch. Blackrock mountain looms in the distance, in clear view to honor from this sacred place.

94468.title: Call of Fire
94468.details: Torch firmly in hand, you turn away from the brazier and look out over Loch Modan. You feel an excitement tugging at your spirit as the wind picks up and forces the flame to dance violently. You start off down the path back to Dun Morogh in search of Bruegs Kindleborn.
94468.offerRewardText: By Madoran's beard, yer spirit burns brighter than any torch I've laid eyes on, adventurer--and that's somethin' to be proud of. Keep walkin' this path, and the elements'll bend to yer will. Our kin will come to ye for wisdom and guidance. So let me be the first to offer me hearty congratulations -- and present ye with yer newest totem. Ye've earned it, flameborn.
94468.requestItemsText: Aye, adventurer? What do ye have there?

94472.title: Earth Sapta
94472.offerRewardText: Take this and remember, it is sacred.

94473.title: Fire Sapta
94473.offerRewardText: May fire burn within your heart, Ukko. The elements await you.

94484.title: Unnerving Silence
94484.details:
A moment, if you will adventurer. Are you headed towards Shadowgale Forest? There is a druid conclave there in a cave to the northeast. I have been waiting on word from them but their correspondence is long overdue.

With Ban'aethall in ruins and all the unrest lately I worry something dire may have happened. Please, if you are able go, seek out Elegael Thornpaw and put my mind at ease.
94484.offerRewardText: Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent? <Elegael pales as you relay your conversation with Lotheluum.> So the message did not get through. We are in dire straights indeed then. It seems we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.

94485.title: Tears of the Lady
94485.details:
If we are to save my fellows in the Nightclaw Den, I am going to need some ingredients for a poultice. The first and most important is a spindly moss called Lady's Tear. It typically grows on the base of the trees here in Shadowgale.

This moss secretes a sticky substance that acts as an antiseptic and is perfect for binding open wounds. I have gathered what little I can reach but I know there is more in this forest.

Go and be swift. We are going to need a lot if the injured I left behind still live.
94485.offerRewardText: <Elegael takes the sticky mound of moss from you with a weak smile.> Thank you, adventurer, you have done well. This is exactly what we need.
94485.requestItemsText: Have you found the Lady's Tear?

94486.title: Feathers for Binding
94486.details:
The other ingredient I need for the poultice is feathers from the Shadowgale shrieklings that roam this forest. In their juvenile form, the shrieklings have insulative feathers which would be ideal to put over the moss. These feathers will prevent the antiseptic sap from drying out and will provide at least some protection against the elements.

Be warned, the shrieklings are normally docile but they have been incredibly hostile of late. Their large talons can easily disembowel you if you aren't careful.
94486.offerRewardText: Thank you for these. I will be sure to use every feather so their sacrifice will not be in vain.
94486.requestItemsText: It deeply saddens me to ask you to kill the young shrieklings, but with the rise in their aggression it is for the best. We can only handle so many emergencies at a time.

94487.title: Unwanted and Unworthy
94487.details:
The Al'aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds in-between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any.

<Elegael spits.>

These storm cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.
94487.offerRewardText: <Elegael looks down at the collection of bloodied heirlooms with distress.> So many young lives with so much potential now gone forever. Thank you for returning these, champion. I will hold onto them for safe keeping until I am able to take them to the High Elder. There they can go back into the collection and await the next and perhaps more worthy generation to come of age.
94487.requestItemsText: I will make the cult pay for every drop of druid blood they have spilled this day.

94488.title: The Ties That Bind
94488.details:
The reason for cultists presence here still baffles me, but I smell a familiar scent over the bloodshed.

One of our circle druids, Haalien, disappeared months back. It appears he's thrown his sorry hide in with the cultists.

Show him what happens when he spills the blood of his kin! Take his head and return it to me.
94488.offerRewardText: <Elegael grimaces at the severed head, but nods curtly.> Thank you, adventurer. No matter how much rage I have within me, it would have been difficult to strike down my own cousin. Do not mourn for him. His ignorance and malice has killed many innocents this day.
94488.requestItemsText: Are our brethren's lives truly worth so little to you, Haalien?

94489.title: The Wounds of Betrayal
94489.details:
I have finished the poultices. Quickly, take them to the druids in the cave, north just across the clearing. I know my brethren are in much more dire condition than I. They are likely too injured to heal their own wounds. There are so few of us shen'dorei druids that every life is precious.

Before you go, I have a selfish request. My mate, Jorel Windsinger was in dire condition when I left. Please, see to his wounds if he still lives.
94489.offerRewardText: <Elegael's face pales as you relay the fate of Jorel and the condition of the rest of the druids.> No... no! This is far worse than I had-- <Elegael chokes back a sob, and grits her teeth letting out a pained snarl.> They will pay. They will ALL pay. Anyone who allies with the Al'aketh will feel my wrath! This I swear.
94489.requestItemsText: champion! You have returned. Were you able to reach my brothers and sisters? Did you find Jorel?

94490.title: Ripped Missive
94490.details: <Tucked behind one of Haalien's bracers is a note that's been slightly torn and bloodstained in your fight. It looks like it contains useful information for about the cultist motivations for the attack on the druid den. Elegael would be interested in this intel.>
94490.offerRewardText: They were here for the pylon? But to what end? We were not the original reason for their attack? <Elegael trails off shaking with rage as she reads.> They murdered my people because we were an inconvenience! I shall tear apart every cultist with my fangs! I will make sure none leave this place with their lives. Go, swiftly! If the orders truly originated in Valanaar, it means it is likely a traitor hiding there. Give the missive to Lotheluum in Valannar and tell him what has transpired.

94491.title: The Fate of the Den
94491.details:
It would appear that there is a correspondent hiding somewhere in Valanaar feeding information to the cult. I am clearly in no shape to make the journey, but Lotheluum needs to know what transpired here.

He should also know the fate of those who are no longer with us. Thanks to your help I think we can handle the rest of the situation from here, thought the damage has been done.

Please go swiftly, adventurer. I hope our paths will cross again someday. Until then, I have cultists to slay.
94491.offerRewardText: <Lotheluum wears a look of genuine terror as you recount the events from the druid den.> I--I'm sorry, adventurer. I need just a moment. There are no words I possess that can describe the loss. This is grave news indeed. If this missive is not fabricated, then we indeed have at best an accomplice and at worst a traitor here in Valanaar. I will take this to the High Elder immediately! I will not let my fellows sacrifice be in vain.

94493.title: A Sacrifice in Vain
94493.details:
Thank goodness our message got to Lotheluum. Wait, where are the rest of the reinforcements? Surely it is not just you they sent?

<Elegael pales as you explain yourself.>

So the message did not get to Valanaar. We are in dire straights indeed then.

<Elegael sighs deeply then looks resolute.>

Then we must handle this on our own. Time is of the essence.
94493.offerRewardText: The Al'aketh Cultists ambushed us with little to no warning. Many inside my den lay wounded or dying. I had attempted to send a message to Valanaar but it appears my efforts were in vain. Please, if you have come here I beg for your help. I don't know how much longer my fellows will be able to survive this onslaught.

94494.title: Call of Water
94494.details:
Long has it been since ye were last tested, adventurer. Ye have shown patience thus far in yer studies, but the time has come for ye to learn about the purity of water.

Seek out Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan. He is along the north western edge o' the lake, south of Stonewrought Dam. Ye  will find him there at his burrow hut. Good luck to ye, adventurer.
94494.offerRewardText: The wind's rushin' at yer back, the stone's firm beneath yer boots, and the fire in yer belly's burnin' bright. Aye, it's time ye learned the truth o' water's purity. Yer path's been long, but it's yer spirit that'll carry ye further still. Now, go on, take that first step. The mountain waits for no one.

94495.title: Call of Water
94495.details:
If there's one truth ye need to learn about water, it's this: water means rebirth. It carves stone, cleanses filth, and heals the weary -- but only when it's pure. Taint it, and it'll ruin all it touches.

If ye seek the water sapta, find Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands. Her family dwells in a cave beneath the southern falls.

Go on then, don't let the river outrun ye.
94495.offerRewardText: Aye, I see it in yer eyes, friend. You're wonderin' what kind o' soul chooses to live out here, deep in the Wetlands, with Dark Iron scum lurkin' about and nary a guard in sight. Well, we all have our reasons, love. But the real question is, what brings you to our home? Out here at the edge of the falls, I reckon we both know the answer to that.

94497.title: Call of Water
94497.details:
Ah, so ye've come seekin' the sapta, have ye? Well then, listen close, love. To find understandin' and earn the sapta, ye must seek water in its various forms. As ye gather the samples, keep yer eyes open. Watch the beasts that guard it, the land it nourishes, and how it changes lives.

We'll start simple: fill this skin at the base o' the falls, where the fresh meets the brackish. Go on now, and mind the marsh.
94497.offerRewardText: Glad ye managed to steer clear o' the Dark Iron. Shame they've crept so far north--makes ye wonder what dwarfkind could do if the clans ever stopped squabblin' and worked as one. Still, the tides rise high when the moons are strong, and the seawater floods the marsh. It's here that we study our estuary water. Thank ye for this sacred offering, it marks the beginning of your stage as a vessel--one who seeks the waters' wisdom.
94497.requestItemsText: I'm nearly ready to send ye off on the rest o' yer tasks. But tell me, have ye filled the skin yet? The ocean brings life, aye -- but it carries sediment, minerals, and energies far different from the snowmelt and springwater of the highlands. Where sea and spring meet, there's wisdom to be found.

94499.title: Call of Water
94499.details:
Aye, Redridge drinks deep from Lake Everstill, but by the time the waters tumble down Stonewatch Falls, somethin' has seeped in. The murlocs down there are big, twisted brutes. Not like the ones ye find here or in the Loch. Lucky for the townsfolk they keep to the base o' the falls.

Bring a sampling to me. I've a mind to find out if it's magic, venom, or somethin' worse that's taintin' the waters near that old fort.
94499.offerRewardText: Aye, this is good water, adventurer. The magic used by the shadowseers in the region must be changin' the murlocs. Nothin' but pure water, this be. Yer dedication to the task at hand and abilities to seek out that which is needed proves you're ready for the next stage of your journey. One more sample is all I need to create the reagent needed for your sapta. Norric will be pleased as well.
94499.requestItemsText: The folk o' Lakeshire don't ken how good they've got it -- fresh water flowin' right at their boots, keepin' their nets full, their crops green, and their coin purses jinglin'. Even when the kingdom's guard can barely spare a lad with a sword, they've got Everstill watchin' over 'em.

94500.title: Call of Water
94500.details:
Take this waterskin and journey deep into the emerald shade o' Ashenvale. Astranaar rests cradled by waters untouched by corruption. Ruins litter the bed o' the lake, hinting at a bygone era. Bring back a sample from the lake. Pure, ancient, and possibly enchanted water.

It's the last liquid I need before I send ye back to Norric.

Board the boat in Menethil to Auberdine, it stops in Southshore on the way over.

And mind yerself... the forest's got eyes, and they don't blink.
94500.offerRewardText: Well done, adventurer! With all three samples in hand, I'll brew ye a vial o' water so pure it'd make the mountains weep. It's the final piece for yer rite o' passage. I'm proud to call ye kin, adventurer. Ye've done champion proud, and I look forward to hearing yer tales in the future.
94500.requestItemsText: Do you have the water yet, adventurer? If ye haven't made the trek to Kalimdor yet, be careful.

94501.title: Call of Water
94501.details: Norric will have one more task for ye before rewarding ye with the water totem rites. The vial of water I've given ye is necessary for whatever that task is. Go now and find him. We shall meet again some day.
94501.offerRewardText: Ahh, water blessed by Hervdana herself, and gathered by your own hands? A gift indeed. These vials shall birth your sapta, letting you glimpse the water spirits at Stendel's Pond, near Moonbrook. The last few drops of the water have an equally important purpose... waste not even a cork stopper dampened with sacred water.
94501.requestItemsText: Hello again, adventurer. Yer looking well. What brings you back to me so soon?

94502.title: Call of Water
94502.details:
In Westfall, outside o' Moonbrook lies Stendel's Pond. Once a pure spring, now touched by dark forces. The spirits there 'ave gone silent.

Ye must face the corruption that fouls the waters. Take its bracers and the last drops o' Hervdana's potion, then place 'em on the shrine. That'll call forth a spirit, cleansed and true. Speak with it, learn what ye can.

Bring me proof the deed's done, and I'll grant ye the totem.
94502.offerRewardText: You place the bracers atop the shrine and then pour the remaining drops of Norric's potion into dry stone. You begin to incant the simple words Norric taught you and the droplets vaporize atop the stone within the bindings....
94502.requestItemsText: The shrine stands aged and forgotten, cloaked in dust and cobwebs. The pond beside it lies eerily still, its surface untouched by wind or life. Scattered along the shore are the bones of beasts once burdened by labor. The water's murky sheen raises a troubling question--has it been poisoned by the surrounding malaise, or is it the very source of it?

94503.title: Call of Water
94503.details: Light erupts as the final word leaves your lips. The hiss of water turning to mist fades into silence, and your senses reel as the corrupt spirits around you unravel, their essence scattered like ash in the wind.
94503.offerRewardText: Thanks to you. Thanks to the shamans. Corruption ebbs but life continues to wane. Up to shamans to protect life.

94505.title: Call of Water
94505.details: Take shard. Take shard and give life. Give life and understand. Understand water is life... corruption stops life. You protect and give life with water's power.
94505.offerRewardText: Aye, this is the proof I asked for, and ye've done well, adventurer. I'm proud to be the first to offer my congratulations--and yer water totem. Use it wisely, and may fortune walk beside ye. Yer next trial won't come soon, so take this time to learn. Pure water heals, aye, but its gifts go far beyond mending wounds.
94505.requestItemsText: How fared your journey to Westfall? Success there is hard to measure, but even small victories carry weight.

94568.title: The Cult's True Plans
94568.details:
The turncoat clearly was afraid of the what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.

We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.
94568.offerRewardText: We could try and send peacekeepers to directly engage the cult forces, but we would not fare well against them in open battle. We are going to need a different approach.
94568.requestItemsText: That turncoat risked everything to escape the cult and bring us this crystal...

94616.title: Water Sapta
94616.offerRewardText: Take the water sapta and find the tainted pond water in Westfall, adventurer. I have great faith in your abilities.

94638.title: Strength and Mercy
94638.details:
You have come to me in hopes of learning to take a shape of strength. I have a task for you, though it lays heavy on my heart.

My mate, Ur'endra, has lost herself to madness and has begun to attack her own kin. Without the magic of the winds, many creatures have begun to lose themselves... Ur'endra included. She makes her lair in a cave to the west of here, in the bluffs along the border between the Shen'dar Highlands and the Gustberry Lowlands.

End her suffering and I shall grant you my blessing.
94638.offerRewardText: The agony I feel over her loss is immeasurable, but it is what is necessary for the balance. You have demonstrated a resolve to persevere, even when a terrible price is asked. You have done well, champion. I shall grant you the blessing to take on the shape of my kin. Be a beacon for those that lack the strength to persevere and a defender of those in need. Go now, and embrace the way of the claw, child.
94638.requestItemsText: What I ask of you is no easy task. Take heart in your courage and return to me when the deed is done.

94773.title: Divine Grace
94773.offerRewardText: You have done the Light a great service by becoming a shining example to those who travel in these dangerous lands and beyond. Please, accept this lesson as a thanks for all you've done.

94774.title: Divine Grace
94774.details: You've caught the attention of our superiors, adventurer. They've asked you travel to the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind as soon as possible. Apparently they feel you've proven yourself already and are prepared to further your training. When you get there, find High Priestess Laurena. She will be able to guide you further. Good luck, and may the Light be with you.
94774.offerRewardText: I'm glad you've arrived, adventurer. There are many things we will have to discuss, but more importantly is your training in the ways of the Light. There are lessons all servants of the Light must learn. If you are ready, we'll begin discussing some of those now.

94775.title: Divine Grace
94775.details: Elune bless you, good friend. I hope your Light finds you and protects you well this day. One of your priests was here not long ago looking for you. He mentioned you returning to the Cathedral of Light as soon as possible to speak with High Priestess Laurena. It seems you've done well to garner such attention. I wouldn't spend too much time here--your people have need of you.

94776.title: Divine Grace
94776.details: Time's come for you to head to Stormwind, adventurer. High Priestess Laurena in the Cathedral of Light wants to speak to you. Gotta be somethin' really good or really bad for the High Priestess to want you there personally, but I'm guessin' you've only done well for yourself and it's a good thing that she wants to speak to ya. But don't waste too much time 'round here. I'd head there as soon as you can.

94777.title: Divine Grace
94777.details: Just a short time ago, one of your priests was here looking for you, friend. He said that if I were to see you, I should direct you towards the Cathedral of Light. He said it was very important, but I would not be overly concerned if I were you. His demeanor seemed positive... as though it were good news. I wouldn't take too long in making my way there if I were you. Elune be with you, good friend.

94778.title: Divine Grace
94778.details: You're needed in Stormwind, adventurer. The High Priestess there, Laurena, says it's time for you to prove you're worthy of the next level of your training. Don't waste too much time finding your way there. You can find her in the Cathedral of Light in the center of the city. Give her my regards, and prove how worthy you are of such a calling. The Light be with you, adventurer.

94779.title: Divine Grace
94779.details: Praise be to Elune, and to your Light, adventurer. About this time, many of our order learn abilities reflecting their faith in Elune. If knowledge serves me, I believe the same holds true for your order also. When your business in Darnassus is complete, I would seek out one of your High Priestesses for further training.

94792.title: Taming the Beast
94792.details:
Many hunters prefer to travel with animal companions. With a beast at your side, you will find that you can survive even the most dangerous of circumstances. As they say, everything is easier with a friend. However, obtaining an animal companion is something that must be done with care. The balance of nature is delicate, and must always be respected.

Take this Taming Rod with you to the forest. With it, you will be able to tame a Rockhide Boar and practice your skills as a hunter.
94792.offerRewardText: Excellent, adventurer! You are quite a fast learner.
94792.requestItemsText: You will learn, adventurer, and one day you will be a great champion.

94793.title: Training the Beast
94793.details:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than Isaac Chan, a lifelong woodsman. He will give you the ability to train your new pet.

Go with the winds, young champion.
94793.offerRewardText: A fledgling champion, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle. Remember, adventurer, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.

94817.title: Confounding Flash
94817.offerRewardText: You took your time arriving, adventurer. But you can be excused given your dedicated service to the Light. Please pay close attention to this lesson.

94818.title: Contingency Plan
94818.offerRewardText: Continue your service to the Light and you will become a great champion, adventurer. Maintain your vigilance and dedication! You are ready for your next lesson in service.

94819.title: Contingency Plan
94819.details: adventurer, your High Priestess Mims would have an audience with you in Ironforge. Make haste, my clever friend, your next test quickly approaches. Although I wish I could bear witness to your race's own special rites, my place is here. But may the Light go with you in your travels. Mims should still be in the Mystic Ward once you reach the city. She will be waiting.
94819.offerRewardText: Continue your service to the Light and you will become a great champion, adventurer. Maintain your vigilance and dedication! You are ready for your next lesson in service.

94820.title: Contingency Plan
94820.details: Your race is so very clever, adventurer. We are proud to call you allies. And as each day's sun sets, you and your kin grow closer to reclaiming your city, but with the burden of keeping your families safe in exile. That yearning for home must weigh heavily on you. Word came from Ironforge just recently. It asked that you return there and speak to High Priestess Mims in the Mystic Ward. I would not keep her waiting. May Elune guide your travels.

94821.title: Confounding Flash
94821.details: A priest recently visited our halls seeking you out, young friend. He said that he was on a mission to find you and that you should return to the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge as soon as possible. When you arrive, seek out High Priestess Mims --she will tell you more. The Light be with you, adventurer.
94821.offerRewardText: You took your time arriving, adventurer. But you can be excused given your dedicated service to the Light. Please pay close attention to this lesson.

94822.title: Confounding Flash
94822.details: You've caught the attention of our superiors, adventurer. They've asked you travel to the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge as soon as possible. Apparently they feel you've proven yourself already and are prepared to further your training. When you get there, find High Priestess Mims. She will be able to guide you further. Good luck, and may the Light be with you.
94822.offerRewardText: You took your time arriving, Cub. But you can be excused given your dedicated service to the Light. Please pay close attention to this lesson.

94823.title: Confounding Flash
94823.details: Elune bless you, good friend. I hope your Light finds you and protects you well this day. One of your priests was here not long ago looking for you. He mentioned you returning to the Hall of Mysteries as soon as possible to speak with High Priestess Mims. It seems you've done well to garner such attention. I wouldn't spend too much time here--your people have need of you.

94824.title: Confounding Flash
94824.details: Time's come for you to head to Stormwind, adventurer. High Priestess Mims in the Hall of Mysteries commands you to come speak with her. Gotta be somethin' really good or really bad for the High Priestess to want you there personally, but I'm guessin' you've only done well for yourself and it's a good thing that she wants to speak to ya. But don't waste too much time 'round here. I'd head there as soon as you can.
94824.offerRewardText: You took your time arriving, Papi. But you can be excused given your dedicated service to the Light. Please pay close attention to this lesson.

94825.title: Confounding Flash
94825.details: Just a short time ago, one of your priests was here looking for you, friend. He said that if I were to see you, I should direct you towards the Hall of Mysteries. He said it was very important, but I would not be overly concerned if I were you. His demeanor seemed positive... as though it were good news. I wouldn't take too long in making my way there if I were you. Elune be with you, good friend.

94826.title: Confounding Flash
94826.details: Praise be to Elune, and to your Light, adventurer. About this time, many of our order learn abilities reflecting their faith in Elune. If knowledge serves me, I believe the same holds true for your order also. When your business in Darnassus is complete, I would seek out your High Priestess for further training.

94863.title: Taming the Beast
94863.details:
You've alraedy mastered taming a boar, now it's time for the next lesson. The forest holds fiercer companions, and with care, you can earn their trust.

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Gray Forest Wolf. Remember, nature's balance must be respected. Prove your skill as a hunter once more.
94863.offerRewardText: Well done, adventurer! You're quite in tune with the beast.

94864.title: Taming the Beast
94864.details:
You've proven yourself by taming a boar and a wolf, now it's time for your final challenge. Elwynn's balance depends on respect and skill. Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Young Forest Bear. Show that you can earn the trust of even the mightiest companion.

Completing this lesson will deepen your attunement to beasts.
94864.offerRewardText: The brawn of the forest. Brave work, adventurer!
94864.requestItemsText: Go forth, adventurer, and tame the burliest of Elwynn beasts.

94896.title: Aid For The Refugees
94896.details:
You look like a capable adventurer. Do you happen to be headed towards Shadowgale Forest? Ban'aethal lies deep in the forest; that's where we're all from.

<Ealaane gestures to the other refugees.>

We've recently had to evacuate Ban'aethal, as it began to fall into the sky. It was sudden and in the middle of the night. If you are headed that way, would you please look for any belongings left behind? The forest and village are far too dangerous for us to return to now.
94896.offerRewardText: Thank you, champion, you have done a great kindness to us refugees this day. I will make sure to return these to their owners. At least it gives us a place to start over from.
94896.requestItemsText: So many of us left with nothing more than the clothes on our backs. Any belongings you might recover would be cherished.

94897.title: The Fate of a Loved One
94897.details:
If you are traveling to Ban'aethal, I have a selfish request. My love, Resaan... I believe is no longer a part of this world. He had tried to go back to get supplies even though I begged him to stay. It has been over a week already and I fear the worst.

Please, if you find him bring him home. If he has perished then I beg you to please bring me his heirloom.
94897.offerRewardText: <Ealaane's eyes well with tears.> Oh, Resaan my love. What will become of us now? There was so much... it feels as if our lives together had just started. Thank you, champion. The world is cruel to take both my home and my love from me. At least his heirloom will give me some closure.
94897.requestItemsText: Have you any news of Resaan? Please, champion, the wait is hard to endure after everything that has happened.

94898.title: Violent Winds (Temp Disabled)
94898.details:
When our home started to fall into the sky that fateful night, its as if the elements themselves were waiting to consume us. Wind spirits began appearing as we were fleeing, and to our dismay they began attacking the fleeing survivors.

We lost many villagers to the sky, but even more to the relentless anger of those wind spirits. I don't know if it was our village falling into the sky, but they are extremely dangerous.

If you are able, please put them to rest.

94911.title: Child of Nature
94911.details:
Greetings, young friend. I can see that you have much promise in the druidic arts. There is one who you may want to speak with in the city of Thunder Bluff by the name of Turak Runetotem. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, Moonglade.

You will be welcomed there, and the druids of the circle will impart their knowledge upon you.

As your people would say--go with the wind's blessing, young one. I wish you good fortune in your adventures.
94911.offerRewardText: A high elf, speaking to me... in Thunder Bluff. Will wonders never cease? Well, shaper of wind, let me join our Earthen Ring brothers and sisters in welcoming you to Azeroth. My fellow druids of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature.

94912.title: Child of Nature
94912.details:
Greetings, young champion.

Have you heard of the Cenarion Circle? I'd expect not. They are an ancient order of naturalists and practitioners of the druidic arts, much like yourself. In the city of Stormwind you'll find a night elf by the name of Sheldras Moontree. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, a place called Moonglade.

Go now. You have much to learn if you wish to save your home.
94912.offerRewardText: Greetings, fellow champion. It pleases me to meet a fellow champion from among the Skyborne, and to be among the first to welcome you to Azeroth. I think you will find that my fellow druids of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature.

94913.title: Moonglade
94913.details: All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade.  Keeper Remulos - Moonglade's guardian - keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace. As for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.
94913.offerRewardText: Ah I see that you have already mastered the form of the Bear. Good, good. You are well on your way, young champion.

94914.title: Moonglade
94914.details: All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade.  Keeper Remulos - Moonglade's guardian - keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace. As for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.
94914.offerRewardText: Ah I see that you have already mastered the form of the Bear. Good, good. You are well on your way, young champion.

94946.title: The Magical City of Dalaran
94946.details:
I had intended to be the first of us to step foot onto Azeroth, but recent events with the cult have changed my plans. As a result, I will be remaining here in Valanaar for a time. Fret not though, we have several mages awaiting our people's arrival in Dalaran. I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we set our affairs in order here. We will call upon agents such as yourself when you are needed.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.
94946.offerRewardText: Ah, you've made it. Wonderful. It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore the city. Be warned however, try not to venture too far from the safety of the city proper. As idyllic as this new land appears, it can be extremely dangerous to wander outside of Dalaran without appropriate preparation and experience.

94947.title: Welcome to Azeroth
94947.details:
Its a big world down here, and we need our people to start branching out to explore it. That's where you come in.

The Kirin Tor is a member of an "Alliance" of like-minded nations. The de-facto heart of this alliance is the city of Stormwind to the south. Elaadrin has asked me to find someone to travel to Stormwind and meet with the regent lord there, a human named Bolvar Fordragon.

When you are ready, the Kirin Tor mages have set up a special portal for the High Order to use to access Stormwind.
94947.offerRewardText: Well met, champion. I am Bolvar Fordragon, regent to the throne of Stormwind. A Kirin Tor messenger told me to expect an emissary from the High Order, and here you stand. It's been some time since a high elf has stood in this throne room, but I am glad to accept you now as a guest. On behalf of the King, I welcome you to Stormwind and give you leave to travel freely through alliance lands. Welcome to Azeroth, Skyborne.

94978.title: Taming the Beast
94978.details:
Every hunter begins by learning the bond between beast and master. This is your first challenge. In time, you'll tame creatures from every corner of the world, but for now, start with our rivers and lakes on Zephras.

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Windsong Crawler.

Show that you can earn its trust, and begin your path toward true mastery.
94978.offerRewardText: Well tamed, adventurer! You are becoming adept already.
94978.requestItemsText: You will learn, adventurer, and one day you will be a great champion.

94979.title: Taming the Beast
94979.details:
You've proven you can tame the river's crawler, now it's time to test your skill on open ground. The plains of Zephras echo with the cries of the Galestrider, a proud, winged hunter that runs like the wind.

Take this Taming Rod and seek one out. Travel to the lowlands and earn its trust.

Show you're ready for the trials yet to come.
94979.offerRewardText: You're back already! Impressive speed, adventurer!
94979.requestItemsText: You will learn, adventurer, and one day you will be a great champion.

95034.title: The Debt
95034.details:
I think you should know that it wasn't actually the Gnolls who attacked us on the road.

We were actually attacked by a giant, wolf-like creature that I now know as a "worgen". It dispatched our guards and came for me, but Banon threw himself in its path. I managed to get a spell off which startled the creature, causing it to flee, but Banon was already badly bitten. He insisted I leave him there but I refused.

We were limping back here when the gnolls found us. What came next was terrifying...
95034.offerRewardText: So now you understand. At the very end of his strength after being pierced by a dozen gnoll blades, he reared up to strike me. In that final moment we locked eyes, and I could tell he still knew who he was and that he recognized me. He knew what was happening but he had no control over himself. That was the worst part. If such a thing is possible, I will see the creature that doomed him dead so that it can never visit this horror on another living thing. I swear it upon the sky above.

95036.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade
95036.details:
Trevan tells me that the worgen are a major threat to the citizens of Silverpine Forest. Despite their strength and resilience they can be killed, but there is one in particular that just doesn't ever seem to stay dead due to unknown magic.

That's the one that attacked us. He is known as Old Fire-Eye and he is the biggest and meanest of their kind. To put him down, we'll need a special kind of weapon.

Speak with Trevan and he will supply you with a list of what is needed to forge such a weapon.
95036.offerRewardText: Now that we've got the materials we need, we just need a smith to craft the blade for us. I think I know just such a smith.
95036.requestItemsText: Trust in the light to guide your blade. However, the light needs a good blade to guide.

95041.title: Data Hoarders
95041.details:
Before we fled Gnomeregan, I made a hard copy of my family's archives. Arcanotechnical field equations, Second War submarine hull designs, Grandma Quikswitch's chili recipe... our greatest accomplishments are in those files.

It wasn't until we reached Ironforge that I found a hole in my pack! Several punch cards are gone, and without them the data's too scrambled to recover.

The cards must be buried in the snow, somewhere outside Gnomeregan. Could you find them? I know it's a long shot...
95041.offerRewardText: These cards seem a bit damp... but I can work with this! Thank you, adventurer!
95041.requestItemsText: How is the data retrieval progressing?

95042.title: Seeking the Kor Gem
95042.details:
A Forsaken paladin... here in Ashenvale? Amusing.

So you seek a Kor Gem? Unsurprising as these are sometimes employed to empower magical weapons and implements by the paladins of the alliance. Why should a fallen paladin like you be any different?

If you truly desire one of the gems, then you must head north to the ruins known as Blackfathom Deeps. The naga who still use the gems are down below. Do not go alone, champion.
95042.offerRewardText: You'll no doubt notice the corruption that permeates this gem. For your purposes, The magic needed to dispel the evil that the naga witches have infused into the gem is rather simple. A shame really, there's much one could learn from such powers.
