I don't suppose you'd be willing to abandon whatever quest caused you seek this gem, and sell it to me instead? It could prove valuable to my... academic pursuits.
95042.requestItemsText: Kor gems can be used for great acts of evil. Far be it from me to judge if your intentions are pure. It matters not to me.

95065.title: Fishin' Time
95065.details:
What a view... Best an old man can ask for.

The fish sure are bitin' now, though I'm down to my last bait. I don't suppose you have any spare fishing supplies on you? Of course not, forgive me. I get so excited at the thought of casting another line it didn't dawn on me I may be one of the few carrying supplies everywhere I go.

Would you be able to help refresh my stock? Catherine Leland has an assortment of fishing goods just west of the Trade District along the canals. Tell her old Gray sent you.
95065.offerRewardText: Great timing! Caught a big one with my last bait. Great day so far. They're really biting out here! Tell you what, since you were kind enough to keep this old man in business how about a few fish for the road?
95065.requestItemsText: Did you get the fishing supplies?

95111.title: An Underrated Talent
95111.details:
In Tarren Mill there is a weaponsmith known as Ott. By all accounts he is an unremarkable smith, selling simple blades to travelers. I purchased a sword from him myself, and when I took it to the undercity for maintenance some time later, the smiths there were surprised at its quality. They assumed it came from a well known master smith, but no, it was just Ott.

I'd like to give this orc a chance to do something truly special. Take the materials to Ott in Tarren Mill and offer him the commission.
95111.offerRewardText: Interesting. I don't think anyone has ever asked me to actually carry out a custom commission for them. Mostly I just make humble, functional weapons in my own style. It's not much, but its honest work and I don't seek accolades or glory. I'm happy to try, but why would you seek me for this? There are plenty of smiths in the Undercity that will take on custom jobs like this.
95111.requestItemsText: Are you in need of a blade, champion?

95125.title: Ott's Masterwork
95125.details:
These are some truly fine materials, champion. You honor me by allowing me to forge this blade for you and I only hope that I can live up to your expectations.

Please, stand back so that I may begin the forging process.
95125.offerRewardText: This blade is my finest work and I hope it serves you well in your travels. Thank you again for this opportunity. Aka'Magosh, friend.
95125.requestItemsText: My blade will not fail you, champion.

95126.title: The Moonsilver Blade
95126.details: Here's the blade. You said that a paladin named Trevan sent you? Please extend my thanks to him for this opportunity when you next see him. Go with honor, friend.
95126.offerRewardText: <Trevan takes the blade and inspects it carefully.> This will do nicely, adventurer. I knew that Ott had it in him to make something truly great. The only thing left now is to kill that beast. Speak with Lumina when you are ready.
95126.requestItemsText: Was Ott able to carry out the commission?

95140.title: Old Fire-Eye
95140.details:
I see that you have your weapon now, champion. I pray that it will not fail you.

The locals tell me that Old Fire-Eye hunts in a large area south of here and you can generally find him near the gates to Gilneas. Find him, and use your new blade to end him. When it is done, return and you will have the gratitude of the Windshapers.
95140.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. Banon may now rest in peace. If you would be willing to allow it, I believe that I can impart some magic upon your freshly blooded blade to infuse it with a small measure of the magic of my people. It is done. It's a small thing, and I could scarcely improve such a magnificent blade. Regardless, I will pray to the winds that it serves you well, champion.
95140.requestItemsText: Is it done? Is the beast slain?

95161.title: Remember That I Love You
95161.details:
If you're looking for Jeremy Heartweaver, your best bet is to talk to his newly adopted mother, Avette Fellwood out in Duskwood. Sweet woman. Likely needs another pair of hands for her work, but it beats staying in the orphanage.

If you see little Jeremy do be sure to tell him we're all thinking of him, won't you?
95161.offerRewardText: Oh no... It's nice of you to bring this, but I don't think Jeremy is ready to see it. Matron Nightingale said my little Jeremy hasn't spoken since the attack on Lordaeron, and I don't intend to force him now. Showing him this will only cause him more pain. Don't look at me like that. I won't hide his past from him, but he needs time to heal. I'll give this to him when he's older. Thank you for stopping by, but I think it's time you should go.

95189.title: Crest of Lordaeron
95189.details: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in Stormwind would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95189.offerRewardText: How in the world did you find this? It's in such remarkable condition... all things considered. Thank you for restoring this piece of Alliance history, champion. I'll have my best people get to work restoring this immediately.
95189.requestItemsText: Welcome to the gallery. Feel free to browse.

95195.title: Bloodied Insignia
95195.details: <The old Alliance insignia appears to have belonged to a soldier of Lordaeron. These ruins are likely filled with similar medals that living relatives would be grateful to have returned to them.>
95195.offerRewardText: Your instincts to bring these to me were not unfounded. When Lordaeron fell to the scourge, many people fled to take refuge here in Stormwind. There are likely few who remain to claim these insignias themselves. Your duty to Stormwind is commended, adventurer. I'll begin distributing these tokens to next of kin right away.
95195.requestItemsText: You look as if you're carrying a heavy burden, adventurer. What is it?

95204.title: Crest of Lordaeron
95204.details: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in the Undercity would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95204.offerRewardText: <Oran bites the crest to ensure authenticity.> Well I'll be. A genuine relic of our home. Mostly intact, too. We need to be extra careful with this one. Thank you for your aid in restoring our history, champion. I'll see to it that we take good care of this.
95204.requestItemsText: What have you got there, champion? A tasty morsel?

95212.title: Never Saddle on Quality
95212.details:
We're getting ready to send a team of rams to reinforce the Alterac expedition, but we've run out of material to make their saddles.

Collect pelts from the largest, fiercest leopards to the east and bring them to me. It's biting cold up there and our forces deserve nothing but the finest pelts to keep them warm!
95212.offerRewardText: These pelts will make excellent saddles. You've done the Alliance proud, champion!
95212.requestItemsText: You look chilly, champion. How goes the hunt?

95213.title: Stolen Blasting Powder
95213.details:
The keg is stamped:

BLASTING POWDER - DANGER - DO NOT HANDLE - DANGER - QUARRYMASTER AUTHORIZATION ONLY - DANGER

You get a sinking feeling that the troggs shouldn't have this. It would be best to report this to the quarry sooner rather than later.
95213.offerRewardText: <The friend turns pale as he sees the empty keg.>...Where did you find this?

95214.title: Stolen Blasting Powder
95214.details: This keg held enough powder to turn King Magni's throne room into an open air courtyard. We've got to get it back from the troggs before they work out how to ignite it.
95214.offerRewardText: That should be all the stolen powder. Thank you, champion. Please accept this reward, and... I'd appreciate if you didn't mention this little incident to anyone.
95214.requestItemsText: I hope you've got good news for me?

95216.title: The New Plague
95216.details:
Welcome to the most vital organ of the Undercity: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of Azeroth's exotic specimens.

You've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. It appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even undead flesh. How exhilarating!

I wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.
95216.offerRewardText: You killed it?? Hmmph. Lucky for you this should be enough ichor to reverse engineer its properties. You do not wish to be an enemy of the Royal Apothecary Society. Get out of my sight!
95216.requestItemsText: Any fool can tell you the most potent transmission method will always be through the blood. I must see this strain for myself!

95217.title: The Quarry's Smith
95217.details:
So you're looking to learn the blacksmith's trade? Maybe we can help each other.

The supply shipment's late, and I need materials for some repairs around the camp. If you get me what I need, I'll teach you some of my techniques. Sound fair?
95217.offerRewardText: You're a resourceful one, adventurer. Now listen up - I'm not going to repeat myself!
95217.requestItemsText: Don't slack off, adventurer. Smithin' isn't for the lazy!

95250.title: Abominable Creatures
95250.details:
What do you want, friend? Can't you see there is a war to be won?

My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.

I doubt you'll survive ten minutes in combat, but if it keeps your simple mind busy, why don't you seek out the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.

95314.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir
95314.details:
Before the Scourge invasion, the reclusive village of Shadowvale was known for its Whispering Elixir. Distilled from herbs found only in Tyr's Fall, the elixir was sought by apothecaries, mystics, and poisoners alike even after being banned in the city.

I've had requests from a number of buyers eager to get their hands on some elixir. Travel to the ruins of Shadowvale deep in the Whispering Forest to the west. I'm prepared to offer significant compensation if you can recover some bottles for me.
95314.offerRewardText: You say there is evil in Shadowvale? I admit, I am not surprised. The forest folk were an odd lot, and they did not care for visitors. Some believe the Whispering Forest itself is cursed, and the elixir distilled from its roots carries that same curse......but enough of superstition and rumors, adventurer. Thank you for the elixirs. Here, take this as payment.
95314.requestItemsText: I trust you did not get lost?

95328.title: Whispering Horror Residue
95328.details: Against your better judgement you scrape up and collect the squirming remains of the beast. Someone in Undercity might have a use for them.
95328.offerRewardText: What an interesting specimen. From underneath the Whispering Forest, you say? It's no secret that foul place is touched by the void. I welcome the opportunity to explore the mysteries of shadow, champion. Allow me to offer you payment for what you've found.
95328.requestItemsText: Do you have something for me, champion?

95349.title: The Earthen Ring
95349.details:
The recent events with the cult have delayed my plans to travel to Azeroth and I must remain here in Valanaar for a time. You and a handful of other Windshapers will be our vanguard instead. Alaana Stormwalker will be waiting to receive our Windshapers upon arrival in Mulgore, and I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we finish our business here. We will join you soon.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.

Banu-Alah, adventurer.
95349.offerRewardText: More adventurers from Zephras, I see. Wonderful. The winds surely favor us! It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore this new land. Azeroth is an exciting new world, but it's also a dangerous world. You'd do well to prepare yourself for this new adventure by familiarizing yourself with the lands nearby.

95350.title: Welcome to Azeroth
95350.details:
Its a big world down here, and our new allies are the key to our survival.

The Earthen Ring is a member of the "Horde", a proud collection of like-minded peoples. The nearby city of Thunder Bluff is a part of the horde, and further to the east lies the capital of Orgrimmar.

Seek out the flight master in the center of Thunder Bluff. They will fly you to Orgrimmar where you will make contact with the horde warchief-- Thrall, on behalf of the Windshapers. Winds guide you, adventurer.
95350.offerRewardText: Lok-tar, champion. I am Thrall, Warchief of the Horde. An Earthen Ring messenger told me to expect members of the Windshapers, and here you are. I'd not have expected to see a high elf standing before me here in Orgrimmar, but the horde will welcome you as our guest all the same. You have my blessing to travel through horde lands. Go with honor, Windshaper.

95494.title: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides
95494.details:
I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep.

The big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.
95494.offerRewardText: Yes, these look like they will do nicely. I have an arrangement with a local tanner to deliver these raw hides in exchange for various finished leather goods that I use as part of my trade. I've never come up short on my end of the arrangement, and even with my injury I do not intend to start now.

95495.title: The Hermit Tanner
95495.details:
These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.

Oh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.
95495.offerRewardText: Vrang sent you then? Very well. I appreciate you delivering these hides to me. It's unfortunate that Vrang couldn't make the journey himself. There is a matter I wish to speak with him about.
95495.requestItemsText: Greetings, champion. What brings you up to my property today?

95507.title: Vrang's Game
95507.details:
While you are out there, it would be of great help to me if you could check on my traps for me. I've got them strewn all over the valley.

Bring back any small game that I've caught. Keep your eye out for the other wildlife, though. This area can be dangerous if you aren't paying attention.
95507.offerRewardText: Thank you for your aid, champion. I was starting to wonder if I'd have to go to bed hungry tonight because this cursed wound on my leg.
95507.requestItemsText: <Vrang grunts at you as you approach.>

95508.title: Unwelcome Guests
95508.details:
Yes, I used to be a member of the Kul Tiras navy. After Lord Admiral took Theramore and started his campaign in Durotar, I had... "objections" to his methods. Particularly the methods involving executing civilians.

There's more to the story but... wait... what's that?

There's a group of men coming up the ridge!
95508.offerRewardText: Well, looks like we are all alive. I... knew that someday that would catch up to me. I'm in your debt for your help here today. Please, take this. It's not much, but its the least I can do. Safe travels, champion.

95621.title: Trouble in the Valley
95621.details:
This morning I spotted a group of humans searching for something in the valley below. I managed to use my rifle's scope for a better look, and it was clear that they were soldiers sporting the livery of Kul Tiras.

If you'd be willing to take work from me, travel to where these soldiers made camp near the wrecked caravan to the south. Kill any you find and try to learn why they are here.
95621.offerRewardText: So they are looking for a deserter... Well, it seems that the past has finally caught up to me.
95621.requestItemsText: The remnants of Daelin Proudmoore's fleet who still fly his banner are just as rotten and barbaric as the admiral himself was before he died. I don't know why they are so far from Tiragarde, but it can't be good.

95774.title: Her Name Is Olgra
95774.details:
The healer who saved me could not save her, and she has died in battle. Her name is Olgra, and I will never forget her.

You did not find her adornments on her body? She wore many jewels of polished bone.

Slay the Razormane Raiders near where she fell, and find her precious works of art!

I will place them with the memorial that I build in her memory.
95774.offerRewardText: I will place these adornments with my wife's memorial, so that I never forget her. My blood will always run hot with revenge! You have done me... done us... a great favor, adventurer.
95774.requestItemsText: I have only memories now, but I will build a tribute to Olgra so that they never fade.

95803.title: A Token of Good Faith
95803.details:
Now that we've claimed the head of the tarnished commander, I need you to deliver it to the Undercity. Sylvanas Windrunner mistrusts us greatly, and all but openly disparages us.

Deliver Rudolph Gelhardt's head to the Dark Lady. Show her that we tend to our own house and are devoted to the prosperity of the forsaken.
95803.offerRewardText: I don't doubt Danitha's sincerity and desire to earn a place for your kind amongst the Forsaken. However, I suspect that this isn't the last time we'll see one of your brothers and sisters go mad and turn the light against their own people. There may come a time when I decide that tolerating your misbegotten order is no longer in the best interests of the Forsaken. I suggest you continue to serve your people diligently. We will be watching.
95803.requestItemsText: Why are you addressing me, champion?

95805.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha
95805.details:
The sun and the moon, An'she and Mu'sha, are not part of our world like the elements, yet their light gives us life, guidance, and hope.

We pay respect to the spirits of the world, and so we pay respect to the twins as well.

If you would show your respect, take this smoldering incense and bring it to a shrine in the hills to the southeast, overlooking the mesa, south of the quilboar. Be quick, so that you can reach the shrine before the incense burns away.

Don't get it wet!
95805.offerRewardText: <As you empty the incense into the fire, the scent wafts around you, leaving you with just the empty pouch and a subtle sense of fulfillment.>
95805.requestItemsText: <The smoke from the incense rises toward the sky.>

95816.title: Sign Me Up!
95816.details:
Greetings, accomplished craftsperson!

Completion of this form will grant you non-exclusive, revocable, and legally limited permission to display advertisement signs for your tradeskill(s) all across Azeroth!

Once completed, please bring this to your local Azeroth Commerce Authority branch's Contract Coordinator to begin processing.

Happy crafting!

95819.title: Sign Me Up!
95819.details:
Greetings, accomplished craftsperson!

Completion of this form will grant you non-exclusive, revocable, and legally limited permission to display advertisement signs for your tradeskill(s) all across Azeroth!

Once completed, please bring this to your local Durotar Supply & Logistics Contract Coordinator to begin processing.

Happy crafting!

95883.title: The Tortured Soul
95883.details:
<The preparations for a hastily-assembled ritual are gathered unceremoniously on the altar. According to the scrap of note, everything has been gathered. All that's missing are the offering of blood and the Tortured Soul.

The undead around you look tortured enough. They may have what you seek.>
95883.offerRewardText: <The tortured soul lets out a foul energy in the presence of the offering stone. It appears you are closer to fulfilling the ritual.>

95884.title: The Offering Stone
95884.details:
<The scrap of note is mostly illegible. What is still readable, however, are notes about preparations for an offering.

An offering stone is mentioned, as well as a ritual.

Perhaps you can find this offering stone nearby.>
95884.offerRewardText: <Strange implements and items litter the rough surface of the stone. This is surely the offering stone that is mentioned in the note.>

95885.title: The Offering of Blood
95885.details:
<All that's left now is the offering of blood.

The note scrap mentioned a 'willing sacrifice.'

An intense sense of dread washes over you.>
95885.offerRewardText: <The offering stone is inert now. It appears your ritual drained it of power. To what end, you do not know, but it is over now. The rough stone cracks and crumbles, now devoid of purpose. Something glitters from within the remnants...>

95981.title: Watching the Roads
95981.details:
Taking away their pendants is just the first step. If the Kirin Tor really are shipping a steady supply of relics from Dalaran, we must stop them at the source.

Search the roads around Ambermill for Dalaran's wizards and watchers. Their presence has allowed free access across our borders for too long. If we can cull their numbers, that should put a stop to these pendants making it into Silverpine Forest in the first place.
95981.offerRewardText: Ever since the barrier went down around Dalaran, the Kirin Tor have maintained a death grip on the roads. They're paranoid about something, that much is certain. For now, however, the why is irrelevant.

95998.title: The Great Outdoors
95998.details:
Well howdy there, champion. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.
95998.offerRewardText: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill. They will also teach you the know-how to create a proper camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
95998.requestItemsText: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors are critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.

95999.title: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im
95999.details:
Wanted! Incinerator Gar'im, Leader of an orc incursion in Render's Valley. Purported to be working with the Blackrock of Stonewatch Keep.

Beware of Incinerator Gar'im. He and his Shadowcasters are extremely dangerous. A handsome reward will to be given to any brave soul that can deliver proof of Incinerator Gar'im's demise to Magistrate Solomon.
95999.offerRewardText: Excellent work, adventurer! Incinerator Gar'im was preparing to bolster the defenses at Stonewatch Keep. With this victory, we may yet succeed in reclaiming the keep!
95999.requestItemsText: What do you have there, friend?

96031.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking
96031.details:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, champion. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
96031.offerRewardText: There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

96044.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing
96044.details:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
96044.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Sharpening Wheel. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

96045.title: Camping 101: Alchemy
96045.details: Now that you've taken up Alchemy, I can also teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp once you've learned a bit. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
96045.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Mana Well. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

96046.title: Camping 101: Mining
96046.details:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
96046.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Lodestone. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

96047.title: Camping 101: First Aid
96047.details:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a champion.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
96047.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96047.requestItemsText: I can teach you once you've gained some skill with your profession.

96050.title: Camping 101: Fishing
96050.details:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
96050.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Fish Bowl. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

96055.title: Camping 101: Herbalism
96055.details:

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
96055.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Incense Candle. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.

Now that you've begun your journey into being an enchanter, I reckon I can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp once you've learned the ropes.

It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.

96130.title: Chakuyak
96130.details:
Among the prairie wolves that hunt the hills nearby is one that is especially aggressive. We have taken to calling her Chakuyak. She has become a threat to travelers coming from abroad.

She stalks the trees west of Stonebull Lake, moving from tree stand to tree stand.

End this threat and bring me her pelt, and I will speak your praises to the chief. Beware, for she is dangerous! You might see other hunters seeking her out there, and perhaps you could work as a team.
96130.offerRewardText: Taking the life of such a beautiful creature is a sad event, but it was necessary for the safety of our people. I will make certain that the pelt does not go to waste. Thank you.
96130.requestItemsText: Have you found the big wolf?

96137.title: Ira's Dagger
96137.details:
A small dagger belonging to the self-appointed ranger, Ira, who kept the forests safe by preventing the beasts within from attacking travelers.

With Ira's spirit still wandering the woods, perhaps her unfinished business was to clear out the worg that continue to claim victims throughout the forest.
96137.offerRewardText: Ira? Are you sure? Sounds like the woman was damn near a ghost before she died. I'm surprised you found her. Rest assured I will take great care of this dagger.

96138.title: Merrick's Bow
96138.details:
A bow left by the spirit of Merrick Valor, famed Watcher who prided himself on keeping the roads safe from encroaching enemies.

With Merrick's spirit still wandering the roads, perhaps his unfinished business was to clear out invaders near his home in Raven Hill. The ogres south of town may be what's troubling his spirit.

96139.title: The Valor Family
96139.details:
In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it weren't for the bravery of folk like the good Lady Althea or those who lost their lives at Raven Hill.

Have you read much on Raven Hill? No, of course not. Its history was wiped out along with its people. My library, impressive as it is, has little on the subject.

If you happen to find anything, I would appreciate bringing it here. Those folk deserve to be remembered.
96139.offerRewardText: This tome appears to be about the Valor family. I believe I've heard of a few of them. Good folk. Not sure they merit an entire book about them. I'll make you a copy of the tome. If you see anything else related to them on your travels, I'll be happy to take it off your hands.
96139.requestItemsText: Have you found anything? I'm not holding out much hope.

96204.title: The Windshaper's Wrath
96204.details:
Now that I'm free I'm going to make these vile creatures regret ever laying eyes on a Windshaper.

Let's get out of here, champion.
96204.offerRewardText: Thank you again, adventurer. I've been aquatinting myself with Trevan here, who I've learned sent you along on my trail. I've heard... less than charitable things about paladins thus far in my travels. As a sky-touched shen'dorei elf traveling through horde territory, I can certainly understand how easily intolerance and prejudice can take root. You and your kind have a friend among the Windshapers.

96243.title: Call of Earth
96243.details:
It's past time ye heeded the earth, brave Shaman. The elements already prickle in yer skin, but once ye speak with the stone, the ground itself'll set firm 'neath yer soles--and in yer soul.

Seek out Teo Hammerstorm, in Coldridge Valley. Ye'll find him within Anvilmar, a holdfast forged by hammer, fire, and will.
96243.offerRewardText: The land itself let me know ye were comin'! Aye, sometimes, the burnin' fire within us is enough to power us through the snow without even touchin' the ground!

96390.title: Nip 'Em in the Bud
96390.details:
Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' not sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.

Head eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.
96390.offerRewardText: These Dark Irons may be our cousins but they ain't family, that's for sure. I shed no tears for any misfortune that befalls them that stray too far from that accursed mountain o' theirs. Hopefully this is enough to put 'em off of further incursions into these lands.

96391.title: Underground Map
96391.details:
<The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it. Earthseer Farsen needs to see this.>
96391.offerRewardText: Judging by this map, it certainly looks like these Dark Irons are planning some sort of incursion into the vaults beneath Ironforge. The band ye busted up to the east must be a scouting force. Thank ye for bringing me this. If we hurry, we might be able to beat them to whatever their goal is down there.

96392.title: Farsen's Watch
96392.details:
Greetings to ye, friend. My name is Earthseer Farsen and I'm visiting Dun Morogh from Aerie Peak. As I was travelin', I couldn't help but notice that we have, well... a bit o' a Dark Iron Dwarf problem.

If ye have a moment, I can show ye what I mean. I've got a bit o' magic that should do the trick.
96392.offerRewardText: So ye see now, champion? Thick as cockroaches they are, and that's just the ones we can see from the sky. Ye look like a sturdy enough sort. Hows about a bit o' violence?
96392.requestItemsText: Farsight can show ye a great many things, even things ye'd rather not see.

96393.title: Old Ironforge Incursion
96393.details:
Gather some allies and head down into the caverns beneath Old Ironforge. Enter the Hall of Thanes there and push to the lower vaults.

My Dark Iron is a bit rusty, but I can make out a name--one Durgen Dirgehammer. It's likely that he's the commander. Take his head and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard.

Oh, and when you do, tell him his old friend Farsen sends his regards!
96393.offerRewardText: A Dark Iron incursion--right beneath our feet? Well, I'm relieved to hear that the Dark Iron commander has been dispatched. The guards will head in and clean up the rest of the rabble. We'll see to it that the breaches are sealed and the lower levels reinforced to ensure that no further incursions are possible. Thank ye for yer service to Ironforge,champion. Take this as a small token of my gratitude. Oh, and if ye see that old Wildhammer rockhugger Farsen again, tell 'em to pay me a proper visit.

96394.title: The Restless Dead
96394.details:
Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.

Head down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!
96394.offerRewardText: Ah good, its done then. I can't have the other keepers refusing to enter the hall to do their duties on account of "ghosts" and "angry dead", can I?
96394.requestItemsText: I don't have time for ghouls and ghosts. I have a job to do down here.

96395.title: An Ancient Grudge
96395.details:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...

96403.title: Important Heirlooms
96403.details:
You there, adventurer... I could really use your aid.

I was sneaking--uh... 'patrolling' in the vaults when a force of Dark Iron dwarves emerged from the depths in mole machines! I don't know what they are here for, but there is priceless loot--uh or, rather... I mean, 'important cultural heirlooms' down there! Please, recover any such relics you see and return them here.

I assure you that anything you recover will be catalogued and returned to its proper place of honor.
96403.offerRewardText: Look at you, as brave as you are enterprising! I'm a gnome of my word, and your reward is well earned! Now, let me take a look at the haul--uh, I mean... the recovered heirlooms. I need to get started appraising--excuse me, 'cataloging' them so that they can be put back in their proper places as quickly as possible.
96403.requestItemsText: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>

96408.title: A Visitor to Dun Morogh
96408.details:
Last night one of our mountaineers spotted a campfire on a hillside to the east. It looks to be pretty high up, overlooking  the Gol'Bolar Quarry.

It's probably nothing, but I'd like you to go check on that camp. If they are friendly, no harm done. If they aren't friendly... well, you know what to do.

96626.title: Camping 101: Cooking
96626.details:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, champion. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96626.offerRewardText: With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it. Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires. You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96626.requestItemsText: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.

96627.title: The Adventurer
96627.details:
adventurer, you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.
96627.offerRewardText: I appreciate the lookin' out, champion. That marshal's just a worrywart. Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

96628.title: The Adventurer
96628.details:
Wait, adventurer. I have another ask of you, before you brave that tunnel.

My mountaineers have reported an adventurer that's shown up just outside of Kharanos. Could you deliver these supplies to him?
96628.offerRewardText: You say these are from the mountaineers? Aye, I could use them. Thank you, champion. Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96628.requestItemsText: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?

Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.

adventurer, you have proven yourself trustworthy in your endeavors against the Scarlet Crusade so far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Brill. Go and see what she's doing.
96656.offerRewardText: I'm not affiliated with the Scarlet Crusade, if you couldn't tell. I'm just an adventurer stopping by before my next venture into the wilderness. Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

Wait, adventurer. I have another ask of you, before you leave us.

There is an adventurer by the name of Kaga Wildhoof who has made camp just outside of Bloodhoof Village. She has greatly helped me in the past, and now I see my chance to repay her. Could you deliver these supplies to her?
96659.offerRewardText: Chief Hawkwind sent you? I told him back then I needed no compensation, but it seems he hasn't listened. Thank you, champion. Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96659.requestItemsText: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
