96821.title: Legging It
96821.details:
We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.

If your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.
96821.offerRewardText: The peons have been scared to travel south for some time, adventurer. Now that you've cleared the path a bit, we can get them back to work.

96822.title: For Honor
96822.details:
We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths.

Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.
96822.offerRewardText: These warriors will always be remembered, adventurer. You have made sure of that.
96822.requestItemsText: Have you done what I asked?

96825.title: This Fruit Could Bite Back
96825.details:
Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!
96825.offerRewardText: I'll use these to prepare something tasty, and save the seeds for planting. Someday we'll have prickly pears growing all around Orgrimmar!

96873.title: A Pain in the Neck
96873.details:
The trolls east of here have lost their will to the witchdoctor, Zalazane. He uses many cruel magics to keep hold of his prisoners' minds, but one of his favorite tricks is to make them wear pendants wrapped in evil binding spells.

Practice your enchanting skills by stripping the magic from these pendants, and bring me the results. And don't accidentally put one around your neck, if you value your freedom!
96873.offerRewardText: Fine work. A shame about the slain trolls, but with the binding spells removed, their spirits can rest.
96873.requestItemsText: What do you have for me, adventurer?

96874.title: This Is Spinal Axe
96874.details:
Have you seen the huge beasts of Thunder Ridge? I keep thinking the spines on their backs would be perfect for crafting the head of a mighty axe. Saru laughed when I told him... but what does he know!?

As part of your smithing lessons, you can help me out! Bring me some of those spines, along with grinding stones to sharpen them.
96874.offerRewardText: These spines are tougher than I expected, adventurer! Crafting with them may not be as easy as I thought... but I'll keep working on it!

96875.title: Beasts of Thunder Ridge
96875.details:
Orgrimmar is always expanding, champion. And when the peons need hides to line the walls and roofs of our new buildings, they come to me!

The hides of the lizards in Thunder Ridge are typically too thick for armor, but they make excellent building material. Bring me some of their hides, along with a few lighter cured hides. Let's see your skill with leather!
96875.offerRewardText: Your work helps Orgrimmar grow. Know that as you walk the city's paths.

96876.title: Ukor's Lost Pack
96876.details: The pack has the name " Ukor " crudely stitched along the flap.
96876.offerRewardText: My pack! When I dropped it to run from that huge spider, I thought I'd never see it again. You really are a hero!

96877.title: Halikor's Hoof
96877.details: The enormous hoof serves as proof of your victory over the mighty lizard.
96877.offerRewardText: What a trophy, champion! That must have been some fight!

96895.title: The Argent Emissary
96895.details:
Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.

One of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.
96895.offerRewardText: Stay low and try not to be seen, champion. These cultists are not to be trifled with.

96896.title: A Righteous Cause
96896.details:
Danitha and I fought against the scourge in the defense of the Undercity when Naxxramas attacked. We lost many good friends that day, including the hero after which this keep was named--Garek Bandarion.

He might just have been the first Forsaken to rediscover how to wield the light as a paladin. I am encouraged to see his legacy and potential live on here with Danitha and her cohort.

If only the rest of the forsaken felt the same way...
96896.offerRewardText: I plan to stay here for a time and speak with more of my friends, but I will return to Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands soon enough. Should you ever find yourself out that way, please do say hello. We could always use more help from able-bodied adventurers.

96897.title: The Cult of the Damned
96897.details: The scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.
96897.offerRewardText: Thank you for your aid, champion. If we do not wish to see Lordaeron's history repeat itself, we've got to be vigilant when threats like this spring up.

96898.title: Remnants of War
96898.details:
It wasn't long ago that the citadel of Naxxramas bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the Forsaken off the map. Both the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the Forsaken.

During the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal hanging beneath Naxxramas was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the scourge of them.
96898.offerRewardText: Thank you. This should slow the efforts of the scourge in this area. I suspect the denizens of Tirisfal will be pulling these crystals out of the ground for years, but removing the most conspicuous of them can only help.
96898.requestItemsText: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.

96899.title: Bandarion Keep
96899.details:
You've done a great thing for the cause of the Argent Dawn here today, and I thank you. I don't know how familiar you are with the fortress of Bandarion Keep, but my commander and I were headed that way to meet with the paladins that reside there. That was before we learned of the presence of the Cult of the Damned.

If you'd like to learn more about the Argent Dawn and our mission, seek out my commander at Bandarion Keep, to the northwest of here. I'll remain here to mop up the rest of this mess.
96899.offerRewardText: This place is full of memories for me. This place was once held by the Argent Dawn. It was here from here that we prepared for many battles and skirmishes against the scourge during their most recent push into Tirisfal Glades. When we withdrew to the Plaguelands I feared it would fall into disrepair. My fear was well-founded, but I am glad that Danitha and her paladins have taken over stewardship of it now. She even named the keep after... a mutual friend.

97003.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener
97003.details:
You there, champion. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". It's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated.

Most don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before.

Seek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone.

Blood and thunder, champion.
97003.offerRewardText: Impressive, champion. None will doubt my tales when I return to Orgrimmar with this grim proof of the existence of these abominations. Rest assured this glory is yours however, and I will speak loudly of your deeds. Lok-tar!
97003.requestItemsText: It took the strength of six skilled fighters to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to fell four of us before we could put it down. If these monstrous beasts were to appear in greater numbers, the damage that the qullboar could inflict upon the land could be catastrophic.

97005.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener
97005.details:
There's rumors of a monstrous abomination that makes its lair at a cave to the northwest of here, on the plateau known as Thorn Hill. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener" and those that have seen it say its so massive that it can swallow an orc whole.

Few believe such tales, but I do... because I've fought one like it myself. On the honor of those I lost to these things, this beast must die.

Gather strong allies and find the lair of Chol'aruk. Kill the abomination and bring me it's head.
97005.offerRewardText: My dead men will rest easier knowing that there is one less of these monsters in the world. You've done well, and are a true and stalwart defender of the alliance. Thank you. Go with honor, adventurer.
97005.requestItemsText: It took six of us to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to kill all but myself and one other before we were able to bring it down. This far from alliance lands I should leave it well enough alone. Light knows I'll lose little sleep over a few tauren savages or orcish brutes. However, the honor of my fallen brothers demands action.

97220.title: Philmor's Favor
97220.details:
Every day this week we've been short dockhands.

Care to ease the stress on our cargo schedule?

Take this package to the stockroom entrance of the Gatehouse. You'll find it inside Trias' Cheese shop on the second floor. The mistress, Elaine, will be quite familiar with the deliveries. The Gatehouse often has shipments arriving with more discretion to allow for ceremonial surprises on behalf of the guard's officers.
97220.offerRewardText: Oh, dear. You think we want to carry that up the stairs ourselves? Keeping the valuables intact is your responsibility up until the point you drop it off.
97220.requestItemsText: You looking to fill a crate with our finest aged wheels?

97222.title: Gatehouse Goods
97222.details:
Yes, it's only a flight of stairs, but if it's such a small ask, it should be no problem for you to finish the delivery yourself!

Trias' Cheese isn't part of the Gatehouse or their stocking inventory, but our buildings share a floor.

Place the crate outside their stockroom door--the guard will send someone for a regular pickup. They will see the package arrival and carry it inside as they return to post.
97222.offerRewardText: Yep. There's a reason that hinge opens inwards towards them, so they don't get the door blocked by people leaving stuff anywhere they please. Consider us professionally acquainted, champion. We respect your business, and expect you to respect ours.

97223.title: Bloodtalon Matriarch
97223.details:
All of the raptors you see before you are ones I have trained myself. They come from all over Kalimdor, but some of the finest come from the Bloodtalon raptors on the isles off our coast.

One raptor amongst them, the Bloodtalon Matriarch, is particularly savage and has killed many from our village and has become too dangerous to leave at our borders. If you can strike her down, return with her eggs so that we can raise the hatchlings as allies instead of enemies.
97223.offerRewardText: Thank you, adventurer. I am happy we will be able to preserve her bloodline and raise them to be our allies. You have done a great service for our tribe.
97223.requestItemsText: The Bloodtalon are known for their cunning and swiftness, and make fine companions when raised from egg to adult. Unfortunately adult raptors are very difficult to train, and I have tried to capture the Matriarch on more than one occasion. But she had become too dangerous of late. Still I hope to preserve her legacy by raising her children as companions here in Sen'Jin.

97225.title: Forgotten Loa Idols
97225.details:
When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.

The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.

This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.

Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.
97225.offerRewardText: You have done a great deed for our tribe today. Unlike some tribes, our kinship with our loa is one of reverence and respect, and we owe them much. I would not want the Darkspear to fall out of favor with them.
97225.requestItemsText: Have you found our loa idols, adventurer? We must begin our rituals again soon.

97234.title: Reading Room
97234.details:
Are you here to discuss the deeper meanings of our storied legends? No?

Well, after you're done looking around, can you carry this to the library for me? We're exchanging some of our less popular bodies of work for some more modern writing. I have a list of tomes I'm quite sure the librarian will be able to procure for us within our existing arrangement.

Complimentary club refreshments on us, if you help us out.
97234.offerRewardText: Let's see here. Roy's Book Club, isn't it? I recognize this wrap technique. Well, if he says this is what people want to talk about, it's all fine by me. The material we receive back is always in as good of quality as we loaned it, so we know they're treating it with respect regardless of how provoking the words may be.

97236.title: Fang of Githyiss
97236.details: A fresh specimen from a beast of this size is quite a find. Perhaps someone in Aldrassil familiar with the study of spiders would be interested in the fang.
97236.offerRewardText: My, my. How I do love surprises, adventurer. This specimen will surely help further my studies.

97237.title: Shelf Picked
97237.details:
I've checked our inventory and all of the selections Mr. Lewells has listed are currently available.

You will, however, need to procure them off the shelves yourself. Part of our librarian duty is vigilance, and for that, I will resume supervisory bookkeeping.

Returning with the material to Roy on his behalf will not mark yourself accountable for their return; as with his note you're serving as the book club's official courier. Their establishment shall carry that burden.

Good day, adventurer.
97237.offerRewardText: These are them! Some of them even smell exotic! Fantastic, I can't wait for us to have lively conversations about these writings. Cellar after hours, of course. Thanks for the quick errand run, adventurer. As promised, it's on the house. We keep our word here.
97237.requestItemsText: You forgot what you had to do the moment you stepped through the door, eh? Happens to everyone.

97242.title: Yelmak's Medley
97242.details:
Yelmak doesn't want his apprentice breaking anything. Well, anything more than he already has.

He told me the young mixer in training has too much pride to ask for help when he really needs it. Yelmak wants to give him a taste of a particular home-brewed recipe.

Gather a mix of cattail and speargrass cuttings taken from the plants growing around the water in the Valley of Honor. I'd get them myself, but if I left the shop, Whuut would surely know we're catering to his mood.
97242.offerRewardText: This type of cattail and speargrass is unique to Orgrimmar. Drinking from Azshara mountain spring water, and nourished by the sweat and blood soaked mineral dust of our rocky land, these herbs contain potent powers locked within. I'll give these to Yelmak, who may be able to win back Whuut's ear with a hands-on lesson.
97242.requestItemsText: We discover formulations and recipes by showing old ingredients to new generations, who experiment with it in their own way.

97243.title: Call of Fire
97243.details:
Even though we are in the realm of skywall, this is still the elemental plane. The spirits of all four elements speak to us, if we deign to listen. One among us Windshapers is in particular attunement with the element of fire. A shen'dorei by the name of Olariaan Swiftburn.

Bring this to him at the Shrine of Flames in the Gustberry Lowlands. You'll find it tucked away along the edge of the island, west of Valanaar.
97243.offerRewardText: So you've brought the torch. Yes, young champion, I can teach you to heed the call of fire. It will not be easy, but nothing that we do in this realm is ever easy.
97243.requestItemsText: Yes, adventurer? What do you have there?

97244.title: Call of Fire
97244.details:
There is an Al'Aketh Skypriest called Faladiel. He was once a caller of the flame and a stalwart Windshaper. Like so many Al'Aketh, he mortgaged his loyalty for power and his hands are now stained with the blood of  his former brothers and sisters.

You will find Skypriest Faladiel at the farm to the northeast past Valanaar, just to the south of the Shrine of Akir. Kill the betrayer. Bring me his heart. It is a gruesome task, but it is needed for the ritual we are to perform.
97244.offerRewardText: The Windshapers do not forget, and blood is always paid with blood. It pleases me that you were able to deliver this final, painful reminder of our creed to this traitor. This heart will not be all that feeds the flames today, however. There is one other task that needs to done.
97244.requestItemsText: The heart of a betrayer is a powerful reagent. The flames will eagerly accept such an offering and burn more intensely as it is consumed.

97245.title: Call of Fire
97245.details:
The residents of the Shen'dar Highlands speak of an ancient forest sprite called Kuramaa. They say it lives inside of a twisted stump at the summit of a hill near the highlands Anchor Pylon.

Go to the highlands and find this stump. Rap your fist upon the bark and Kuramaa will appear. Best the spirit in combat, and bring me its wooden mask.

Be warned however, this entity will be exceptionally resistant to much of your magic. Only the touch of flame will lay low the spirit.
97245.offerRewardText: We now have what we need. We will light the eternal flame and commune with the spirits of fire.
97245.requestItemsText: The spirit of Kuramaa is eternal, and it will manifest again when it is needed. It's mask is a source of great power, and will prove invaluable to the ritual we must complete.

97246.title: Meal Appeal
97246.details:
My son, Migi, always takes off to play with his friends all day. I tell him to pick up a lunch at Borstan 's, but I know he almost never does, because he comes home starving. These kids think their games are more important than their own bodies!

Please, stop at Borstan 's Firepit and tell him you're there to deliver Migi's lunch. You can almost certainly find Migi behind Grommash Hold with the rest of his friends.

Duties keep me here during the day and I can't watch over his every meal.
97246.offerRewardText: Of course. Migi's parents and I have an arrangement to give Migi a bagged lunch every day, but I can only ensure the boy gets his food if he actually comes in to pick it up. Sometimes, he doesn't pick up his meal multiple times a week, and I wonder where he gets the energy to stay out and play.

97249.title: Favorite Food
97249.details:
Now that I know his parents worry about how much he's actually filling that belly, I've got an idea.

They made me promise not to pack the same meal every day, so Migi grows a taste for more than one thing. Still, whenever the smoker's full and we're making sweetglazed hog belly sandwiches, he always shows up for lunch. We've started crumbling the leftover crispy glazed bits as a topping--something we can add daily.

Take this to him. Maybe he'll start showing up early and bringing friends!
97249.offerRewardText: Borstan's Meats? Is that for one of us? Oh! Wow... this smells really good! Yummy. Thanks for bringing me my lunch. I can tell what Borstan is going to be serving daily when my friends and I walk the road to Grommash Hold, by the smells alone. This tastes like my favorite, the sweetglaze! But it's different. I like the strong flavored crumbs. If it's going to be this tasty every day, I think we need to stop our game to take our lunch together!
97249.requestItemsText: I think we can win this one...

97250.title: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected
97250.details:
Traveler, have you plans to head toward Dustwallow Marsh? I have heard mutterings that a few human soldiers have taken a stand at its border and are toppling the landmarks left behind by our tauren pathfinders.

Rumor has it that a favored tavern has burned to the ground, and in typical Alliance fashion, they immediately cast their blame onto the Horde! I cannot know whether there is any truth to their claim, but their incursion onto OUR land must not stand.

Kill first, investigate later!
97250.offerRewardText: So the rumors were true! I expected as much, tensions have been rising along the eastern coast for some time. I knew it would only be a matter of time before conflict crept into our territory. However, I am skeptical that we played a role in the tavern's destruction. Too many Horde civilians rely on that route for trade and travel. Perhaps you could investigate further if you find the time. In any case, today's deed is a victory for the Horde, and a stern warning to the Alliance!

97253.title: Parts and Pieces
97253.details:
Hey, got a sec?

So, apparently, nobody I've sent to deal with the recent pirate problem has come back alive. After five or six attempts I thought, "what if I sent a machine instead?" Turns out, scimitars double as screwdrivers in a pinch, and before I could redirect it home, it was already in pieces and scattered across their camp!

I need those parts back, and since this is a quick little retrieval mission, I'd wager your odds for survival are MUCH higher than the others. Whaddya say?
97253.offerRewardText: Whooooa! Nice one, pal! You saved me from another one of Gagsprocket's unbearable lectures on the cost of metal. More importantly, I can jump right into building my next prototype. Uhhh, I didn't have a reward planned... Do you like boxes?
97253.requestItemsText: Not another word out of you until your pockets are jingling with metal!

97257.title: Call of Fire
97257.details:
Now we will perform the ritual.

I will place the materials onto the altar and call forth the spirits of flame. If the offering is accepted, they will appear and light the Eternal Flame. You will then hold your torch forth and capture the flame.

Carry the lit torch to Valanaar and place it in the Brazier of Eternal Flames. You must do so quickly, for the flames of the Firelands are quick to dissipate here in Skywall.
97257.offerRewardText: It is done. The Eternal Flame burns once again. Your trial is now complete. I am pleased to present you with your Fire Totem. Use this icon of power well in your travels, adventurer. Just remember, the power of the elemental plane serves those that respect it, and consumes those who do not. This is our way.
97257.requestItemsText: You have done well to come this far. You do the Windshapers honor, adventurer.

97263.title: Your Package Has Arrived
97263.details: <Several misplaced packages have been left by the mailbox. You note that one of them is marked for delivery from Aerie Peak, to Ironforge, to Eldrun Stormbreaker. It is marked "urgent.">
97263.offerRewardText: What! I've been going to the mailbox by the bank every day looking for this package! This city needs to figure out its layout. Not easy to navigate like Aerie Peak! Let's see what I've got... totem carving tools... spare axe... some kind of goblin device? I didn't order that! Ah, I'll just send it back. Er, uh... I mean... thank you for bringing all of this to me. Here's a little something for your trouble.

97275.title: Whuut's the Rush
97275.details:
Whuut is a prodigy. That much is true. But he doesn't yet have the experience, wisdom, and time on the stirring rod to know how to respect alchemical processes.

He is exhausting all of the rarest and most exotic reagents we have available without pausing to practice and refine his basic skills.

Give him this potion I've brewed with a quick tonic method. He'll reconsider everything he's doing when he learns how local remedies and careful touch are the first true mastery.
97275.offerRewardText: Grorru--whaa? You say Yelmak made this potion from speargrass and cattail with no other reagents? I didn't know chemists had any real need for these common plants we see every day. Maybe he's right. There could be a lot I'm missing out on by skipping to the most rare and least-studied flora first. adventurer, take your pick from one of these potions I brewed earlier. I appreciate you taking the time to visit our shop.
97275.requestItemsText: Alright, what's next... Black Lotus, Mountain Silversage...

97277.title: Grund and Gozwin
97277.details:
Oi, had me back turned gettin' the boar roast ready when I heard me pal Gozwin screamin' fer his life!

Wicked fangs and a blur are all I saw when I turned. Such huge paws! A snow leopard was draggin' its gnomish catch away. I grabbed me shotgun and fired above the beast. It dropped him and sprinted off.

Luckily, it hadn't done more than give ol' Goz some deep scratches.

Head back to camp in the northwestern hills and retrieve Gozwin's Mechanic's Log. Kill that snow leopard too if you see it!
97277.offerRewardText: Aye, I'm not surprised to hear that snow leopard was makin' a meal of the boar we were fixin' fer roastin'! Goz will have one less thing to stress about now that you brought back his log book. Maybe now he can focus all his energy on gettin' back on his feet. Thanks, adventurer. Take a little something as a token of my appreciation, fer makin' the trek, and fer protectin' the hills.
97277.requestItemsText: Poor Goz is more concerned for his mecha-walker than himself. Says if anyone gets a hold of that mechanic's log he's greased. Hah! That's why I told him he should just leave his work at home!

97279.title: Wayward Weapons
97279.details:
With an influx of new recruits like yourself, it's been hard to keep our weapons supplied. Our weaponsmith, Kzan, is running low on training weapons and I'd like to see what kinds of skills you possess to get an idea of what I have to work with. Luckily for you, I have a solution to both.

While you're out there cutting your teeth on boars, salvage six abandoned training weapons. Our failed recruits left them laying on the ground. Once you do, return them to our weaponsmith Kzan behind me in the Den.
97279.offerRewardText: Thank you for returning these weapons, adventurer. I will get to work repairing them for the next wave of recruits.
97279.requestItemsText: Throm'ka, champion. Gorak told me I should be expecting you. It is good to see you in one piece! Were you able to collect the training weapons I requested?

97281.title: A Simmering Storm
97281.details:
<Before you is a strange orb and with a dull surface. When picked up a small electrical current seems to vibrate from within. Upon closer inspection, it looks as if a dark mist swirls within and every so often a small electrical spark can be seen.

It is clear the harpy was using it for some purpose. Perhaps Rezlak would be interested in this object?>
97281.offerRewardText: Woah, where did you find a neat thing like that? Ya know it reminds me of the other thing my boss Gazlowe always used to tell me...

97282.title: Stormy Potential
97282.details:
"Rezlack, when an opportunity come's knocking make sure you're ready to seize it." That's another gem Gazlowe taught me and that's exactly what I intend to do.

This orb doesn't seem damaged, it just looks like it's out of juice, but I've the idea to supercharge it back to full strength!

There are a bunch of thunder lizards in a gorge west of here. They have organs that hold a strong electrical charge that would be perfect for this.

Go harvest some and bring them back to me!
97282.offerRewardText: Hey, thanks pal! You've been a really big help to me here and I appreciate it. Here's to hoping I can get this all charged up using these organs. I bet it'll make those no good harpies think twice about attacking my caravan again. I sure hope this works. Either way you've done your side of the deal. Take this for your trouble.
97282.requestItemsText: It might come as a surprise that with a name like thunder lizard they shoot lightning instead of roaring like thunder. Well, they do. Shoot lightning, I mean. Trust me, it's a lesson you only get to learn once if you're lucky.

97286.title: Research Access
97286.offerRewardText: Your actions show you are one who respects knowledge. The library is open for use in your studies.

97288.title: Unending Torment
97288.details:
<As the creature falls, its head comes toppling off. It seems as if it has been reattached several times, and the connection gets weaker with each reconnection.

Someone in the Undercity would know more about this unique abomination.>
97288.offerRewardText: Oho! I believe I know this head. A cruel joke by our Dark Lady. A delicious one at that. I think I have a use for this.

97289.title: Unending Torment
97289.details:
We craft abomination heads all the time, but this one is special. It belonged to a Grand Marshal of the alliance once. A particularly unpleasant one. Othmar, I believe its name was. The Dark Lady had the pleasure of dispatching of this one herself.

Ooh the secrets it could tell if it could talk. And it can! If we reattach it to an appropriate host.

Go ahead and place it next to the available body in the next room. But don't attach it. Not yet.
97289.offerRewardText: <The body twitches to life, panicking as it relives its final moments.> You...
97289.requestItemsText: <The abomination remains lifeless without a head to control it.>

97290.title: Unending Torment
97290.details:
You... abomination...

Why should... help you...

Be gone...
97290.offerRewardText: Not cooperating, eh? Excellent. I always love a challenge.

97291.title: Unending Torment
97291.details:
With the head reattached, all we need now is to bind it to the Dark Lady's will. This should not be a problem. The beast barely has brains left as it is after all the beatings it's taken.

We simply need to motivate it.

Fetch me a Toxic Skullcap from Miss Grisette in the Trade Quarter. Oh, and some Blisterweed from our local herbalist trainers, the Alliestars. Feel free to just take some, they owe me. And lastly a bit of Essence of Agony. Any old poison vendor should do.

We have a potion to make!
97291.offerRewardText: These will do nicely. We will see how much bravado our honored guest retains after he is subjected to my masterpiece.
97291.requestItemsText: It will be ever so lovely to have our lost sheep returned to the fold, don't you think?

97292.title: Unending Torment
97292.details:
I have concocted a lovely serum that our new guest is sure to find quite... stimulating.

Take this. Feed it into the workings dripping from above him. Let's see if we can't show him why it's in his best interest to serve loyally.

And try not to drop it. I can't afford a new assistant.
97292.offerRewardText: Excellent. We'll let his flesh simmer for awhile. Give him time to acclimate to his new home. I have no further use for the wretch for now, but we shall keep an eye on him. I have many plans for Othmar's future.
97292.requestItemsText: For Othmar's crimes against the Dark Lady, placing him under that oozing specimen is the least he deserves. And it's funny...

97326.title: Rocks to Rests
97326.details:
Hey! You've got time to help us out! I know you do, I can tell by the way you smiled watching the game we're playing.

This spot behind Grommash Hold is nice because it's clear enough for us to set up our figures. But what stinks is we don't have enough rocks for chairs or tables.

You're big and strong... d'ya think you could carry back some medium sized rocks, smooth enough to sit on if we need a rest?
97326.offerRewardText: How can you even hold all of those boulders! Those are great. Most even have a nice flat side, too. Now that you carried them all the way over here we can scoot them around in the dirt, right where we want 'em. Thanks, adventurer!
97326.requestItemsText: It's nice to not have to always sit in the dirt!

97485.title: Traditions of the Bluff
97485.details:
Blessings of An'she, friend.

We tauren have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds and I was hoping you'd be interested in honoring this tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
97485.offerRewardText: You have done well, friend. I thank you for taking the time to perform one of our time-honored traditions, adventurer. I hope that as you travel you will find plenty of occasions you wish to give thanks for. Should you ever wish to perform the ritual again, you should be able to repurchase the components I sent you to collect. Go with An'she's warmth.
97485.requestItemsText: There are many occasions one may choose to spread incense to the winds. You could be asking the Earthmother to watch over someone, bless a hunt, celebrate an occasion, or even to seek guidance from our ancestors. Or it could be something else entirely. Though the act is done with reverence, it is not strictly a ceremonial affair. Typically there are certain traditional steps observed when performing this act, but many tribes have differing practices.

97538.title: Pigments for Paints
97538.details:
Greetings, friend. I wonder if I may ask a favor of you? I have just run out of red pigment for my paints, and I am looking for one with younger hooves to make the long journey into the Stonetalon Mountains on my behalf.

In the middle of the mountain pass there lies a large circular lake, Mirkfallon Lake, that has a unique plant that grows within its waters. The pods of this plant, mirkweed, turn a vibrant red when dried. Gather the pods of this plant for me, and I will reward you well for your efforts.
97538.offerRewardText: Ah, thank you adventurer. It means much to me to have you venture all the way out there for what must seem a trivial notion from an old tauren, but with your kindness I will have enough pigment for the rest of the season. Thank you for supporting my livelihood, and I will strive to create something magnificent with the pigments you have brought.
97538.requestItemsText: You have returned! Were you able to find the mirkweed plant pods in Mirkfallon Lake? We tauren have used this plant pigment in our paints for generations, so any amount you manage to bring would be appreciated. Though there are many ways to get a red pigment, I find the mirkweed to give the richest and most vibrant hue of the methods I'm familiar with.

97558.title: Hides for the Forsaken
97558.details:
One part of undeath no one mentions is what happens when we are injured. How does the skin of an undead heal itself?

Well, it doesn't.

Ours is a cursed life, adventurer. We must take from the living to further our own existence.

When we sustain an injury, we must replace our skin which usually means animal hides. Since different hide thicknesses are better for different places on our bodies a variety is key!

Bring me wing membranes of a duskbat, hides from a darkhound and skin of a Vile Fin murloc.
97558.offerRewardText: Ah, excellent! Thank you for acquiring these. I can promise they will be put to good use.
97558.requestItemsText: Have you gathered the skin I inquired about? Our stocks are running low. It may seem odd to ask for murloc skin but it works well for internal membranes, or surfaces like cheeks or mouths. Similarly, the duskbat wing membranes are especially suited for more delicate areas, like faces or fingers. It prevents the skin from being too... thick.

97583.title: WRIGGLE.
97583.details:
<The little slime seems delighted and is attempting to mirror your motions as you dance. It begins to look weary though.

The little slime hovers over a bit of sludge and absorbs it, looking slightly rejuvenated.

It seems all of this dancing has tuckered it out. Perhaps someone in the Undercity canals sells more of this nutritious sludge?>
97583.offerRewardText: <The slime shudders with newfound energy. It seems to want to follow you, now that it has associated you with food.>
97583.requestItemsText: <The slime seems to regard you with interest.>

97891.title: Prompt Potion Runner
97891.details:
You! Quickly, I need you to bring this potion across the slime canal to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium!

It has a very limited shelf life, and no I can't go myself, my knees rattle and pop out if I attempt to run.

Just another lovely side effect of undeath, apparently.

But we're wasting time! Here, take this and go!

<Alessandro makes a shooing motion.>
97891.offerRewardText: Ah, marvelous! I had been waiting for Alessandro's potion to arrive. The last six he sent destabilized along the way, but you've made it just in time! Here, take this for your effort. That is all for now, unless you have other business with me? If not, remove yourself so I may continue my experiments unhindered.

97894.title: Business in Auberdine
97894.details:
Pleasure to make yer acquaintance! Name's Borgus, of the one and only Steelhand family. You can always count on a Steelhand fer a fair deal!

A few weeks back me brother Gorbold joined up with a merchant stall in Auberdine. Plenty of coin to be made supplyin' ships there, let me tell you! Lucky sod.

I haven't heard from him since--mind checking on him if yer heading that way?

There's a new ship in the harbor that will take ye straight there. Head to the southern-most dock; can't miss it!
97894.offerRewardText: Old Borgy sent you? Always looking out for me. We could certainly use another set of hands around here. Business has all but stopped with the recent tragedy, and I think you could help set things right.

97899.title: Camping 101: Alchemy
97899.details:
So, you chose to cook up brews and potions as an Alchemist. I'm sure that'll come in handy in your travels.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
97899.offerRewardText: There ya have it, directions for your very own Mana Well. Most folks don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to try it out. No camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those as the basis of your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. Check in with someone who can train you in cooking if you haven't already learned the basics.

97900.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing
97900.details:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
97900.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Sharpening Wheel. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

97901.title: Camping 101: Enchanting
97901.details:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
97901.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can craft your very own Enchanted Lute. Most folks don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to try it out. No camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those as the basis of your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. Check in with someone who can train you in cooking if you haven't already learned the basics.

97902.title: Camping 101: Engineering
97902.details:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
97902.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Reagent Bot. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

97903.title: Camping 101: First Aid
97903.details:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a champion.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97903.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97903.requestItemsText: I can teach you once you've gained some skill with your profession.

97904.title: Camping 101: Fishing
97904.details:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97904.offerRewardText: Dere ya have it, ya be craftin' your very own Fish Bowl. Most folk don't be carin' much for camps being set up in da center of town, so ya be needin' ta head into da wilderness if ya be wantin' to try it out. No camp is complete without a campfire, mon. Ya be needin' one of dose before ya be startin' up your camp. Most cooks be teachin' ya ta make a fire. Check in with someone who can train ya in da culinary arts if ya haven't already learned da basics.
97904.requestItemsText: I can teach you once you've gained some skill as a fisherman.

97905.title: Camping 101: Herbalism
97905.details:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97905.offerRewardText: Dere ya have it, ya be craftin' your very own Incense Candle. Most folk don't be carin' much for camps being set up in da center of town, so ya be needin' ta head into da wilderness if ya be wantin' to try it out. No camp is complete without a campfire, mon. Ya be needin' one of dose before ya be startin' up your camp. Most cooks be teachin' ya ta make a fire. Check in with someone who can train ya in da culinary arts if ya haven't already learned da basics.

97906.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking
97906.details:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, champion. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97906.offerRewardText: There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

97907.title: Camping 101: Mining
97907.details:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97907.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Lodestone. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

97908.title: Camping 101: Skinning
97908.details:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97908.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

97914.title: Expanding Horizons
97914.details:
Auberdine is a humble place, champion. You will not hear its name spoken in the boughs of Darnassus. Most reference only what the Sundering took from us--the thriving cities of Ameth'Aran, Bashal'Aran, and... Lathar'Lazal.

Yet Auberdine remains in their shadow.

I would see our work here recognized. A new vessel connects us to the kingdom of Stormwind, bringing life and supplies to our shores. I beseech you join its next voyage, and bring this letter to a human called Baros Alexston.

Make our home known.
97914.offerRewardText: <Baros opens the letter and begins to read it, his smile fading.>
97914.requestItemsText: I can smell the sea on you, friend! <Baros laughs.> What brings you to Stormwind?

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
97925.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Rallying Banner. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. 97926.title: Making Do
97926.details:
I wish it was that easy to help, champion. I really do.

Should you choose to spend more time in our lands, you will find that many are without. Stormwind's coffers are not what they once were, and what remains is spread thin.

Give this reply to the elder the next time you see him. It's not what he's hoping for, but it's all I have to offer right now.
97926.offerRewardText: Sad news indeed. Still, I thank you for making the journey. With neither Stormwind nor Darnassus coming to aid us, it seems that Auberdine's fate is our own to decide.
97926.requestItemsText: You have returned. What news comes from Stormwind?

You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97932.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Fish Bowl. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

97933.title: Camping 101: Herbalism
97933.details:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97933.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Incense Candle. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

97934.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking
97934.details:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, champion. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.

Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97971.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

97972.title: Camping 101: Tailoring
97972.details:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
97972.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Rallying Banner. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

97973.title: Camping 101: Tailoring
97973.details:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
97973.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Rallying Banner. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

97977.title: Nature's Call
97977.details:
The Gnarlpine furbolg would not turn on their ancient allies so readily. We must learn more of their plight.

Search their abandoned homes for totems. If any survived the chaos of their departure, their engravings may tell us more of what happened here.

You'll find their camps along the western edge of the glen, though the grell and grellkin may have scattered them beyond.
97977.offerRewardText: Oh, it's even worse than I thought. These engravings tell us that the Gnarlpine began having nightmares of being wiped out by some great shadow. Before long, that fear turned to rage--and the shadow to their former elven friends. To be aware of your own mind slipping away from you... Our only hope is that this may help us better understand what is happening on Teldrassil. Thank you for your aid, adventurer.
97977.requestItemsText: Don't worry about any larger totems you might find. I wouldn't know what to do with them if you found a way to get them!

97979.title: The Goddess Provides
97979.details:
You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and have inherited a birthright unlike any other in this world. Elune's grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.

Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.

Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.
97979.offerRewardText: You have seen what our goddess provides. Use it well, and she will never forsake you.

98013.title: Swelling Forces
98013.details:
Steel yourself for your time in the ruins, young one... you will not be granted free passage there.

Scores of cursed Highborne, now known as naga, roam the once great city. Travel northeast and dispatch them from this land.

What they once were... is no more. If they aid the Twilight's Hammer, they can bring only further pain to the forests that once gave them shelter.

War is what they seek, champion. War... is what we will bring.
98013.offerRewardText: Do not fret, young one. To pillage one's own home for some dark master... It is unforgivable.

98021.title: Journey to Sentinel Hill
98021.details:
If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, I'd recommend reporting to a man named Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall to the south, at the settlement known as Sentinel Hill. His people are in need of aid.

After journeying here from another plane of existence, the problems our lands face may seem small. I assure you, the aid you provide to those impacted by such problems means everything to them, and you will grow stronger for your labors.

Good luck out there, adventurer!
98021.offerRewardText: I've been begging Stormwind for aid for months and he sends me a skinny elf? Well, beggars can't be choosers I suppose. Welcome to Westfall, champion. Let's see if we can't put you to work.

98024.title: Journey to the Crossroads
98024.details:
After journeying here from the elemental plane, the problems our lands face may seem small. Rest assured, the dangers the horde faces are very real, and you will grow formidable should you survive your service.

If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, travel southwest to the vast lands known as the Barrens. There is a settlement there known as the Crossroads. The proud citizens there are ever in need of aid.

Go with honor, adventurer!
98024.offerRewardText: What's this? An elf? And you say the Warchief sent you? <Thork grunts sharply as he looks you up and down.> You look a little skinny to me, but it matters not. Out here you'll either thrive and survive, or you'll die. That is the way of things in these lands.

98025.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel
98025.details:
Attention!

A reward is being offered for the death of the owl "Jai'vhanel" also know as "Swordfeather".

Unfortunately this owl has gone mad and has begun to attack travelers as they journey along the road near Auberdine.

Jai'vhanel was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Bring back one of her jet black feathers as proof of her death.

Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

The Auberdine Village Council
98025.offerRewardText: It is good to know that issue has been taken care of, but it saddens me that we could not find another way. Jai'vhanel had been somewhat of a guardian of this area for quite some time, and I am not sure what could have caused her decent into madness. Regardless, thank you for your service today, champion. The roads to Auberdine are safe for travel once again.
98025.requestItemsText: Greetings champion - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Jai'vhanel?

98028.title: Baron Marinous
98028.details:
All that remains of the powerful elemental is a globe of what seems to be pure water, clouded by some unknown substance. The edges of the sphere seem to be clear until you turn it--as if the cloud actively prevents you from peering within.

Whatever happened to it--and to the ruins it was guarding--is still active in some way.

Only Onu, the Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients to the far south, would have a chance at knowing more.
98028.offerRewardText: <Onu appears surprised--or as surprised as an ancient can appear.> Stairs descending down in Mathystra? Could be it be? <Onu shakes his head.> I must confer with the others on this. For now, know that it is good you uncovered this before the naga... or their cult allies. Please accept this as thanks for your efforts. It is no small feat to defeat an elemental guardian.
98028.requestItemsText: I can sense something far older than you in my presence, friend... what have you brought me?

98042.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...
98042.details:
<As you tear away the single page from the Twilight Tome, a foreboding voice floods your mind, uninvited.>

They have failed.

You will be forgotten.

They will lose the eye they gained.
98042.offerRewardText: <Thundris does not speak for some time.> This bears the mark of an ancient evil, champion. I will see it brought to Darnassus at once for further study. Ande'thoras-ethil.
98042.requestItemsText: You look troubled. I am listening.

98046.title: Crown of the Earth
98046.details:
< Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm 's gaze narrows.>

You're still here?

Take the phial and get out of my sight, champion. It is clear my answers do not lie in the waters, just as they did not before.

Perhaps one of the priestesses in the Temple of the Moon to the south will dispose of it.

<Fandral looks away, no longer speaking to you.>

I must look elsewhere if this is to work...
98046.offerRewardText: Do not mind the Arch Druid, adventurer. He bears the weight of much in Malfurion's absence. Wait! Some drops yet remain in the phial! Perhaps that is why his incantation failed?

98065.title: Crown of the Earth
98065.details:
You must bring this to Tyrande at once! I will transfer it to a more ceremonial container for you.

Do not be afraid. The High Priestess of Elune is firm, but kind. She protects all who enter Darnassus, and carries our goddess' light to all.

She will be glad to receive this sacred water. You will find her directly above us.
98065.offerRewardText: Staghelm has done much in my beloved's absence, but he is not Malfurion. And he does not run the affairs of Darnassus--that burden is mine alone. <Tyrande's face settles.> I apologize. As you have likely seen, we have many challenges to overcome. Fandral is Arch Druid for now, and I ask you respect his station. But his doings pertain to druidism, and mine not only to Elune but indeed to lead our people as she wills. Every drop of this water is blessed by our goddess. I thank you for saving it.
98065.requestItemsText: Please state your business. I have a city to run, and a people to lead.

98067.title: Eyes of the Sentinels
98067.details:
General Feathermoon ensures all sentinels have time to pray to Elune. A proper huntress wields not blade alone, but gifts of the goddess to overcome our enemies.

You may help with my daily duties. Place sentinels around the city--start with the tunnels leading beneath Cenarion Hold to the north, the bank at the center of town, the inn in the Craftsman's Terrace to the northeast, and the city gates. The guards can assist you.

Something is amiss in Teldrassil--we must remain vigilant.
98067.offerRewardText: I thank you for your aid. Though I find peace in the daily rituals, it is nice to have a moment to reflect instead.

98072.title: Crocs of the Sky
98072.details:
You're quite the go-getter! I have just one more favor to ask, if you're up for something a bit more dangerous.

The crocolisk trade is steady money, but they're small fish compared to what whelp scales will bring. Folks will pay top dollar for a sack of those.

Crocs of the sky, I call 'em! There's no way my apprentice could get them--but it seems right up your alley!

You'll find whelps far to the east, along the Green Belt. But be careful, there's nasty orcs in those hills!

98093.title: Field to Clear
98093.details:
I'm so glad you saw me!

The weather was lovely this morning, so I walked from Camp Taurajo down the golden road. When it came time to head back, I couldn't--a pack of hyenas started circling, and Stormhide lizards blocked my only escape.

Scrambling up this tree I went, and now there are too many foes about at this hour for me to make the run home through the fields.

Would you mind clearing out these Stormhide and Hecklefang Stalkers for me?
98093.offerRewardText: Thank you for helping me out, adventurer. I'll let Camp Taurajo know you were able to rescue me. I'm so lucky you helped, I could have been stuck there all day! This is all I have to spare, but I hope it's useful to you. I'll be making my exit once I make the careful climb down.

98094.title: Scout Support
98094.details:
Now that we can trust you to deliver critical information to our forward spies, there's an extra task for you.

Bring this to Deathstalker Masoj almost directly south of us. He'll have more for you to do once you get there and hand this to him. He is posted on elevated terrain north of the rotten vineyard they call Nethander Stead.

Our plan to take control of these lands continues steadily.

98095.title: Valuable Vantages
98095.details:
Our high command inserts strategic troops using bat riders. Key points around the foothills have lost their signaling beacons.

Take these vials. Uncork them in three locations: the hills bordering Dun Garok, the plataeu overlooking Dunholde Keep, and the last on the ridge of the Headland above the town of Hillsbrad. The vapors that emanate will be like a potent tuning rod to the senses of the bat, drawing them to the desired drop-off points once more.

Look for crushed empty vials and renew our marks.

98189.title: Return the Statuette
98189.details:
My goodness, it's--it's beautiful!

The Blind Princess was to deliver this to Menethil Harbor before tragedy struck. We were so close!

I believe it was to be signed for by Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep just behind us. Why don't you do the honors of finishing the job?
98189.offerRewardText: You managed to get it back from those monsters! There aren't too many artifacts of the late king left now.
98189.requestItemsText: What's that you've got there? Let me take a look.

98190.title: A Friend of the Family
98190.details:
You'll want to take this to Stormwind right away. Proud as I am that this keep and harbor bears King Terenas Menethil II's name, we are a calm harbor in a very nasty storm of enemies. It's just not safe here.

The Dragonmaw in particular would sacrifice much to loot something like this... and I shudder to think of what they'd do with it.

Don't bother going up the chain of command on this one, <lad/lass>. Go straight to Highlord Fordragon with this. He'll know where it will be best kept.
98190.offerRewardText: You have my gratitude for recovering this. I am relieved it did not fall into the wrong hands.
98190.requestItemsText: Let us speak, champion. I can feel you carry something of the Light.

98191.title: A Friend of the Family
98191.details:
King Terenas was a good man. A devout man. Beloved by his people, and truly the reason we have this Alliance at all.

The irony is he was humble--he hated these sorts of memorials, and so precious few exist. And of those, few survived Lordaeron's fall.

It seems the Light has coalesced in this statuette. It would be best kept in the Cathedral of the Light in Cathdral Square, in the center of the city. Bring it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker for safekeeping.
98191.offerRewardText: By the Light... it looks just like his boy... <Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker pauses for a moment.> This statuette has indeed been blessed. Its connection to Terenas, its survival of what that monster did to him... this carries great power for those who believe in its strength. It is best kept here for now, under guard of the paladin order. We will meditate on it further to learn more of its gifts, and perhaps it may aid us in dark times ahead. Thank you, champion. Light bless you.
98191.requestItemsText: Light be with you, champion. You are clearly not here for small talk--what is it?

98197.title: Spoils of War
98197.details:
This harbor was first built by the Old Horde as a staging ground for their naval invasion of Hillsbrad. Completely circumvented Lordaeron's defenses!

So many lives lost...

What's worse is that fleet was built with the very resources they stole from Khaz Modan!

Plenty of it remains in the harbor after Admiral Proudmoore routed the brutes and built this place for the Alliance. We'll need it to bolster the town's defenses with the Dragonmaw on the move.
98197.offerRewardText: Ah! A bit damp, but nothing a few days in the sun won't fix. Thank you, champion. It's nice to not solely rely on shipments from Theramore or Auberdine for once!
98197.requestItemsText: Keep your wits about you beneath the waves. There's plenty of nasties down there!

98208.title: Bloom of the Heavens
98208.details:
I came to Menethil Harbor from Auberdine, from the great tree Teldrassil, to recover a bloom of great import to my people.

My people's ship the Flying Osprey crashed here many moons ago, joined with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Among its cargo was the flower known as Nord'el --Bloom of the Heavens in your tongue--bloomed under a full moon at the peak of Mount Hyjal, our former home.

Please help me retrieve it! The wreckage is just south of the city, but it is inhabited by fierce murloc raiders!

98219.title: The Shamed Lieutenant
98219.details:
Thank you again for delivering the statuette safely, adventurer.

I could use your help with something else. There's a member of the city guard who was reassigned to duty in Southshore out in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

His father was a friend of mine, and while I don't disagree that he could use the lesson... I'd still like to see him succeed. He would really benefit from someone like you helping him out.

There is a boat that can take you that way from Menethil Harbor, if you are passing back through.
98219.offerRewardText: Ah, of course. Another one of Stormwind's finest here to check on me. Same as last month!

98240.title: Crimson Crate Delivery
98240.details:
Word is officially out on those whelps, adventurer. We already have an order in!

I'll package 'em up all nice for you, then you take it out to the customer. I know, I know; it's just one last favor, I promise!

These will be for one "Howin Kindfeather". Sent his gryphon into town of all things with a letter for the order! Says he's just off the road to the east, a bit past Whelgar's Excavation Site, if you're familiar.

98245.title: Razormaw Needling
98245.details:
I don't know who I hate more: the bloody Dark Irons, the Dragonmaw, or the drakes they rode.

<Howin spits.>

I aim tae make things right. But we're gonna need some supplies.

These whelp scales will protect against dragonfire a good bit, but they're a pain in the arse tae weave together.

The Razormaw raptors up in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest are so named for their pointy chompers--they oughta break through the scales.

Bring me a handful of the incisors.

98246.title: Trying Times
98246.details:
I'll need some eggs if my plan is going tae work. Bassbeak needs a nice an' full belly--I ain't in the business of hoppin' on the back of a surly gryphon.

They need to be perfect--no cracks or anything.

Take some from the Razormaw raptors--they're known for having yolks the size of a gnome's noggin. You can find 'em in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest.

Let's make it a nice even dozen, just to be safe.

98247.title: Shipping Label
98247.details:
<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Property of the Azeroth Commerce Authority. Please return empty crates or unfulfilled shipments to our local trade hub at the Three Corners crossroads in Redridge Mountains. Couriers will be compensated for their time and travel."

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>
98247.offerRewardText: You have arrived at the right place! I am happy to mark you down as one of our affiliates. No contracts to sign and no commitments to weigh you down. All we ask of you is your diligence to assist in completing or returning any of our deliveries you find on your travels. When you do so, you will be compensated with Merchant's Favor that will allow you to purchase goods and services we offer here. In fact, here's a little bit to get you started. Now, do you happen to have the crate this came from?
98247.requestItemsText: Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?

98248.title: Shipping Label
98248.details:
<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Return damaged shipments or empty crates to the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade outpost, now conveniently located due west of the Crossroads in the Barrens. Your time is valuable and we will compensate you for your efforts!"

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>
98248.offerRewardText: You found the right place, and you're speaking with the right person! I can jot you down as one of our new associates. No paperwork necessary on your part, I can't be bothered with more of that. All we ask of you is to assist in dealing with compromised deliveries you find out during your travels. Doing so will earn you Merchant's Favor, which you can use to purchase goods and services right here. Here's a bit to get you settled in! Do you happen to have the crate this label came with?
98248.requestItemsText: Good day, traveler. How can I assist?

98251.title: Never Coming Back
98251.details:
Gaaah!

I'm so angry. They said Ashenvale was easy to follow. Easy for who? The beasts? The birds?

One moment I was gathering an herb, the next I'm trapped in this ravine. Do I truly have to circle half the forest to reach where I stood just moments ago?

When I'm like this, my spells grow volatile and behave... differently.

Could you thin the wildlife nearby? Even their stupid hooves grate on me. I despise this cursed forest.

98252.title: A Void Path
98252.details:
Show my Eye of Kilrogg the way out of this ravine and back to the Ashenvale road. Keep it moving and I'll follow once I see a clear path.

I'll stay here--one of us should keep our bearings. If you lose the way, I can guide you back through the eye. I will not have us both wandering blind in this malicious forest.

I can hold the channel for four minutes. No longer. Reach the road before the vision breaks, or return to me and we try again.

98282.title: Alchemical Hazards
98282.details:
Certain alchemical recipes require ingredients sourced from, well, very dangerous places. And those are often just the base herbs! The other ingredients are even worse!

I need to make more antivenom before I can leave again. I swear everything in this marsh is venomous. It's like it runs through the land itself!

Can you help me? I'll need a venom gland from the spiders in Thelgen Rock to the far southeast. But it has to be unruptured, or too much venom will spill out before you can get here. Sorry!
98282.offerRewardText: Oh, perfect! This is exactly what I need. You're a real hero, you know. Please, I'd be remiss if I didn't share some of the fruits of your labors with you. Stay safe out there!
98282.requestItemsText: Have you had any luck? I know it's a pain to ask, but I really do need a whole gland!

98284.title: Camping 101: Enchanting
98284.details:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
98284.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Enchanted Lute. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

98285.title: Camping 101: Engineering
98285.details:
An engineer is ever-resourceful, and if you are in the wilds alone, it's always good to be able to put your trade to use. No good camp is complete without a few helpful constructs!

Yes, come back and see me when you've gained a little bit of experience as an engineer and I can show you how to make something special!
98285.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Reagent Bot. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

98286.title: Camping 101: Enchanting
98286.details:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
98286.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Enchanted Lute. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out. Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

98287.title: Camping 101: Engineering
98287.details:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.

98293.title: Forced Disarmament
98293.details:
The Dragonmaw are stockpiling all manner of weaponry. It would be wise to relieve them of these before more soldiers can be armed.

Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep would surely be interested in these.

98298.title: Arugal's Folly
98298.details:
Ah, it's all become so embarrassingly clear! Arugal hardly had any magic at all, let alone enough to create the worgen. 'Arugal's Curse.' Pah! Barely potent enough to last a few seconds.

These shackles prove he can bind the beasts, not create them. The worgen clearly spread their curse a different way. I would know how.

Go to the Greymane Wall to the south. The worgen seem to be spreading to the humans nearby. Tear the beasts apart and bring me whatever you find. This requires a more direct approach.
