98298.offerRewardText: It appears I get the last laugh after all, haha! Arugal truly was a fool. And I, Dalar Dawnweaver, have exposed him as the fraud he is. These pieces are all the proof I need that the curse has nothing to do with that blithering dolt. Regrettably, that means his remedy is also worth nothing. It seems the search for a solution to the worgen curse continues.
98298.requestItemsText: Fangs, claws, gizzards. It makes no difference to me. The easiest way to study something is to see the guts yourself.

98299.title: Stop the Spread
98299.details:
If there is one thing we do know, it is that Arugal is responsible for worgen within Silverpine--be it his own machinations or otherwise. What we don't know is how it spreads.

While I research a way to stop the curse, our first priority is to contain it. It appears this affliction cannot infect forsaken, but a large group of humans have gathered by the Greymane Wall.

Go to the wall and put down these refugees before they have a chance to become servants for Arugal. And try not to get bit, friend.
98299.offerRewardText: It seems the Gilneans are not too keen on allowing anyone past their wall. That is fortunate, I suppose. It means there is likely no chance for the worgen curse to spread to their city. Can you imagine the depravity if an entire kingdom were infected?

98319.title: Secure the Mountain
98319.details:
It's bad enough havin' a troll problem, but the mountains are filled tae the brim with wendigos! They normally keep to their own caves, but they seem tae be spreadin' like bunnies. Now they've filled the Grizzled Den north of here.

If we want Whitebeard's report, we're gonna need to find my partner Cornelius. The blockhead got a little too excited and charged in head first. Brave, but stupid.

Head into the cave and see where he is. And feel free to take out some the beasts while yer at it.
98319.offerRewardText: Ach, the fool... Thank ye for the help, adventurer. Guess we have our report.

98321.title: Flintfire's Shipment
98321.details:
Hoha! Good to see a friend who's not afraid to get their hands dirty.

If yer lookin' fer work, I'm afraid I'm a little short on supplies at the moment. Our most reliable source of ore has been overrun by wendigo and now the cave has been abandoned. The miners had to drop everything when they fled!

Say, why don't ye poke yer head around the Grizzled Den to the west and see if you can find some of our missing shipments. It would save us a great deal o' trouble.
98321.offerRewardText: Now that's more like it! With these shipments we'll get the forge back up and runnin' in no time!
98321.requestItemsText: Wendigos are nasty beasties. Its just good all the miners made it out of the Grizzled Den in one piece!

98322.title: Secure the Mountain
98322.details:
Spelunking dark caves is adventurer business. My job's just to make reports and send them over to Ironforge.

Trouble is, one of my reports hasn't... well, reported back. I asked a few mountaineers to learn more about the wendigo problem we have out here, but I haven't heard from them.

If you're already going to be out and about, what say you don't check in with Mountaineer Gretchen just west of town. I'm late enough as it is!
98322.offerRewardText: Ol' Whitebeard sent ya, aye? I got his report, alright. This whole situation's a mess!

98323.title: Secure the Mountain
98323.details:
Hopefully ye put down a fair number of the mongrels while you were in there. Shame about Cornelius, though.

From what you described, there's not much to report other than the cave is a lost cause. Whitebeard's not gonna like that answer, but I'm not darin' sendin' anybody else into that death trap.

Feel free tae pass along the message, adventurer. I'm not leavin' this spot till the mountain's secure.
98323.offerRewardText: Completely overrun? Why am I not surprised. Well, that's going in the report too. <Senir folds Gretchen's letter into his pile of notes>
98323.requestItemsText: Ah, you're back just in time. What's the matter, lad? You look like you've seen a ghost.

98326.title: Frosthowl
98326.details:
Do ye know how hard it is to fish on a frozen lake? My poor husband, Paxton, has been out in the middle of it for days and we barely have a single sack to show fer it.

Well, we DID have a sack to show fer it. Until the thrice-damned wendigo attacked me and made off with our haul. It'll take us weeks to fish all that back up! If that loudmouth Frosthowl didn't scare 'em all off, anyway.

Do us a favor and get it back, aye? Drooling brute is hiding somewhere deep in the Grizzled Den to the southeast.
98326.offerRewardText: Yer a real lifesaver, adventurer! My husband would just laugh it off, but I couldn't bare tellin' him he has to spend another night on the lake. Maybe now we can enjoy a real feast.
98326.requestItemsText: It'll be a hot day in Dun Morogh before I tell Paxton I lost his entire stockpile to a wendigo.

98340.title: The Great Cat Spirit
98340.details:
It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young druid. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.
98340.offerRewardText: And so it continues, Father Cenarius. <Dendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him. A slight aura of power falls over him.> Greetings again, adventurer. It is time for you to learn the next perspective of nature: the cat. I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but much like the bear, it is you that must embrace this learning and propagate it.

98341.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit
98341.details:
A spirit of your homeland has recently appeared here and has asked me to guide you to it. This windborne cat spirit has come to tutor and mentor you so that you may take the feline shape of the spirit on Zephras.

All druids eventually seek this wisdom, though it seems your homeland has a slightly different shape than our traditional one. If you desire to take this spirit's feline form, you will need to undergo our trial.

It can be found in the southern part of Moonglade, south of the twin bridges.
98341.offerRewardText: Greetings, young shen'dorei. I have come to you because I sense you are ready to undertake the trial to determine if you understand my spiritual nature or not. I will have you take the trial of the Great Cat Spirit of Azeroth, but as you are from Zephras, I wished to oversee your progress myself. After all, it is my shape you would take, not that of a Azerothian cat spirit. Let us begin.

98342.title: The Great Cat Spirit
98342.details:
To draw upon my spirit, you will need more than a few words. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics of my favor you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me. We will see if you are ready to take my shape.
98342.offerRewardText: Excellent. You have shown you understand the true nature of the cat, and are able to embody the cunning, stealth, and ferocity needed to take my shape. I now deem you worthy of my blessing, young champion.
98342.requestItemsText: Ah, you have returned. I do hope you have brought the relics with you?

98362.title: To Thunder Bluff
98362.details:
The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Turak Runetotem, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.

Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.
98362.offerRewardText: Welcome back, adventurer. I can sense you have met with the Great Cat Spirit and have successfully completed the trial. All druids must pass a trial given by this spirit, though the trials vary by generation. I am proud you have passed and have heeded the wisdom of the Great Cat Spirit. It is an ancient spirit that is as deadly as it is playful, though I can sense you understand the spirit's nature already. I will now instruct you on how to take the shape of the cat.

98372.title: An Unfortunate End
98372.offerRewardText: The deceased Night Watchman lying before you is covered in deep gashes and cuts. It's clear to see that he was mauled by some sort of large beast. You notice that the corpse has an unlit torch in his hand. You reach down and pry it from his stiff fingers. This could be useful in your travels through Duskwood and beyond to reveal things hidden by darkness.

98386.title: Alther's Mill
98386.details:
Orcs, gnolls, murlocs. Everything seems to be out to stop me from getting this bridge done on time. Now we have word there's an infestation of tarantulas at our lumber mill!

If you're up to earn a bit more coin, would you head over to Alther's Mill to the east and clear out their spider problem? Place is as good as useless to me if I can't safely send workers to collect shipments.

Oh, and if you see ol' Alther, tell him he owes me for cleaning up his mess.
98386.offerRewardText: The mill is that bad? That's worse than I thought. I'm not particularly squeamish, but work's bad enough without spiders snatching up my workers. Thanks for the help,adventurer!

98387.title: Blackrock Blockade
98387.details:
What the Blackrock orcs don't understand is that this is a war of attrition. Their brazen push into Alliance territory has left them vulnerable and without supplies, relying on the surrounding mountains to gather resources.

An army can't run on empty bellies, adventurer. Go to their encampments south of Stonewatch Keep to the east and rob them of their food and weapons. Let's see the orcs' fighting spirit when they're starved and defenseless.
98387.offerRewardText: Excellent work, adventurer. With the Blackrock orcs cut off from their allies in the Burning Steppes, they will have no hope of maintaining their foothold here without proper supplies.
98387.requestItemsText: Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.

98389.title: A Light in the Darkness
98389.details:
Greetings, champion. Yes, I am a paladin. Not even death can stop the Light.

This my kind have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but I am not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.
98389.offerRewardText: May this help Executor Arren and so many others see our true nature. Much like in our past lives, we live to serve our people--to protect them with the gifts the Light provides us. They will see in time that we are just as valuable to the Dark Lady's plans as any other. Light be with you.
98389.requestItemsText: Have you freed the poor, unfortunate souls trapped in that cave?

98391.title: The Sisterhood of Elune
98391.details:
Blessings to you, champion. The Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.

We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.
98391.offerRewardText: I am glad you arrived so quickly. The Sisterhood requires your aid.

98392.title: Darkness in the Glade
98392.details:
These belts... look closely at the leather, adventurer. Do you see the taint running through the fibers?

I have a suspicion as to its origin, but we will need further proof to be sure.

Venture back out into the harpies' nests to the west and take out their leaders. If their necklaces carry the same darkness as these belts, we'll have our answer.
98392.offerRewardText: <Arynia investigates the amulets.> Do you see the foul green swirls within the gems? This is indeed fel moss corruption at work. I have heard similar reports from Shadowglen and elsewhere in the boughs of this substance turning our very world against us. I will inform my superiors of this at once.
98392.requestItemsText: Have you wrested the amulets from the harpies' leaders?

98393.title: The Great Cat Spirit
98393.details:
It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young druid. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.
98393.offerRewardText: And so it continues, Father Cenarius. <Dendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him. A slight aura of power falls over him.> Greetings again, adventurer. It is time for you to learn the next perspective of nature: the cat. I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but much like the bear, it is you that must embrace this learning and propagate it.

98394.title: The Great Cat Spirit
98394.details:
In the southern part of Moonglade, on a hill overlooking the bridge, resides a wise and cunning being we call the Great Cat Spirit.

Much like the Great Bear Spirit, this spirit has served as a tutor and mentor to druids that desire to take the feline shape. All druids eventually seek its wisdom, and if you desire to take the form of a cat, you will as well.

Go meet with the Great Cat Spirit and learn what it will teach you.
98394.offerRewardText: I see you have come to learn to draw upon my spirit. Good. Let us see if you are ready to take my shape.

98396.title: The Great Cat Spirit
98396.details:
To draw upon my spirit, you will need more than a few words. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics of my favor you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me. We will see if you are ready to take my shape.
98396.offerRewardText: Excellent. You have shown you understand the true nature of the cat, and are able to embody the cunning, stealth, and ferocity needed to take my shape. I now deem you worthy of my blessing, young champion.
98396.requestItemsText: Ah, you have returned. I do hope you have brought the relics with you?

98397.title: To Darnassus
98397.details:
The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.

Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.
98397.offerRewardText: Welcome back, adventurer. I can sense you have met with the Great Cat Spirit and have successfully completed the trial. All druids must pass a trial given by this spirit, though the trials vary by generation. I am proud you have passed and have heeded the wisdom of the Great Cat Spirit. It is an ancient spirit that is as deadly as it is playful, though I can sense you understand the spirit's nature already. I will now instruct you on how to take the shape of the cat.

98398.title: The Oracle Tree
98398.details: I am impressed by what you have accomplished here in so short a time, adventurer. Would that I could ask you to remain here to assist me with my duties... but I know in my heart that greater tasks lie ahead for you. I have noticed the Oracle Tree has just shed a piece of its bark. No doubt it has a task that it wishes completed. You should speak with it.
98398.offerRewardText: As you inspect the fallen bark, a voice enters your mind. It is calm and soothing, cresting over you like a gentle breeze through the leaves.

98403.title: Twisted Hatred
98403.details:
Lord Melenas did not act alone; he was at the behest of another. The one you seek is Xethorr the Wicked. It seems he has twisted the spiders that call Teldrassil home, intending their venom for some foul plan.

He has taken residence deep in the forest, in the area to the northwest of here known as the Cleft. Take caution, and bring allies, for Xethorr is not an opponent to be trifled with.

Dispatch his brood, and bring me anything that may tell us more of the satyr's work here.
98403.offerRewardText: I should have known this was being used to twist the spiders of this land. I have heard whispers of this substance being the source of much of the corruption plaguing us. Though this is not the original, it is an older sample and may yield more information than what we have obtained so far. Normally I would have you send this to Darnassus for further study. However, it is best we kept this quiet for the moment, or Dolanaar will never recover its reputation. I trust you to do the same.
98403.requestItemsText: <Tallonkai lowers his voice.> Does Xethorr still walk freely?

98404.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit
98404.details:
In order to draw upon my spirit, you will need to undergo a trail. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me to pass the druidic trial of these lands.
98404.offerRewardText: Excellent. You have shown you understand the true nature of the cat, and are able to embody the cunning, stealth, and ferocity needed to take my shape. I now deem you worthy of my blessing, young champion.
98404.requestItemsText: Ah, you have returned. I do hope you have brought the relics with you?

98405.title: The Great Cat Spirit
98405.details:
In the southern part of Moonglade, on a hill overlooking the bridge, resides a wise and cunning being we call the Great Cat Spirit.

Much like the Great Bear Spirit, this spirit has served as a tutor and mentor to druids that desire to take the feline shape. All druids eventually seek its wisdom, and if you desire to take the form of a cat, you will as well.

Go meet with the Great Cat Spirit and learn what it will teach you.
98405.offerRewardText: I see you have come to learn to draw upon my spirit. Good. Let us see if you are ready to take my shape.

98407.title: Show of Force
98407.details:
If the gnolls are growing so bold they are willing to camp this close to humans, there's no telling how much further they'll go. We need to deter them.

The beasts are hardly organized, but they seem to respect strength above all else. If we can slay the worst of them, maybe claim some of their trophies, we can remind these gnolls why they should stay in the hills where they belong.

Should you see any of their thrashers, bring me their collars. That should put the fear of the Alliance back into them.
98407.offerRewardText: Quite the armful you have. While this doesn't solve our problem out here, I can rest comfortably knowing we've discouraged them pushing any further. Great work, adventurer.
98407.requestItemsText: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!

98423.title: The Treaty of Understanding
98423.details: Inside of the vault you find a tablet detailing the terms of a peace treaty between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer dwarf clans. It appears to date back to time period just after of the War of the Three Hammers, and is very likely a notable piece of dwarven history. The king of Ironforge would no doubt be interested in this artifact.
98423.offerRewardText: Ah yes, my ancestor Madoran was the first Bronzebeard king of Ironforge following the great civil war between the Wildhammer, Bronzebeard, and Dark Iron clans. This treaty was drafted to codify the cessation of hostilities and terms of peace after the Bronzebeards won the mountain. As you can see, the Wildhammers and Bronzebeards signed it... and the Dark Irons did not. Thank you for recovering this and bringing it to me, champion.
98423.requestItemsText: What have you brought from the depths, champion.

98424.title: Fizsprocket's Notes
98424.details:
Some particularly worn papers are held separately, folded in Fizsprocket's inside breast pocket.

They seem to detail important information that could be used against the Venture Co. and its operations in the region. It would be prudent to look for more before returning to Morin Cloudstalker.
98424.offerRewardText: Ah, this is most valuable knowledge. I thank you for your efforts. <Morin looks through the notes.> It seems our next move is clear.
98424.requestItemsText: What is it you bring me, champion?

98427.title: Ceasing Operations
98427.details:
The shredder one of the pages speaks of--I have seen them before in my travels. They can decimate a forest in a fraction of the time that hand and axe can.

Entire glades--homes to the Earth Mother's children for millenia--erased in days.

We will not allow this to happen in our home, a stone's throw from where our young ones take their first steps.

adventurer, I must ask you to gather others, go back into the mine to the northeast, and ensure it fells not a single tree more.
98427.offerRewardText: All of Bloodhoof Village is in your debt this day. May the Earth Mother's grace stay with you always.
98427.requestItemsText: Has the shredder been stopped, adventurer?

98430.title: The Longwalkers
98430.details:
Hail, champion. What brings you deep into such a dark and violent place?

I was sent here by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof as a part of our efforts to communicate with the gnolls that have taken residence. The rest of my mission must remain a secret, as do all things with the Longwalkers, the trusted scouts of our chieftain.

All you must know is our diplomacy was met with violence, and I fear I may be tonight's feast for the gnolls if you do not help me escape.

Are you up to the task?
98430.offerRewardText: I am relieved that Longwalker Stormhoof is well. He is my most trusted scout, and his mission of the utmost importance. Please, accept my thanks and my hospitality for riskng your life to save his own. You have done a greater service to our people than you know. I encourage you to explore our great city while you are here. It is a place of safety, and you will find many that may aid you on your own travels upon its bluffs. Ish-ne-alo por-ah.

98435.title: Thunderhorn's Report
98435.details:
Our elders in Thunder Bluff must know of the progress we have made here, thanks to your aid.

Please, take this to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff. You will find him in the Elder Rise, on the east side of the city. You must take the lifts up to the center of the city, then cross the bridges to reach it.
98435.offerRewardText: Ah, no wonder there is such joy running through the streams of Mulgore. You have done a great service today. The wells provide much for not only our people, but to the wildlife we depend on for food, clothing, and companionship. It is my humble pleasure to honor Mull's request. Please, accept this token of my gratitude.

98447.title: The Valor Family
98447.details:
Despite you putting down the Valor family ghosts, the reports of attacks have not ceased. It was a good gamble, but perhaps we did not settle their unfinished business after all.

From my research, it sounds like this family all went missing at the same time. Whatever trauma caused their spirits to be chained to this realm must have happened all at once.

Our only clue is where you found the book. Return to Raven Hill and see what you can find. Maybe bringing their weapons will spark something.

98459.title: A Lack of Virtue
98459.details:
Bart Tidewater 's a no-good cheapskate, I tell ya!

"Captain of the Maiden's Virtue" he calls himself. That ship's sailed as far as a rock in Tanaris! He's no captain, he's an actor who won enough hands of poker to buy the Virtue in the first place!

If you ever find yourself in Menethil Harbor over in the Wetlands, give this to him and let him know it's from ol' Half-fish.

There's a boat from here that can take you right to the harbor, by the way. It'll be the second stop!

And he cheats at poker!
98459.offerRewardText: <Bart unwraps the gift.> Why that no good, son of a-- Did he even tell you that HE is the one who cheats at poker?! I only won enough money to buy the Maiden's Virtue after we kicked him out of our poker circle! I swear, the next time I see that absolute waste of seawater-- I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I shouldn't shoot the messenger. On behalf of the crew of the Maiden's Virtue--finest ship in the Great Sea--welcome to Menethil Harbor!
98459.requestItemsText: Put yer backs into it! We set sail on my word! Oh? What's that you have there, traveler?

98461.title: Unrequited Love
98461.details:
If you're heading out of Auberdine, I could use your help!

My dear friend Tarrel and I were classmates in school. Oh, he was such a quickfire on all things excavation! We got split up after graduation--him to Wetlands, and me to here in Darkshore.

<Hollee sighs, then her brow furrows slightly.>

Sorry, and his wife... Merrin.

It doesn't matter. If you go to the Wetlands, could you make sure he's alright? And maybe give him this? He's probably near Menethil Harbor. There's a boat straight there.
98461.offerRewardText: <Tarrel reads the note.> Oh... oh my. Poor Hollee. She always did have a bit of a thing for me. And, truth be told, there was a time where I would have reciprocated. But I'm married. Happily married! I think the best thing to do here is not to reply. I don't know how to let her down, and I have far more pressing things to worry about here! My wife is missing!

98512.title: Al'Aketh Assassins
98512.details:
You there, stranger. Get low and keep quiet. We are not alone here.

I was on patrol near the border and noticed that there are a number of Al'Aketh skulking around the house just up the hill there to the north. I don't know what they are doing here, but it can't be good.

If you want to make yourself useful, get in there and take them out. I'll wait here and watch your back.
98512.offerRewardText: I'm glad you made it back. That group of Al'Aketh looked like stone cold killers. Thank you for your aid, I'll include your assistance in my report when I return to Valanaar.
98512.requestItemsText: I wonder what they are after?

98517.title: Call of Fire
98517.details: Greetings, young Skyborne. The spirits have spoken of you, and tell me that you are ready to heed the call of fire. However, I shall not be the one to start you on that Path. Return to your home in the elemental plane, seek your mentors there. They will tell you what must be done.

98545.title: Leonid's Letter
98545.details:
Since you are here, I'd like you to deliver this letter to an old friend of mine in the Undercity. I'd deliver myself but I have a somewhat colorful history with the Dark Lady, and it would be better if a neutral third party made the delivery.

You are looking for a goblin named Glix Xizzix in the Trade Quarter area of the Undercity. I'm sure he'd be happy to compensate you for your time.

<Leonid lets out a low chuckle as he hands you the letter.>
98545.offerRewardText: Thanks for delivering this, pal. Wait... he said I'd tip you? I didn't agree to that! Fine. Take your pick of this junk in the lost and found. You'd be surprised how many of these Forsaken leave their stuff laying around after getting haircuts. There's a joke here about them being brainless, but I suspect in a lot of cases it might actually be true.
98545.requestItemsText: What's that? You say that Leonid sent you? Oh boy, haven't seen that crusty old soldier since Naxxramas was raining hell down on our heads.

98574.title: Hallowed Memorandum
98574.details: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the priest trainer Branstock. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
98574.offerRewardText: With time and practice, you'll discover new facets to the Light. In a way, it's finding a union between what you think and what you feel. As you deepen your connection with the Light, you can come back to me to talk about what you've learned. I'll be happy to show you how to tap into that force to teach ya how to heal, or to smite the wicked. For a small donation, of course!
98574.requestItemsText: Ah, another friend comin' ta learn about the Light! You'll find that deepening your connection to the Light relies on curiosity and intelligence, qualities that many gnomes have in abundance. The way o' the Light isn't a technical discipline, it's a riddle, and one that provides both life lessons and practical blessings.

98575.title: Tainted Tablet
98575.details: Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, adventurer. I usually avoid dealing with warlocks if I can help it, but I think you should read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from your newly-appointed trainer, Nartok. He would have words with you when you're ready.
98575.offerRewardText: You have just glimpsed the power that can be yours. The feeble and foolish among us are afraid of the path that we tread, but with boldness and cunning we can decide our own fates. Guard your powers closely. The fearful lash out against that which they do not understand. Now you are one of us. If you need training in spells then return to me.
98575.requestItemsText: Ah, you received my message. Excellent. We orcs have a long and turbulent history with the entities of the Nether, but now we forge our own path, in command of our destiny. You, too, can seize the power to shape the future for your people. Where our leaders falter, we are ready to press forward and claim our rightful place. You will be of eminence among the trolls.

98576.title: Glyphic Parchment
98576.details: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, adventurer. Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.
98576.offerRewardText: Da magic dat flows through you be da greatest power in da universe, but ya must be patient. Wait for da perfect moment to strike. Choose da right response to da problem at hand. If you be smart, and you watch carefully, dere be nothing you can't do. When ya tink you be ready for trainin', come back to Mai'ah. She teach you what you ready to learn, no problem.
98576.requestItemsText: Ya come to Mai'ah ready to learn. Dat be good. Ya got da power to touch da strands of da cosmos, but ya also got da wisdom to know dat you need guidance. I can teach ya da first steps to wield dat power.

98581.title: Archaic Rune
98581.details: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. Based on the Wildhammer style to these inscriptions, I'm guessin' this came from the shaman trainer Teo Hammerstorm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
98581.offerRewardText: The shamanic arts have been kept by the Wildhammer clan for years, an' now those arts have passed into the care of the Bronzebeard dwarves as well. I'm here ta help spread these teachings an' offer guidance for new shamans learning the ways of the elements. Come ta me if ya need more trainin' in the spells of earth, air, fire, an' water.
98581.requestItemsText: Ah, you were able to read the rune? It is imbued with the power of elements from some of our oldest script. That shows that you have the makings of a champion.

98601.title: A Difficult Path
98601.details:
While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine its of some importance to a paladin like yourself.

Read it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Paladins make me quite uneasy.
98601.offerRewardText: Your training can now begin in earnest, champion. I see great promise in you, but take care not to turn away from the light, even for a moment. Embrace the pain it will cause you. That pain is a crucible, and you will emerge from it stronger than you ever were in your previous life.

98731.title: Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit
98731.details:
Now that you have received my blessing, return to Dendrite. He will instruct you further. I do hope we meet again someday.

May the shadows forever hide you and your foes easily fall prey to your claws, young one.
98731.offerRewardText: <Dendrite makes another invisible gesture in the air above him as you approach. Another aura of power comes over him, and he smiles ever so slightly.> I sense the cunning and ferocity of the cat within you that was not present when I sent you to meet the Great Cat Spirit. In your eyes I can sense you now understand the stealth and speed needed to adopt this nature. Now you may learn to focus your cunning and adopt the true nature of the cat and call upon its spirit.

98738.title: Blessings of the Great Windborne Cat Spirit
98738.details:
Now that you have received my blessing, return to Dendrite. He will instruct you further.

Unfortunately I have little left to teach you for the moment. I do hope you come and visit me in Zephras again someday. I sense promise in you, young shen'dorei.

May the shadows forever hide you, your foes easily fall prey to your claws, and the winds guide your steps.
98738.offerRewardText: <Dendrite makes another invisible gesture in the air above him as you approach. Another aura of power comes over him, and he smiles ever so slightly.> I sense the cunning and ferocity of the cat within you that was not present when I sent you to meet the Great Cat Spirit. In your eyes I can sense you now understand the stealth and speed needed to adopt this nature. Now you may learn to focus your cunning and adopt the true nature of the cat and call upon its spirit.

98739.title: Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit
98739.details:
Now that you have received my blessing, return to Dendrite. He will instruct you further. I do hope we meet again someday.

May the shadows forever hide you and your foes easily fall prey to your claws, young one.
98739.offerRewardText: <Dendrite makes another invisible gesture in the air above him as you approach. Another aura of power comes over him, and he smiles ever so slightly.> I sense the cunning and ferocity of the cat within you that was not present when I sent you to meet the Great Cat Spirit. In your eyes I can sense you now understand the stealth and speed needed to adopt this nature. Now you may learn to focus your cunning and adopt the true nature of the cat and call upon its spirit.

99046.title: The Lost Runner
99046.details:
The Council of the Forest sent a small group of sentinels to the Oracle Tree some time ago. The tree sends messages to our elders, and it falls to us to deliver them to Darnassus safely.

I received word that our most recent runner has not yet arrived. The Oracle's messages vary in frequency, but it has been abnormally long.

Please head towards the Oracle Glade along the road to the west and check on her. It would have been Eralya Leafshadow's turn, and she is still in training. Elune guide you.
99046.offerRewardText: Elune's grace... I shall not die... alone...

99047.title: Not Dead Yet
99047.details:
My sisters and I... were dispatched... Oracle Tree...

Tree... message. I... harpies... everywhere...

<Eralya coughs up blood, grimacing through the pain.>

I may not have long... no one coming. Please... Byancie... in Dolanaar...
99047.offerRewardText: The harpies have become afflicted by the same foulness showing up throughout the forest. I'm sure that is what ails Sentinel Eralya as well. We must hurry. It won't be long before she succumbs to her injuries.

99048.title: A Missing Hand
99048.details:
A member of the Shattered Hand, a group of more... subtle fighters, was watching Tiragarde Keep from a distance. Her reports suddenly stopped coming in.

I doubt the humans would have caught her, so I'm concerned something more dangerous is at play. See if you can find her. Hopefully the messages are just delayed.
99048.offerRewardText: Heglan's body lies cold within the wreckage of the hut. Whatever killed her doesn't seem to be human. There may be signs of what happened nearby.

99049.title: Threat from Below
99049.details:
The nearby area is destroyed with obvious signs of a skirmish. Whatever ambushed Heglan didn't make it out unscathed. There's probably signs nearby of what happened.

Orgnil will probably want to see any evidence left by the attackers.
99049.offerRewardText: This banner and blade piece belong to the naga! They must have come down the coast from the north. We cannot let them establish a foothold here. The pressure from both directions would be too much for Razor Hill.

99050.title: The Great Tree Provides
99050.details:
I will need your help acquiring the ingredients I need to stop the affliction long enough for Eralya to make it back here for further treatment.

Thankfully, our living home is still bountiful and will provide in our time of need.

The core ingredient is dewy lasher fronds. You'll find them around Lake Al'Ameth directly south of here, or Wellspring Lake and its river to the northwest.

In addition, I'll need an empty vial and some spring water. Both can be bought here in town, or traded for.
99050.offerRewardText: Thank you for your help. Please, accept this to help with the costs of the vial and water. Now, to make the salve. It should only take a moment.
99050.requestItemsText: Do you have the ingredients? I fear Eralya may not have long.

99051.title: Threat from Below
99051.details:
It wouldn't be the first time those snakes bothered us. They need to be taught that their presence is not tolerated here.

Find where their scouts are setting up camp and slaughter them. Bring me back their fins as proof. We need to act fast to make sure they understand.
99051.offerRewardText: Hopefully that sends them packing back to the north. I'll have some grunts keep an eye out for any stragglers or funny business.
99051.requestItemsText: Hopefully those snake scum aren't giving you trouble?

99052.title: Threat from Below
99052.details:
One of my scouts has reported a sea giant followed those naga down here. Not sure if they brought him intentionally or what, but he's dangerous in any case.

It's a young one, but it could still rip an orc in half in a heartbeat if they were caught off guard. I need him gone. But I'd suggest you find some help to deal with it.
99052.offerRewardText: Ha! I could hear his body fall from here! Be proud of your kill today, not many can claim they survived a fight with a sea giant.

99053.title: Escaping Ban'ethil
99053.details:
My prayers have been answered! I am thankful that you have fought your way down here.

I was sent here by the Oracle Tree to deliver a message to the slumbering druids here only to find it completely overrun by furbolg! They ambushed me before I could turn back and brought me down here--I fear for their next meal.

I don't know about you, but I loathe this place. Under the earth is no place for the kaldorei.
99053.offerRewardText: Thank Elune you were around to help Lynessa avoid a dark fate with the Gnarlpine. She's one of our best, and a personal friend. Please, take this in thanks. May it serve you well in keeping the kaldorei safe.

99073.title: Easing Suffering
99073.details:
The salve is ready. Take it to Eralya swiftly.

I do not know if it will truly cure her. The rot festers quickly, and grows in strength as it spreads.

It will, if nothing else, ease her suffering. And that is still worth your haste.
99073.offerRewardText: <Eralya's breath calms quickly as you help her ingest the salve. She may not survive, but is at relative peace.>
99073.requestItemsText: <Eralya has stopped responding verbally. Only a weak, gurgled exhale confirms life.>

99079.title: Longwalker Malah
99079.details:
The Longwalkers are our people's most trusted scouts. Though their loyalty lies with the High Chieftain alone, young Baine at times seeks their aid.

This is one such time. Longwalker Malah was dispatched near our borders to the east and did not return last night after three days. When this occurs, it is our duty to confirm their safety.

I must ensure the village remains safe. Prove yourself, and seek Malah out. You will know her by her headband and feathered staff, emblematic of the Longwalkers.
99079.offerRewardText: It is clear that Malah did not die naturally. Arrows cover her back and the ground nearby.

99080.title: Drive Them Out
99080.details:
Hear my words well: we will not yield a single blade of grass to the centaur.

Go to their camp now, before they have rested and have a chance to ride to our village. Slaughter them all. Ensure none escape to the Barrens to rally others to their aid.

If you find the leader of this would-be raiding party, bring me his head so that it may serve as a warning to others who dare tread on our ancestral homeland.
99080.offerRewardText: You are covered in centaur blood. Remember this feeling. It is an honor unlike any other among our people. I could hear the moment the last fell, and their thunderous stampede echoed no longer. Well done! Today marks a great victory for our village, and a security our young ones need now more than ever. You have my deepest thanks, young champion.

99081.title: Grim Tidings
99081.details:
You can see what appears to be a new centaur camp in the direction the arrows in Malah's back would have come from. There is a stir of activity, suggesting a small raiding party has made its way into Mulgore.

The Longwalker has a report in her still-clenched hand. Brave Wildrunner will want to know of Malah's fate--and her killers.
99081.offerRewardText: This is most dire news indeed. We must inform Baine at once!

99082.title: The High Chieftain
99082.details:
Your bravery defending your people demands recognition. Journey to Thunder Bluff to the northwest, our mighty city whose shadow grants us shade in the warmer months, and seek audience with my father.

It was he who led the charge with the young Warchief Thrall to reclaim these plains and drive the centaur away for good. As High Chieftain, he will reward you generously for your part in ensuring his own bravery is honored.

You must take a lift to reach the High Chieftain, who sits on the central rise.
99082.offerRewardText: The Galak centaur dare show themselves in Mulgore?! You have brought pride to your ancestors by driving them out. Perhaps that will remind them of the pain that awaits them should they do so again! Please accept this gift in honor of this. May it serve you well as you venture out into the Earth Mother's kingdom, to the far reaches of this world.

99101.title: Our Ancient Enemy
99101.details:
Baine Bloodhoof leads our village. He must know of this incursion at once.

Bring him Longwalker Malah's report. You will find him at the center of town.

Quickly, now. There is no time to waste!
99101.offerRewardText: <Baine reads the report, his gaze darkening.> This will not stand. Thank you for delivering it to me, adventurer.
99101.requestItemsText: What is it you bring me, champion?

99108.title: Sparring Match
99108.details:
Hail, young champion. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.
99108.offerRewardText: You honor me with your abilities, champion. Perhaps the new generation has hope yet. Take these to tend to your wounds, for many more battles await you in this harsh world.
99108.requestItemsText: There is no teacher quite like the sharp end of your adversary pointed at your heart.

99123.title: Lost in the Shadows
99123.details:
I decided to do a bit of scouting in the crag on my own. Unfortunately my magic ran out at the wrong time and I've been stuck hiding here since.

If you could help me escape, I would appreciate it.
99123.offerRewardText: Ah, Pal'juh got herself in trouble again, did she? Hopefully she learns her lesson about going alone this time. Thank you for helping her. She's a promising hunter, just tends to act more like a raptor than a tiger.

99127.title: A Net Disaster
99127.details:
The fish just ain't biting today, and there's something wrong going on with them. It's not just empty hooks. I haven't seen a single minnow up in the water at all.

Lee here set up some traps overnight, go check to see if we've at least got some stock there. If you find anything weird, make sure to show me.
99127.offerRewardText: All the traps are like this? Seems our new neighboring nuisances are causing more destruction than we were aware of. I'll go broke if we don't do something about it.

99128.title: Slimy Menace
99128.details:
This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match.

If we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.
99128.offerRewardText: I can hear their warbling from here, it'll be in my nightmares. Well, that should slow them down--although I have no doubt that they'll make up those numbers quickly.

99129.title: A Man About a Murloc
99129.details:
Remy mentioned murlocs the other day... I'm pretty sure he hates the little buggers as much as I do.

He might have some ideas on how to keep them away from my fish in the future. I'd like to ask you to go chat with him and see if there's anything he can think of.
99129.offerRewardText: I've been warning the guards about the murlocs. They won't listen. I have a few ideas on how to get back at those critters. I'll need your help getting what I need for it though.

99130.title: An Enticing Offer
99130.details:
I've got a few ideas on how to deal with murlocs. And one of those also helps some others in the process.

There's a weed often found on farms in the area called duskweed, and in large quantities the petals are toxic to most animals. If we make some murloc bait with the plant, hopefully that can train those creatures to stay away.

And some farmers get their fields cleared in the process. Truly a win-win... truly a win-win.
99130.offerRewardText: Give me just a minute... It's pretty simple bait, but as long as nobody's pet gets into it, it should be safe. Just tell Jason not to eat any of it.

99131.title: Baited for Success
99131.details:
Tell Mathers he can come pick up the bait later today. I'll give him the rundown on the proper usage.

Hopefully he'll be able to sell his fish again soon. And we'll have less murlocs in this world.
99131.offerRewardText: Poisoned bait? As long as the fish aren't going to eat it, that should work. I'll visit Remy later to pick it up.

99134.title: Discipline
99134.details:
You are not a member of the Deathguard, and therefore have yet to disappoint me.

As a reward for your lack of incompetence, you shall be rewarded with punishing those that have demonstrated such talents in excess.

Swiftly now--adventurer, is it?--or I shall add your name to my ledger for someone else's reward.
99134.offerRewardText: There are precious few delights afforded to us in death. Thankfully, pain is chief among them. You please me this day, and therefore you please the Dark Lady. Perhaps you can be of further use.

99141.title: Patience
99141.details:
Make no mistake, champion--the Dark Lady demands the perfect execution of her will. As an Executor, it is my duty to see that this happens.

Reports from several of my Deathguards are overdue. Needless to say, my patience has run out. Obtain their reports and bring them to me in the Dark Lady's name.

You will find Deathguard Dillinger just west of here, by the graveyard. Deathguard Kristof is stationed at the waystation to the east. And check on the abomination Gordo; he wanders west near Stillwater Pond.
99141.offerRewardText: I should have known better than to think an abomination could write anything of use. Let us keep that lapse of judgment between us. You have pleased me, and therefore pleased the Dark Lady. Perhaps there is hope for you.
99141.requestItemsText: You'd best have those reports in hand, or get out of my face.

99142.title: Tomb Weed
99142.details:
If you're heading east, towards the Balnir Farmstead, I have more you might do for me. Good help is ever so hard to find these days, as your run-in with Gordo illuminates ever so clearly.

As I acquire doom weed I perform some minor alchemical alterations and replant them on that farmstead to cultivate my ultimate creation. I call it tomb weed, and it shall be the herald of my glorious destiny.

Do keep an eye on the Scourge in the area while you're there. They seem... drawn... to the weed. Curious.
99142.offerRewardText: Most glorious indeed! <Junior Apothecary Holland inspects the weeds.> Hmm, I had hoped they would have matured a bit more violently. Nevertheless, progress is progress! A great many will die as a result of your actions this day. You should be proud.
99142.requestItemsText: More interruptions! Wait, it's you. Were you able to recover the tomb weed?

99143.title: Bottles and Baubles
99143.details:
Those fish men must think like actual fish, right? Which means anything they like, fish will like!

If you rummage through some of their junk and return to me with anything that seems like it would make good bait, I'll reward you.
99143.offerRewardText: An interesting collection. These should work well enough! Here's some of my own older supplies. It should help anyone trying to get their footing in fishing.
99143.requestItemsText: What did you find? Anything interesting?

99144.title: Seeking Refuge
99144.details:
Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all I meditate for... all I strive to protect!

< Bareth Dawnstone steadies himself.>

I know some still take issue with my kind, but I assure you our intentions are pure. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.
99144.offerRewardText: Blessings upon you for aiding Dawnstone. Our order is still taking root here and it would be devastating to lose one so promising before his time. Please accept this as a token of our thanks. Should you ever take an interest in our ways, our monastery Bandarion Keep lies on the bluffs northwest of the Solliden Farmstead. We welcome all who seek guidance in the Light.

99152.title: As Above, So Below
99152.details:
While the Tarnished in Shadowvale to the southwest are definitely a problem, we cannot allow the cellars below the town to fester into a full-blown Scourge uprising on Bandarion Keep.

I need to get these trainees up to snuff in case that happens. You, however, are going to receive what I like to call a crash course.

Travel beneath Shadowvale and retrieve some of their wretched bones so we can study them further. I need ones that still retain some of the initial reanimation magic--that's glowing ones.
99152.offerRewardText: Well done, recruit. We might just make something out of you yet. With these bones we may be able to better understand how such a threat was able to go unnoticed for so long.
99152.requestItemsText: You'd best not be returning empty-handed. I either need the bones I asked for, or your body on a stretcher to confirm you at least gave it your all trying to get them.

99153.title: The One That Got Away
99153.details:
Oi, you! Word travels quickly among our ranks. I heard about the work you did with the cultists around the remnants of the battle with Naxxramas.

Problem is, one of them cultists got away with a piece of the focusing crystal. Seems to still have some juice in it. Best guess we have is it's somewhere beneath Shadowvale. It's either raising 'em or making 'em stronger, and you don't want either one.

Find that crystal before this gets out of hand.
99153.offerRewardText: Well done--and quick, too! Now onto my favorite part...
99153.requestItemsText: Did you find the damned thing?

99156.title: Rear Guard Patrol
99156.details:
Damn it all! A new report came in while you were on patrol. There has been a sighting of a rogue abomination wandering Eastern Tirisfal Glades, near Venomweb Vale.

Something is wrong. Abominations don't just slip through the Bulwark unnoticed.

Keep this matter on a strictly need-to-know basis. That said, such a creature will not fall easily; you will need allies if you wish to be more than its next meal.

See this through, and you will be duly rewarded. Bring me its heart as proof of the deed.
99156.offerRewardText: You are a testament to the cunning and coordination that all Forsaken possess--something the mindless Scourge will never have. Please accept this as thanks for your efforts, as promised.
99156.requestItemsText: Have you dealt with our little problem?

99158.title: Dawn in the Mountains
99158.details:
There's a priest out in the mountains that belongs to an organization called the Argent Dawn. They're a holy group that is dedicated to finding and destroying the unholy and unnatural.

Father Gavin though, he's mostly the type that seeks to help and heal everyone rather than grab a weapon. He's fixed up an old building to serve as a rest spot for travelers and called it Misty Pine Refuge. I've got a shipment of holy candles that I need to get him. Could you bring them to him if your going that way?
99158.offerRewardText: Ah. Candles from Ironforge. While I am mostly able to live independently in my hermitage, there are a few key things that I appreciate from the city and the pious.
99158.requestItemsText: Why did the Light guide you here today?

99159.title: Finding Warmth
99159.details:
My hearth is open to warm any soul, but I'd like to ask you to help me if you could.

I simply need more firewood. It is something I would normally do myself, but I have been preoccupied by other tasks.
99159.offerRewardText: Ah, perfect. These will do--any that are too wet to use right now I will leave to dry. Now, if you're willing, I have more tasks I could use help with.
99159.requestItemsText: Light guide you on your tasks.

99160.title: Rime's Wrath
99160.details:
You may have noticed the elementals nearby. A shelf of rock and ice fell from the mountain peaks a few days ago and riled them up.

These frozen mountains are already treacherous for the average dwarf or human without the elements taking form. I am not one for fighting anymore--so any of the spirits you can kill would help make the road safer.
99160.offerRewardText: I wish we could have simply placated them. Unfortunately it was beyond my knowledge and they were too dangerous to leave unchecked.

99161.title: Rime's Wrath
99161.details:
I noticed that the first elemental that appeared after the rockslide was larger than its peers. And from what I can tell, it has been the source of occasionally weather changes and other minor slides.

I've been calling it 'Avala', if you could kill it and retrieve the core as proof, I will reward you.
99161.offerRewardText: Light bless you, champion. Your efforts make this area much safer and hopefully will prevent unnecessary deaths.

99162.title: Treacherous Cold
99162.details:
Even mountaineers from Ironforge have to keep their wits about them when traversing through the peaks of Dun Morogh. Falling snow and ice often spells the end of some more novice members' lives.

After a slide, I usually try to find any sign of survivors or victims--while praying to the Light that there's nothing to be found. But with the elements acting up, I've held off wandering too far. If you could look for some lost mountaineers and bring me their rifles, I will return them to Ironforge.
99162.offerRewardText: The mountaineers engrave their names on the stock of their rifles. It helps identify them should something happen. I'll send these back to Ironforge--there someone will pass them on to any family.

99191.title: A Donation of Wool
99191.offerRewardText: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, adventurer!
99191.requestItemsText: The High Order are currently accepting donations for wool cloth. A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the High Order for your generous actions.  Sixty pieces of wool should prove to be a sufficient amount for the High Order's needs for now. If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

99196.title: A Donation of Wool
99196.offerRewardText: We thank you for your generous donation! Winds be with you, friend.
99196.requestItemsText: The Windshapers are currently accepting donations for wool cloth. A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Windshapers for your generosity. If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

99260.title: Fillion's Mission
99260.details:
I was tasked to retrieve important data on the flow of elemental energy from the Overlook Standing Stones. That data is vital to our plans to safely travel between Skywall and Azeroth. Without that data to aid in our calculations, our attempts to steer our skycutter ships through the elemental plane will fail.

The data is likely lost at this point, and I'm in no state to attempt to gather it again. I told the Supreme Magister of your role in saving me, and he wishes to speak with you again.
99260.offerRewardText: Thank you for saving Fillion, adventurer. I'm sure he told you how vital the data he was sent to retrieve is. Without that data, our prospects for opening safe lanes of travel to Azeroth is at serious jeopardy. Our spies tell us that the Windshapers have themselves procured the means to traverse the planes, and no doubt wish to jealously guard this secret. As ever, their own dogmatic hubris take precedence over the good of our people. They are little better than the Al'Aketh.

99267.title: An Unfortunate End
99267.offerRewardText: The deceased Night Watchman lying before you is covered in deep gashes and cuts. It's clear to see that he was mauled by some sort of large beast. You notice that the corpse still has an unlit torch in his hand. You must not have taken it earlier after all. You reach down and pry it from his stiff fingers. This could be useful in your travels through Duskwood and beyond to reveal things hidden by darkness.
